It's not like that. It's not like that. Adam's phone rings. He answers it, and a male voice speaks.
speaker: MIRANDA

text: Sir, Jake's medical report is out. But strangely, his blood type doesn't match yours. He's likely not your son. Adam’s phone slips from his hand.
speaker: MALE VOICE

text: Jake isn't my son?
speaker: ADAM

text: What? How is that possible? Miranda was pregnant with Jake when she was in a car accident while raising funds for you. She was a wandering amnesiac for eight years. How could Jake not be your son?
speaker: QUINN

text: We've already investigated. When your company was on the verge of bankruptcy, Miranda didn't raise any funds for you. She abandoned you and ran off abroad. Jake is the child she had while she was the mistress of a foreign tycoon.
speaker: ISSAC

text: When she found out you were back on your feet and even richer than the tycoon she was with, she came back with Jake. She made up a tragic story to earn your sympathy.
speaker: PHOENIX

text: What? You poisonous woman! You've been playing us for fools?! Quinn rushes to Miranda and grabs her by the neck.
speaker: QUINN

text: Because of you, we’ve offended the richest family in the world! The Dawson Group is about to go bankrupt! Are you trying to drag us down with you?! I'm going to strangle you!
speaker: QUINN

text: Miranda can't breathe.
No. No.
speaker: MIRANDA

text: And here I thought I was so good to you!
speaker: QUINN

text: Adam pulls Quinn away.
There must be some misunderstanding. Phoenix, who now has a miscarriage diagnosis in her hand, hands it to Adam. Adam takes it with trembling hands.
speaker: ADAM

text: What is this?
speaker: ADAM

text: Our child.
speaker: PHOENIX

text: Do you remember when Miranda and I fell down the stairs? You carried her away. And I… I watched our twins die! FLASHBACK: Phoenix lies on the ground, bleeding after falling down the stairs. PHOENIX (VO): After five years of marriage, you still don't trust me. Adam carries Miranda away.
speaker: PHOENIX

text: Adam grabs Phoenix's arms, his eyes red.
You're lying to me, aren't you? We had a child?
speaker: ADAM

text: Perhaps their death was God's will. Because you don't deserve to be my children's father!
speaker: PHOENIX

text: Adam is filled with regret and cries bitterly, shaking his head.
Phoenix, please… I really didn't know.
speaker: ADAM

text: Adam suddenly kneels. Adam cries.
I'm sorry, Phoenix. It was my fault. Please forgive me. Let me make it up to you! We can still have our children!
speaker: ADAM

text: Phoenix slaps Adam.
There is no "after." From now on, I only want to live for myself. Besides, the person I am now is far beyond your reach.
speaker: PHOENIX

text: Phoenix leaves, with the light behind her. Miranda crawls to Adam's feet, holding his hand and begging for mercy.
Adam, please, forgive me. Jake is so young. I just wanted him to have a good life. Please, let me go!
speaker: MIRANDA

text: Adam forcefully pushes Miranda's hand away.
Phoenix was never a threat to you. You were just too greedy. From today on, you and Jake get out of the Dawson family!
Adam!!!
speaker: MIRANDA

text: INT. MUSE COMPETITION - STAGE - DAY
The host announces on the stage.
Now, let's present the Muse Gold Award.
speaker: HOST

text: Moreau proudly walks onto the stage.
The winner is Phoenix Blunt.
Moreau is stunned. Phoenix gracefully walks onto the stage and turns to face the audience.
Impossible! Absolutely impossible! How could a newcomer win against me?! This is a fix! It has to be a fix!
speaker: MOREAU

text: Then I'll show you the painting Miss Blunt made with the mud-like gray- black pigments! So you can admit defeat willingly! The host signals to the stagehands. Two women in white blouses and black skirts, with their hair neatly tied up, walk to the center of the stage, holding a painting covered with a black cloth.
Fine! When everyone sees the painting, let's see how you'll try to justify this!
speaker: MOREAU

text: I don’t need to.
speaker: PHOENIX

text: Phoenix turns and pulls the black cloth off the painting. It is a painting with only black, white, and gray colors. It shows a majestic snow-capped mountain standing firm against a thunderstorm. Moreau is shocked when he sees it.
Impossible! How could you?!
speaker: MOREAU

text: The American art scene has plenty of talent. You are just arrogant and shortsighted, so you can't see our true strength.
The judges' decision is fair and just. There's no cheating. Miranda suddenly breaks into the competition venue.
I object!
speaker: MIRANDA

text: Phoenix Blunt's painting is a complete copy! I'm Angel's number one fan! I can tell that her technique is an exact imitation of Angel's. She’s just using her status as the Blunt family heiress to plagiarize Angel and impersonate her! The champion should be Moreau!
Even if they're the richest family in the world, they can't use their power to get their daughter into the Muse competition! All the spectators raise their fists and shout in unison.
speaker: SPECTATOR 2

text: We want fairness! We want justice! We want fairness! We want justice! Some spectators excitedly stand up. Miranda smiles triumphantly. Logan stands up and walks to the front.
speaker: ALL SPECTATORS

text: My daughter was the winner of the Muse Award five years ago.
speaker: LOGAN

text: What's going on? Does Mr. Blunt mean that Phoenix Blunt was Angel five years ago?
speaker: SPECTATOR 1

text: You’ve been calling me your idol for so long. How is it that you don't even know what I look like?
speaker: PHOENIX

text: Impossible! My idol is Angel, how could it be you?! You have no evidence, you're all just talking nonsense. A lowly woman like Phoenix can't possibly be my idol.
speaker: MIRANDA

text: I can prove it!
speaker: ISSAC

text: Issac enters with six bodyguards in black suits and sunglasses.
Five years ago, Angel won the Muse Award Gold Medal, and I was her defeated opponent that year. I have been serving as the president of the National Artists Alliance for five years in her place.
speaker: ISSAC

text: Angel's whereabouts have always been a mystery. Even if you were her defeated opponent, it doesn't prove anything!
speaker: MIRANDA

text: That's because Phoenix is low-key! If her face had been shown at the award ceremony, she would have had countless suitors. Dawson wouldn't have stood a chance!
speaker: ISSAC

text: How can this be?! How can she be Angel?! You're all lying to me! You're all liars!
speaker: MIRANDA

text: Issac signals to the bodyguards. Two bodyguards drag Miranda away. Issac signals to Phoenix.
Please, champion, come up to the stage to receive your award. On stage, Phoenix holds the trophy, surrounded by reporters, as confetti falls from above.
speaker: ISSAC

text: In the future, I will lead the art world to create even more outstanding works!
speaker: PHOENIX

text: INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT1 1

A motel room so rundown and dirty the cockroaches don't stay. SHANNON CLARK (29) lies sick in bed, coughing. She weakly reaches for a glass of water sitting on a warped nightstand carved up with graffiti. Shannon strains to reach the water. Too weak. KAREN MURPHY (28), uptown glam and loathe to be in a place so dirty, pushes open the door and steps inside. Her fiance, RICKY TRAX (29), sporting a tailored suit that oozes "powerful businessman...wannabe" follows Karen like a nervous puppy. Karen reaches for the glass of water and "accidentally" knocks it over. Shannon collapses in exhaustion. KARENWhoops. Karen covers her mouth and giggles like a bitch. She links arms with Ricky, showing off her engagement ring, of which the dazzling shine pierces through Shannon's heart. KAREN(cont'd)Tomorrow, we are getting married. As my ex-best friend, I believe you want to give us your blessing, right? SHANNONBlessing? Fine. (coughs) Can I have some of my money back? My treatment isn't covered by... KARENShannon, how did you end up so shameless? Did you plan to feed off of Ricky your whole life? Ricky nervously adjusts his suit over and over. He doesn't like being here, but he's not about to say no to Karen. SHANNONRicky, before I trusted you with my fortune, you were the son of my father's chauffeur...who's feeding off who? Ricky scowls and shoves Karen out of the way. He reaches over and grabs Shannon by the throat, half-lifting her out of the bed. His grip tightens and tightens...

RICKYYou think I'm feeding off of YOU? Your father has been dead for years. Before you had me, you were a loser about to drop out of college. I earned my worth with blood and sweat tutoring dumb rich kids like you. You're nothing but the daughter of a filthy rich dead guy! ...until he flings her back to the bed. SHANNONYou said you would marry me, not her, if I gave you control of the business. I'm asking you for less than one-percent of what I gave you. Karen stifles laughter. Ricky rolls his eyes. Shannon collapses in a fit of tears and coughing.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT2 2

Ricky leans to get into Shannon's face, to be intimidating, but when he sees how sick she is, he recoils in disgust. RICKYHow dare you even to bring that up? I saved the Clark family business from YOU, the useless, spoiled brat, who'd been carrying HIV, and never bothered to tell ME UNTIL THE NIGHT BEFORE OUR WEDDING!
RICKYHow many people did you sleep with? How many excuses do you still have? With a broken heart, Shannon is no longer listening. SHANNONRicky, did you ever love me?
speaker: SHANNONI DIDN'T KNOW!

text: A beat. Ricky is stunned by the audacity of her question. Ricky and Karen burst out laughing. Shannon is devastated. RICKYLove? What an insult. Being stuck with a woman so stupid, disgusting and phony, looking back, everyday was like a nightmare. How can I love someone who only makes me sick?

Shannon grips her chest, coughing. Wet, nasty coughs. Disgusted, Ricky walks out, leaving Karen to deliver the final blow. KARENAw, look at you, here at the end and the only thing you want to know is if Ricky loved you. You should be asking how a drug-free virgin like you ended up with AIDS. SHANNONYou know...? KARENSince you're about to die. I'll have some mercy and tell you a little secret. Someone was hired to inject you with HIV. I'm surprised you never figured that out, or jumped off a building, to save the world from your disgrace. SHANNONWho would do that...why? KARENRicky. The love of your life didn't want to marry you. Twenty dollars to a junkie, he's free and you're the dirty slut. Nice and easy. Horrified, Shannon pushes herself off the bed as Karen leaves, trying to stop her. SHANNONNo, that can't be true. No... Shannon gurgles and chokes, coughs spraying blood.
EXT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT3 3

Karen and Ricky walk out of the hotel. They slow down when they see JOHNNY WONDER (30), a handsome, kind looking man hurrying towards the motel. All three eye each other when they pass shoulders. There is history there.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT4 4
Johnny kicks open the door and finds Shannon fallen halfway out of bed, unable to get up. JOHNNYShannon! He rushes to help as she coughs up more blood.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT5 5

Johnny rushes to Shannon's side and pulls her close. She coughs blood all over his suit. JOHNNYYou need a doctor. Let me call 911... SHANNONJohnny Wonder...is it really you? She looks longingly into his eyes, stops him from calling. SHANNON(cont'd)It's too late. JOHNNYI'm so sorry, Shannon. I always thought you were doing well...happily married. If I had any idea it was like this...I would have stopped the wedding! I'd have taken you from Ricky Trax! Let me call an ambulance, please? Shannon smiles, almost laughing out of joy. Johnny is confused. Why is she laughing while dying? SHANNONI've never imagined, other than my father, there can be another man who cares so much about me. What a shame I wasted this life on a heartless monster. I'm a fool. Shannon, coughing more blood, has her eyes rolling back. She can barely keep her head upright. SHANNON(cont'd)In my next life, I will...choose differently... Shannon is breathing her last breath hearing: JOHNNYIn my next life, I will make you the happiest woman in the world. Tears falling down Johnny's face -- the last thing Shannon sees before she dies in his arms. Then, in an instant we are transported to...
INT. COLLEGE CLASSROOM - DAY6 6

A college classroom. Bright golden summer sunlight pours through a wall of windows. Desks are gleaming and every STUDENT in the room (including Shannon) wears casual clothes that cost thousands of dollars. Shannon is sleeping on her desk. JOHNNY (V.O.)(grieving as she dies)Shannon...Shannon...SHANNON! Shannon's eyes jolt open. She slowly lifts her head, unsure of where she is. Unsure why she's alive. Then she sees the name of her UNIVERSITY on a banner in the classroom. SHANNON (V.O.)This is...college? How can this be? I've been reborn ten years ago? Shannon (18) looks around and sees Ricky (19) and Karen (18) sitting next to each other one table away. Clearly a couple. RICKYWhat’s wrong, honey? KARENThe egg-salad gave me a tummy ache. Ricky looks at the lunch in front of Karen, then looks at Shannon who's still looking around the room in wonder. RICKY(to Karen)I'll be right back. Ricky walks over to Shannon. Shannon feels food coming from above: Ricky has dumped Karen's lunchbox on top of Shannon's head. Shannon is stunned. Frozen. Giggles everywhere. RICKY(cont'd)I told you to get some FOOD for Karen, not the garbage people like you eat. Go buy something edible. Shannon stares at Ricky, her face a cool, collected mask of rage. It unnerves Ricky to his core.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY7 7
Shannon wipes egg-salad from her face.

SHANNON (V.O.)Ricky Trax, in my previous life, I gave you everything, only for you to betray and murder me. This time will be different. RICKYAre you deaf? Go! Now! KARENRicky. Maybe I'd better go myself. Karen gives a pouty, simpering vibe that is pure condescension. Ricky raises his palm to stop Karen. RICKYWhy bother? Running errands for you makes her feel valued, right Shannon? SHANNON (V.O.)Yes. Let this meal start my revenge. Shannon stands up and walks out so purposefully Ricky smugly thinks his world is in order.

RICKY(whispering)Shannon what the hell are you doing? SHANNONYou still expect a free ride in my car after insulting me like that? Yancey and Sue watch from a distance, unable to hear what's being said, but willing to speculate anyway. YANCEYThat's Ricky's family car. Why does he let this bitch do that to him? SUEThat's what you get letting a maid's daughter ride with you. If you give a mouse a cookie... YANCEYC'mon Trax, just pull her out. RICKYDo you have to act like this? I forgive you about the lunch, but if you don't stop acting like this--
speaker: INT./EXT. CAR - DAY12 12

text: SHANNONI don't need your forgiveness. You can walk home. Stop following me. RICKY (V.O.)I have to get in the car. Or I'll be exposed. If anyone knows I'm the son of their driver...

Ricky grabs Shannon's wrist and yanks her out of the car. Flinging her to the ground. He tosses her purse after her. The students laugh and cheer. Ricky helps Karen in the back seat then he gets in front the other side. Nobody moves to help Shannon. SHANNONRicky Trax, how dare you push me? RICKYDrive. The car zooms away. Shannon climbs to her feet, brushes off her purse and grabs her phone. YANCEYWell done Ricky, dealing with some ungrateful low life. That's what she deserved. SUERicky is so cool. Shannon is on the phone. SHANNONDad, our driver has forgotten who he works for. YANCEYCalling Ricky, begging for forgiveness? It's too late. SHANNONThe one who will beg for forgiveness is him. Watch. My car is coming back. Yancey laughs in disbelief. But her smile fades when the car engine roars as it reverses back to Shannon. Ricky, and Karen climb out. Mr. Trax is most chastised of all. Everyone who mocked Shannon are stunned. MR. TRAXShannon, please get in the car. I'll take you wherever you want to go. Shannon walks past Yancey and Sue proudly in vindication and gets into the backseat.
INT. DINING HALL - DAY8 8

The dining hall is impressive, like if The Cheesecake Factory wasn't tacky. While Shannon picking up food, Yancey (18), a classmate struts up beside her ready to cause trouble. YANCEYFetching lunch for your master again? With brilliant girls like Karen around, Ricky won't waste a glance on your kind. You know that right? Other STUDENTS watch the show, giggling behind their hands. SHANNONWhat kind am I? YANCEYThe "daughter of his maid" kind. The "follows him to school every day" kind. The "dream of marrying rich" kind. The "if your lucky you can make his bed, sweep his floors, scrub his toilet" kind. You know. Your kind. SHANNONThat's what Ricky told you? Did he tell you "his luxury car" belongs to MY family? That he's the son of MY driver?

The crowd watching gets bigger, laughs a little louder. It doesn't phase Shannon at all. YANCEYWhat a psycho! Barking like a chihuahua just because Ricky won't look at you? Hurry up, your master's lunch is getting cold. SHANNON (V.O.)The driver's son saying I'm HIS maid! Ricky Trax, you are going to pay for that. Shannon takes her food and walks through the crowd that was watching and laughing. They all turn away in embarrassment.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY9 9

Shannon sits at her desk, finishing up the food she was supposed to bring to Ricky and Karen. Karen, Ricky and Yancey walk in, seeing the empty containers in front of Shannon. RICKYI told you to bring food for Karen and you ate it? Mine too? God, you're such a pig. Shannon tosses her fork and knife down, and crosses her arms. She's done with this dude. SHANNONI bought this with my money. Two meals or twenty meals what does it have to do with you? YANCEYYour money? Even if you spend it, it's still Trax money. Duh. SHANNONWhat do you think, Ricky Trax? Who's money is it? RICKYI think getting lunch when you're told to get lunch for your boss is a simple task. He leans over and whispers loudly in her ear.

RICKY(cont'd)If someone can't get that right, she's gotta be stupid. SHANNONWho's my boss? Her? If this capable young woman is too lazy to get her own lunch, she deserves a tummy ache. RICKYYou— YANCEYYou're a Trax family maid. Taking care of his girlfriend is your job. Why is that so hard to comprehend? Ignoring Yancey, Shannon rises to her feet and faces Ricky. SHANNONRicky Trax. Am I your maid? Ricky flinches. He's not used to direct confrontation like this. RICKYAlright, Shannon, alright. I'm not interested in this little game you're playing. Don't cause trouble because I won't forgive you. No matter how much you beg me. SHANNONBeg you? Why would I? What have I done wrong? A stand-off. Ricky scoffs and rolls his eyes. RICKYYou think you're tough? Fine, there's no seat for you in my car. You can walk home. Everyone walks out, and Shannon watches them go. SHANNON (V.O.)Your car? It was never yours and it's time you learned your place.

Shannon smiles with amusement. SHANNON (V.O.)Oh there is a line to cross? I had no idea. But, this is just the beginning. Ricky Trax, Karen.... She slams the door, almost crushing Ricky's hand, leaving him and Karen embarrassed. The window glides down -- SHANNONBye. (to Mr. Trax.) Driver, drive. The car peels out.
EXT. SCHOOL PARKING LOT - DAY10 10
Shannon, with her handbag, walks toward a luxury car in front of everyone. She gets in the backseat, leaving them in awe. Yancey and her friends loudly gossip. The window is down.

YANCEYAfter insulting Ricky and Karen she still has the nerve to keep freeloading rides? Unbelievable! Yancey and her minions scoff. SUE (18), a student who socially clings to Yancey the way Yancey socially clings to Karen, chimes in. SUEA maid's daughter acting like a princess. YANCEYRicky is too kind. If it was me, I’d have already kicked her out.
INT. CAR - DAY11 11

Hearing their words, Shannon rolls up the window. Trying to relaxes, she closes her eyes. SHANNONDrive. The driver, MR. TRAX (50) Ricky's father turns around to address Shannon. He's in a suit, but a cheap one. MR. TRAXLet’s wait for Ricky. SHANNONMr. Trax, you work for my father and me. I decide who we wait for. MR. TRAXDid you have a fight with him or something? I'll have a word with Ricky, for sure. But try to be nicer to him, if you please. I know you look down on us, but... SHANNONDrive! I don’t want him in my car. I don't want him in my house. I don’t want to see him anymore! MR. TRAXWell, let’s wait. SHANNONAre you going to drive or not? MR. TRAX (V.O.)She's usually so scared of Ricky. What's going on today?

Did she forget I'm her future father in law, or the fact my son will take over her father's business? SHANNONMr. Trax I asked-- MR. TRAXLook, they’re coming out. Shannon, fuming, sees Ricky and Karen walking out of the building toward the car. Mr. Trax hops out, deferential as hell, opening the door to the backseat for his son. But when Ricky opens the door, Shannon grabs it and refuses to let Ricky inside. Panic flashes across Ricky's face.
EXT. SCHOOL - DAY13 13

Sue and Yancey watch the drama between Shannon, Ricky, and Mr. Trax play out in the parking lot. SUEEven Ricky's driver gets so respectful to a maid's daughter. This doesn't make sense. YANCEYWhy did Ricky get out? Mr. Trax clings to Shannon's door like it's a shield and timidly speaks over the top edge. MR. TRAXShannon, was it really necessary to bother your father? For your little argument with Ricky? He's very busy. SHANNONFrom now on, they two are not allowed in this car. MR. TRAXIsn't that a little--childish, Shannon? SHANNONYou are not close enough to use my name. Remember who pays you. I think to drive when your boss tells you to drive is a simple task. If you can't get that right, feel free to quit. MR. TRAXI...I know I was wrong. I'll drive right now. Before his father closes the door, Ricky stops him. RICKYShannon, that's enough. SHANNONOh look, the "young master" is mad. KARENShannon, you may not like me, but there's no need to bully Ricky. He's always nice to you. He had the driver come back just for you. Why do you have to be so mean? RICKYNo need to tell her that. She doesn't know anything about gratitude.
Shannon, you've really crossed the line this time. Shannon rolls her eyes.
EXT. SKYSCRAPER - NIGHT14 14
Establishing shot of where Shannon lives.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT15 15

Shannon walks into the huge, open concept kitchen filled with natural light and spectacular views of the city. She finds an older woman, AUNT JO, preparing dinner. Jo takes her handbag. AUNT JOMiss, you're back alone? Where’s your friend Ricky? SHANNONAunt Jo, from now on, I don't have any friends named Ricky. AUNT JOMiss, you’ve finally come to your senses. With instant regret crossing the boundary, Aunt Jo covers her mouth awkwardly. Shannon reaches out and holds her hand. SHANNON (V.O.)Aunt jo was the kindest of all the servants in the house. In my past life, she always warned me about Ricky, but I was so blind in love that I pushed her away. In this life, I won’t fail her again.

AUNT JOSorry miss, I spoke out of turn... SHANNONIt’s okay, Aunt jo. You were right. I'm going to go lay down for a bit. It's been a long day. AUNT JOAlright. Oh, Johnny Wonder came to visit. I can send him away though, if you're tired... About to leave the room, hearing that, Shannon's face lights up in excitement. SHANNONJohnny? Where is he? Aunt Jo points and Shannon runs that direction.
EXT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - TERRACE - NIGHT16 16

Shannon steps out of the house and sees, standing in a pool of light, the most handsome young man in the world, JOHNNY WONDER. This is the first time she's seen him since being reborn. He hears her gasp and turns. The entire world slows down as this beautiful person turns to rest his eyes on Shannon. SHANNON (V.O.)This is 20 year old Johnny, the fiancé my father arranged for me. In my past life, because of Ricky Trax, I was not fond of him. He wanted to be with me, but I wanted only Ricky. I not only refused him but also said hurtful things to him. She holds back tears. Johnny isn't sure what's up but he only cares for her. SHANNONJohnny, it's so nice to see you again. JOHNNYMiss Clark, it’s nice to see you too. SHANNONJohnny, is there something you needed?

JOHNNYI wanted to see you. Hesitating, in awkward silence. JOHNNY(cont'd)I know you don’t want to see me, so I’ll go. Johnny turns away, ready to leave, when Shannon stops him. SHANNONJohnny... She almost grabs his hand to stop him from going. SHANNON(cont'd)Would you like to have dinner with me? JOHNNYReally? The romantic tension between them is insane. We half-expect them to start making out right then and there. SHANNONSure. Aunt Jo is the best chef! As she leads Johnny inside she can't help looking over her shoulder and smiling at him.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT23

At a elegant glass desk, Johnny and Shannon sit next to each other. Johnny diligently works through a complicated math problem, explaining the steps, but Shannon stares at him dreamily, absorbed in her own thoughts. SHANNON (V.O.)God, Johnny is nothing like Ricky. Johnny has patience, he speaks well, he never complains. And OH MY GOODNESS is he handsome. (beat) How could I have been so blind in my previous life?

How could I waste all my time on someone like Ricky Trax. Especially when Johnny was right there all along! She doesn't realize Johnny is watching her think. JOHNNYIs there something you don’t understand? She doesn't say anything, just keeps looking at him. Then she realizes he said something and snaps out of it. SHANNONSorry, I’m just too dumb. JOHNNYShannon, you're not dumb. You're just using the wrong study method. Let me help you build a stronger foundation first, then if your grades don't improve...you can fire me and I'll return everything you've paid me already. SHANNONAre you sure? You really mean that? Johnny nods. Then they smile at each other. Ricky stomps into the room. He doesn't even acknowledge Johnny and rips into Shannon. RICKYShannon, seriously, what’s your deal? She speaks slowly and clearly, like she's dealing with a child. SHANNONWhat do you want now? RICKYYou threw my things in the basement! Johnny carefully watches the back and forth. SHANNONI told you this afternoon, you've been fired. I have a new tutor. So why should you stay at my house? Especially in such a nice room? ESPECIALLY after I fired your father too! But if you insist on staying, the basement is all yours. Ricky slams his palms on the desk. Shannon doesn't flinch.

RICKYShannon, do you think it's fun to humiliate me? SHANNONHumiliate you? Stop being so dramatic. RICKYFine, Shannon, don’t think I don’t know what you’re up to. RICKY (V.O.)Tomorrow at the birthday party, I’ll make sure you regret this. I’ll make you kneel in front of everyone and apologize. Shannon slaps the papers with each word, trying to break through Ricky's dense idiocy. SHANNONWe’re still in class. Can you stop interrupting us? Ricky is thrown off his game. He's still not used to Shannon resisting him. RICKYFine. Just wait. Ricky points a finger at Shannon. Johnny shifts his weight, ready to leap in and defend Shannon if necessary. Ricky and Shannon both notice.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT17 17

Aunt Jo bustles in the kitchen while Shannon and Johnny sit shyly near each other trying to steal looks at the other but not get caught doing it. SHANNONAunt jo, let’s start dinner. AUNT JOWe're not waiting for Ricky? Hearing "Ricky", Johnny's eyes dart to Shannon, watching to see what she'll say. SHANNONWhy? AUNT JO (V.O.)Thank goodness, Miss Shannon won't be such a suck-up anymore.

AUNT JOI’ll get everything ready right away. SHANNONJohnny, you're grades are really good, aren't they? Mine are terrible. Would you mind...being my tutor? You could come here every day and help me study. JOHNNYI thought Ricky Trax was your tutor? JOHNNY (V.O.)And you love him so much you pushed me far away from you. SHANNONHe’s about to be fired. Johnny barely suppresses a smile. JOHNNYIf you would like, I'm available. Maybe we could begin tomorrow? SHANNONYes. Tomorrow, then. Johnny leaves. Moments later Ricky storms in, angry. RICKYShannon, why'd you tear my dad a new one in front of everyone? What's wrong with you? Go apologize to him right now or I'll-- SHANNONI disciplined my driver. I pay his salary and he leaves me on the side of the road! And you think I should apologize? RICKYHe's my dad! Anything he did was because I told him to do it!That’s my dad! It had nothing to do with him. If you have an issue, deal with me! SHANNONOh, right. Your father answers to you. In that case, you can both pack your bags and go. RICKYWhat? What did you just say?

SEBASTIANEnough of this madness.(to security)Get him out of here. Security immediately restrains Vincent, dragging him backward. He thrashes wildly, completely unhinged. VINCENT(screaming)I won’t give up! I’ll make you remember me. I swear I will! Lydia watches him being hauled away. Her face remains cold. LYDIA (V.O.)Vincent, seven years of marriage, you hid our relationship from the public. And now, when you’re desperate to prove it, no one believes you. You did this to yourself. Pathetic. Episode 37
INT. SEBASTIAN’S VILLA – LIVING ROOM – NIGHT
Lydia stands before a golf club rack by the window. Her fingers slowly trace along one particular club.
EXT. LAWN – DAY

Vincent hands Lydia a custom-made golf club. VINCENTLydia, this is a custom piece, my gift to you for our first wedding anniversary. From now on, you and golf are the two most important things in my life. Lydia throws her arms around him, holding him tightly. LYDIA(teary-eyed)I’ll carry this club with me forever. I’ll stay by your side, always.
INT. SEBASTIAN’S VILLA – LIVING ROOM – NIGHT

Lydia exhales softly. Her gaze steadies. LYDIA (V.O.)I’d completely forgotten about this. Looks like this game has already helped me let him go…So why am I still reluctant to end it? Across the room, Sebastian stands half-hidden in the shadows. A trace of fear and possessiveness flickers across his face. He walks over and wraps his arms around Lydia from behind. SEBASTIAN(low, careful)You… don’t believe what he said, do you? Lydia pauses for a beat, then relaxes. She reaches back, placing her hand over his. LYDIANo. I’ll never believe him.

Sebastian tightens slightly. SEBASTIANBut what if… what if he was telling the truth? Lydia turns to face him, tilting her head up. LYDIAIf it were true, I’d hate him even more. Because he was the one who pushed me into your arms.(soft, assured)Don’t worry. Right now, you’re the only one in my heart. Sebastian freezes. His lips part slightly, stunned. SEBASTIANSay that again. Lydia lifts her arms, resting them on his shoulders, fingers interlacing behind his neck. She rises onto her toes, close enough that only a breath separates them. LYDIA(whispering, intimate)I love you. Sebastian’s eyes redden. He pulls her sharply against him and kisses her deeply, fiercely, as if afraid she might disappear. LYDIA (V.O.)Let me be selfish—just this once. Let this game… last a little longer.
EXT. VILLA – NIGHT

Vincent stands beside his car. From a distance, through the villa’s floor-to-ceiling windows he watches. Lydia and Sebastian locked in a fierce, intimate kiss. Vincent’s hands clench at his sides, knuckles turning white. Zoe runs up behind him, breathless. Vincent dials his phone.

VINCENTGeorge ， your grandson, Sebastian, is taking advantage of my wife’s amnesia. He’s deceived her and stolen her from me.(voice tight with fury)You need to come back and stop him. He hangs up without waiting for a response. Vincent turns sharply, gets into the car, and drives off, leaving Zoe standing there, completely ignored. ZOE(furious)Vincent! Zoe watches the car disappear, her expression shifting as thoughts race. ZOE (V.O.)As long as someone can still prove that marriage ever existed, Vincent will never let go. If I want him to be free of Lydia forever ， I’ll have to cut off his obsession at the root.
INT. SEBASTIAN’S VILLA – LIVING ROOM – NIGHT

Sebastian cups the side of Lydia’s face and neck with one hand, kissing her deeply. With the other, he loosens his tie and tosses it aside, fingers moving to unbutton his shirt as he kisses her again. He backs her up step by step, until Lydia’s back meets the glass window. She shifts her shoulders. Sebastian pauses, their foreheads touching, breath mingling. He reaches for the curtains, Lydia catches his arm. LYDIADon’t close them. Sebastian arches a brow. SEBASTIANYou sure? Lydia smiles—slow, provocative. LYDIAQuick and decisive. No one will see.

Sebastian lifts her legs effortlessly, settling them around his hips. Lydia gasps and instinctively wraps her arms around his neck. SEBASTIAN(chuckling)That’s one request I can’t promise to fulfill. He kisses her again. The camera slowly pulls back.
INT. VILLA BEDROOM – DAY

Morning light spills into the room. Sebastian lies shirtless in bed, one arm wrapped protectively around Lydia. Her bare shoulder peeks out from beneath the covers as she sleeps against his chest. Suddenly, BANG! The bedroom door is kicked open. Both Sebastian and Lydia jolt awake. Standing in the doorway ， GEORGE HAWTHORNE (MALE, 80s), impeccably dressed in suit, leaning on a cane, his presence imposing and icy. Beside him ， Vincent, fists clenched, eyes blazing with rage. VINCENT(voice shaking)Sebastian!
INT. VILLA BEDROOM – DAY

Vincent lunges forward and swings at Sebastian. Sebastian catches the punch mid-air and throws Vincent aside. Vincent crashes into a desk, knocking it over—but he scrambles back to his feet and charges again. Before he can land another blow, Lydia steps forward and slaps Vincent hard across the face. The sound echoes. Vincent’s head snaps to the side. He freezes, clutching his cheek, staring at her in disbelief. LYDIA(cold, furious)Enough. I’m sick of you.

VINCENT(stunned)You, you hit me for him? LYDIAYou broke into my home and tried to assault my husband.A slap is me being generous.(voice sharp)This is your final warning. Stay away from me. VINCENT(shouting)Lydia! George strikes the floor with his cane. The room falls silent. GEORGE(authoritative)Enough. This ends now. Vincent spins around and grabs George’s sleeve. VINCENT(shouting)George! You know the truth!Tell her, tell Lydia whose wife she really is! All eyes snap to George. George stands tall, leaning on his cane. A long pause. Then— GEORGE(calm, absolute)Lydia is Sebastian’s wife. Lydia freezes. Vincent’s face drains of color. Sebastian remains perfectly composed.
INT. VILLA BEDROOM – DAY
Vincent locks his gaze on George, barely holding himself together.

VINCENT(breaking down)George! Why are you lying to her? You know the truth— GEORGE(cutting him off, icy)Both of you—get dressed.(points his cane at Vincent)You. Come with me. George turns and walks out. Vincent shoots a look at Sebastian and Lydia—resentful, unwilling, humiliated, then follows George. Lydia stands frozen. LYDIA (V.O.)Why would George lie for me? Sebastian notices her furrowed brow.He pulls her into his arms, patting her back gently. SEBASTIAN(soft, confident)Don’t be afraid.George believes in fairness. Lydia exhales, still unsettled. LYDIA (V.O.)Or… was this Sebastian’s doing?
INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM – DAY
Vincent follows George into the living room, barely able to contain himself. VINCENTGeorge, you—
George slaps Vincent hard across the face, cutting him off. Vincent’s head snaps to the side. He stares at George in shock. GEORGE(enraged)You disgrace. Sebastian already told me everything.(MORE)

text: GEORGE (CONT'D)You cheated on your wife with her best friend, and had the nerve to play sick games like wife-swapping? You’ve dragged this family’s name through the mud! From your home to your work, she took care of every detail of your life—(voice hard)You didn’t cherish her. So don’t blame someone else for cherishing her now. Vincent snaps his head up, eyes burning. VINCENT(low, threatening)No. Lydia is my wife. If Sebastian doesn’t give her back. I’ll expose the truth. I’ll destroy him. Let him fall with me. George stares at Vincent in cold silence.
INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM – DAY

Vincent turns sharply and heads for the door. George slams his cane hard against the floor. GEORGE(booming with rage)You dare? Vincent freezes. He turns back, eyes wild. VINCENT(losing control)Sebastian stole my wife—and now he wants to erase my marriage to Lydia forever! He’s trying to drive me insane!(MORE)

VINCENT (CONT'D)(bitter laugh)At this point, what wouldn’t I dare? GEORGEThen what about your child? Are you abandoning that too? Vincent freezes. VINCENT(stunned)What child? George turns his head slightly toward the doorway. GEORGEBring her in. The butler nods and opens the door. Zoe appears. She rushes in, beaming, clutching a pregnancy test report. She throws herself into Vincent’s arms. ZOE(excited, breathless)Vincent! I’m pregnant—with your baby! Look! She grabs Vincent’s hand and presses it to her belly. Vincent looks down at her stomach, then at the pregnancy report in her hand— His entire body stiffens. VINCENT(trembling)That’s impossible… A cold voice cuts through the room. LYDIA (O.S.)Congratulations. You’re going to be a father. Vincent snaps his head up. At the top of the staircase stand Sebastian and Lydia, fully dressed, arms linked. They look down at Vincent, detatched and superior. Vincent’s face drains of color.
Sebastian’s expression is calm and dominant. Zoe lifts her chin, her eyes flashing with provocation.
INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM – DAY

Vincent shoves Zoe’s hand away and rushes to the foot of the staircase, looking up at Lydia in panic. VINCENT(frantic)Lydia, listen to me!That night—I was drunk.I don’t even know how that child happened! Lydia… You’re the only one in my heart. The only child I want is the one you give me— Sebastian steps forward sharply. SEBASTIAN(cold, commanding)Enough. Lydia is my wife. Watch your place. Vincent glares at Sebastian with naked hatred. Lydia tightens her hold on Sebastian’s arm. She looks at Vincent gently, then speaks. LYDIA(soft, calm)If I ever have a child,it will only be Sebastian’s. Her gaze turns icy as it shifts to Vincent. LYDIA (CONT'D)(cold)Not yours.You’re a stranger to me. She links her arm more firmly with Sebastian. She brushes past Vincent without even sparing him a glance. Vincent turns, reaching out instinctively. VINCENT(broken)Lydia! Zoe grabs his arm, stopping him.

ZOE(pleading, humble)Vincent… The baby and I both need you. Please don’t leave us. Vincent watches Lydia disappear. His raised hand slowly drops— utterly powerless. Zoe rests a hand on her stomach and turns toward George, fragile on the surface. ZOE (CONT'D)(soft, calculated)George… I’d like to live here with Vincent. That way the baby can grow peacefully. George nods. GEORGEButler. Prepare a room. BUTLERYes, sir. George looks at Vincent with finality. GEORGEVincent. It’s over. Accept reality. From this moment on, you and Lydia have no future whatsoever. Vincent clenches his fist, eyes squeezed shut. After a beat, his grip loosens. Tears well as he stares in the direction Lydia left. ZOE (V.O.)(triumphant)I’ve finally moved into this villa as its mistress. From now on, I am Vincent’s rightful wife. No one will ever take that away from me.
INT. VILLA STUDY – NIGHT
George sits behind his desk. Sebastian stands in front of him.

GEORGE(serious)Are you sincere about Lydia? SEBASTIAN(without hesitation)Yes. George studies him. GEORGESince Vincent’s so-called marriage to her doesn’t exist, then you’d better treat her properly. Lydia is a good girl. Vincent hurt her. I don’t want you to do the same. SEBASTIAN(firm, solemn)I never will. I’ll protect Lydia for the rest of my life until death. George nods, satisfied. A beat. SEBASTIAN (CONT'D)George… Vincent is far too obsessed with Lydia.Let them move out. George smiles faintly. GEORGEOnly when Vincent sees with his own eyes how deeply in love you two are will he truly give up. That’s why you must live together. Sebastian frowns, conflicted. SEBASTIANBut Lydia will be upset. GEORGE(chuckling softly)Why don’t you ask Lydia yourself? I don’t think she’s as fragile as you imagine.
EXT. VILLA BEDROOM BALCONY – NIGHT
Lydia stands on the balcony in a silk camisole.

Her arms rest on the glass railing as she lets the night breeze wash over her. Sebastian approaches quietly, draping a blanket over her shoulders. He wraps his arms around her from behind, resting his chin against her hair. Lydia tilts her head, smiling. SEBASTIAN(gentle)Is living with Vincent and Zoe making you unhappy?Do you want me to kick them out? LYDIA(calm, resolute)If they take one step forward and we retreat, they’ll only push harder. Whoever moves out first loses. I don’t intend to lose. Sebastian kisses the top of her head. SEBASTIANI know. You’ll win. He lowers his head, kissing her neck. Lydia laughs softly, ticklish. LYDIAStop… On the adjacent balcony, Vincent steps out impatiently, pulling out a cigarette. He looks up and sees Sebastian holding Lydia from behind, kissing her bare shoulder and neck. Vincent’s expression twists. He clenches the cigarette, snaps it in half. The crushed tobacco falls from his fingers.
EXT. VILLA BEDROOM BALCONY – NIGHT
Sebastian stands behind Lydia, kissing along her cheek, her neck, her shoulder. Lydia’s shoulders lift slightly as she closes her eyes, breathing unevenly.

Sebastian gently hooks two fingers under her chin, turning her face toward him. SEBASTIAN(low, teasing)Do you still have the strength…for another round? Lydia inhales sharply. LYDIA(Softly)No— Before she can finish, Sebastian captures her lips. He turns her body toward him, the kiss deepening. Lydia’s hands slide up around his neck, responding instinctively. SEBASTIAN(murmuring against her lips)Your body disagrees with your mouth. He lifts her slightly, holding her close. Sebastian reaches into his pocket— Lydia catches his wrist. Their lips part, foreheads touching, breath tangled. LYDIA(quiet, resolute)We don’t need that anymore. I want a child. A child that belongs to us. Sebastian freezes. Pure, unguarded joy flashes through his eyes. He lets go of the item in his hand without a second thought. It arcs through the air, landing on the adjacent balcony. Vincent stands there, frozen. His bloodshot eyes drop to the ground. Then slowly lift, locking onto Sebastian and Lydia. VINCENT(breathless, breaking)No… Sebastian adjusts Lydia in his arms, kisses her deeply, laughing softly as he turns and carries her back inside.
VINCENT (CONT'D)(roaring)STOP! Sebastian doesn’t look back. The balcony doors close. Vincent slams his fist against the railing, shaking with rage. He spins, storms back inside.
INT. VILLA HALLWAY – NIGHT
Vincent charges down the corridor. He stops abruptly in front of a closed bedroom door. His hand reaches out, then grips the doorknob tightly. His chest heaves.
INT. VILLA HALLWAY – NIGHT

Vincent’s hand is locked on the doorknob. Before he can turn it, a cane strikes down sharply, pinning his wrist. George steps forward, eyes cold. GEORGE(low, commanding)Go back to your room. Take care of your wife and your child. Stop disturbing your brother and his wife. Vincent jerks his hand back, fury blazing. VINCENT(gritted teeth)His wife?! Fine. Then I’ll let the reporters decide. I’ll tell the world exactly whose wife Lydia really is. He yanks out his phone, about to dial, George snatches it from his hand and slams it onto the marble floor. The screen shatters. George lifts his cane, pointing it straight at Vincent. GEORGE(final warning)This is the last time I warn you.(MORE)

GEORGE (CONT'D)If this scandal reaches the public and damages our family’s reputation—every share of the company under your name will be taken back. All of it. Vincent freezes. The threat lands. VINCENT(shaken, unwilling)…On what grounds? Sebastian stole my wife. He owes me. GEORGE(cold, absolute)No one owes you anything. This situation is the result of your own choices. And the consequence you must bear is letting Lydia go. Zoe rushes in, wrapping her arms around Vincent, forcing a smile toward George. ZOE(overly cheerful)Don’t worry, sir. I’ll keep an eye on him. I won’t let him act recklessly. George gives her a frosty glance, then turns and walks away. Silence falls. Zoe tightens her grip on Vincent, lowering her voice. ZOE (CONT'D)(reasoning, coaxing)Vincent, think about the money. And think about the baby. Throwing away everything you have for Lydia, it’s not worth it. Vincent stares at Sebastian’s closed bedroom door. His eyes burn red. He suddenly slams his fist into the wall, a dull thud echoes down the hallway. Zoe flinches. VINCENT (hoarse, breaking)Lydia… Am I really supposed to just stand by and watch you be taken from me?
His jaw tightens, eyes filling with rage and despair. VINCENT (CONT'D)(low, venomous)I won’t accept this. I won’t.
INT. VILLA RECREATION ROOM – DAY

Sebastian leans over at the pool table, hits in a ball, his shirt unbuttoned down to his abs. Lydia leans against the wall behind him, wearing a bikini, checking out the shape of Sebastian. She bites her lip. LYDIAI didn’t know you were also a master pool player. Sebastian turns around, checking Lydia out. He yanks Lydia into his arms. Lydia puts her hands on Sebastian's chest. Sebastian holds the cue with one hand while the other hand traces up between Lydia's legs. SEBASTIANWant to learn? Say the word. Sebastian pins Lydia under him on the pool table. Lydia looks up at Sebastian, doe-eyed, her throat bobs as Sebastian's lips are inches away from her. LYDIATeach me... Before she finishes, Sebastian flips and pins her down again, pressing her face-down at the pool table with one hand. Vincent and Zoe enters and sees them. Vincent's eyes turn red, his hand holding a wine glass trembles. SEBASTIAN(whispering)Don’t tense your wrist.Billiards doesn’t respond well to force. LYDIA(low, teasing)Then what does it respond to? A faint smile curves Sebastian’s lips.

SEBASTIANGuidance. He leans closer. His chest brushes lightly against her back. His breath lingers just behind her ear. LYDIA(soft, absorbed)And then? SEBASTIANNow! Lydia strikes. The cue ball rolls smoothly, hits the red ball cleanly. Straight into the pocket. Lydia breaks into a smile, turning her head toward him. LYDIAI did it! The wine glass in Vincent's hand shatters from his tight grip.
INT. VILLA RECREATION ROOM – DAY
VINCENTSebastian, I'm not giving Lydia to you. You will get what's coming for you. Vincent leaves in fury. ZOE(Jealous)Lydia, I'm tired with the world with you in it.
EXT. VILLA POOL – DAY

Lydia lounges on a sun chair by the pool. Bikini. Sunglasses. Relaxed. Radiant. Zoe storms over and deliberately blocks the sunlight. Lydia frowns and opens her eyes. ZOEEnjoying two men fighting over you? Feeling proud of yourself?

Chasing after married men, that’s low, even for you. Lydia sits up. Slowly removes her sunglasses. Stands. She looks Zoe straight in the eye, calm but cutting. LYDIAI’ll give that speech right back to you, Zoe. You earned every consequence coming your way. She steps past Zoe, brushing her shoulder as she moves to leave. Zoe snaps. She grabs Lydia’s arm. ZOEYou don’t walk away from me, say it clearly! They struggle. Hands push. Feet slip. Suddenly, Zoe shoves hard. Lydia loses her balance, falls into the pool with a splash. Zoe staggers backward, slips, and tumbles in after her. At that exact moment, Sebastian and Vincent rush out from opposite sides. Both freeze for half a second, then shout at the same time. SEBASTIAN / VINCENTLydia! They leap into the pool, one after the other. Water explodes upward.
EXT. VILLA POOL – DAY

Sebastian and Vincent plunge through the water toward Lydia. Sebastian reaches her first. He wraps his arms around her and pulls her to the surface, hauling her onto the pool deck. Vincent climbs out right behind him. Sebastian immediately begins CPR, pressing down and giving rescue breaths. Vincent stands frozen nearby, fists clenched. His face twists with worry—and jealousy he forces himself to swallow. Zoe struggles in the water, ignored by Vincent. ZOE(screaming)Vincent! Help me! Please, help me!

Lydia suddenly coughs violently, choking up water. Sebastian exhales in relief. Vincent’s shoulders drop. Then Lydia’s eyes flutter and she goes limp again. Sebastian’s breath catches. His entire body tenses as he scoops her into his arms. SEBASTIAN(panicked, hoarse)Lydia! He picks up Lydia and runs out, carrying her in his arms. Vincent follows right behind. Zoe climbs out of the pool, watching Vincent out, abandoning her. ZOEVincent! In the distance, George stands with the butler, watching Zoe unravel. Cold. Calculating. GEORGE(rigid)After all that, is the baby still fine? Check on her pregnancy. Have her pregnancy checked again. Thoroughly. The butler bows slightly. BUTLERYes, sir. George turns away as Zoe’s cries echo across the pool.
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY

Sebastian sits at Lydia’s bedside, gripping her hand tightly. Vincent stands a few steps away, anxious, eyes never leaving her face. Lydia’s lashes flutter. She slowly opens her eyes. Both men exhale at the same time. SEBASTIAN(relieved, emotional)Lydia… You’re awake. You scared me to death.

Lydia gives him a faint smile. Then her gaze shifts to Vincent. Her expression cools instantly. She turns back to Sebastian, voice steady and unmistakably clear. LYDIAZoe pushed me into the pool. I want to press charges. The air in the room freezes. Sebastian’s eyes darken in an instant. Vincent stiffens, stunned. SEBASTIAN(low, controlled)Anyone who lays a hand on you…will pay for it.
INT. HOSPITAL HALLWAY – DAY

After a while, Zoe is dragged in by two men in black suits. She thrashes, shaking her head wildly. ZOENo! It wasn’t me! She’s framing me! Sebastian steps forward calmly. He pulls out his phone, taps the screen, security footage plays. Clear. Unmistakable. Sebastian stops in front of Zoe. He slaps. Zoe freezes. She stares at the phone in his hand, face draining of color. SEBASTIAN(ice-cold)Lying to my face? You’ve got a death wish. Vincent surges forward, furious. VINCENTHow could you hurt Lydia?! ZOEVincent! Please, help me! I did it because I love you! And I’m carrying your child! I'm pregnant! A calm, authoritative voice cuts through the chaos. GEORGE (O.S.)But you are not. Never was.
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY

George stands tall, eyes sharp. He signals the butler, who steps forward holding a neatly folded lab report. Vincent freezes, shock washing over his face. Zoe’s eyes dart nervously. Vincent grabs her by the throat, trembling with rage. VINCENT(furious)You've been lying to me?! He slaps her hard. Zoe collapses to her knees, clutching her face. Vincent points at her, furious. VINCENT (CONT'D)It’s because of your lies, your deceit, that I lost Lydia! You deserve to die. He rips the ring off Zoe’s finger—Lydia’s engagement ring—clenches it in his fist. VINCENT (CONT'D)You have no right to wear what I gave Lydia! Drag her out! The black-suited men move in. Zoe struggles, screams, but they cover her mouth and drag her out. GEORGE(to Vincent, Sebastian, Lydia)Sort this out, the three of you. No more loose ends. George and the butler exit. Vincent stands there, clutching the ring, eyes locked on Lydia. Sebastian instinctively steps in front of her, protective. Vincent gazes at Lydia, pleading. VINCENTLydia… I love you. And I don’t have a child with Chloe. We can start over.

Lydia takes the ring and stares at it for a few seconds. Vincent's eyes ignited in hope, while sebastian's darkens, worried. Lydia smirks, cold. She drops the ring on the ground. Vincent is left in shock. Lydia laughs coldly, venom in every word. LYDIALove? Seven years of marriage, all my sacrifices… and you? You slept with Zoe, abandoned me while I was vulnerable, married her in my place, and now you want to take me back? You are incapable of love. You only love yourself. Sebastian and Vincent both freeze at the words: “seven years of marriage”. Their eyes widen in shock. VINCENT(stammering, horrified)Lydia… you… you remember everything? LYDIA(calm, unflinching)I never forgot. I never lost my memory. Both Sebastian and Vincent stand stunned, their emotions frozen in disbelief.
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY

Vincent stands frozen, disbelief written all over his face. His voice shakes with desperation. VINCENT(voice breaking)No… this can’t be. You’re lying to me! Lydia fixes her gaze on him. A faint, almost playful smile curls her lips. LYDIA(smiling coldly)Yes… I lied. But not just now.(MORE)

LYDIA (CONT'D)since the very beginning, I’ve been lying to you. Vincent’s eyes widen. He steps back, stunned. VINCENT(whispers)…Why? LYDIABecause I couldn't understand why you would push me into your brother’s arms. Why I had to watch my own husband and my best friend get close right in front of me. Why you would do this to me after all I have done for you! Vincent kneels, voice trembling, desperate, almost broken. VINCENT(humble, pleading)Lydia… I was wrong… I know I was wrong. I'm so sorry. I swear… I’ll give you the biggest wedding the world has ever seen. I’ll make our love known to everyone… I'll make it up to you. He reaches out, trembling, for her hand. Lydia steps back coolly. Vincent’s hand freezes midair. Tears spill down his cheeks. VINCENT (CONT'D)(voice cracking, desperate)I’ll step aside, be your assistant, stay by your side… I swear I’ll never betray you again… Please… come back to me… Lydia’s eyes are icy. Her tone is sharp, final. LYDIA(cold, unyielding)Too late. Vincent… you destroyed us with your own hands. If you want me to remember even the tiniest bit of what we had, let me go. That’s the only happiness you can give me now. Vincent’s shoulders slump. He lowers his head, letting the tears fall onto the floor. He closes his eyes, takes a deep breath, wipes them away, and slowly rises.

VINCENT(sorrowful, broken)I’m sorry, Lydia… I was a fool… to lose the most beautiful, loving person in the world. I promised you happiness… if leaving is the happiness you want, then… I’ll give it to you. He bends to pick up the wedding ring from the floor. He glances back at Lydia one last time, eyes filled with regret. Then he walks away, utterly defeated. Lydia exhales slowly, turns to face Sebastian, who watches her anxiously. They lock eyes. LYDIA(tired, soft)Sebastian… The game is over. We both need to return to our rightful places. Sebastian grabs her shoulders, lowering his head to meet her eyes. SEBASTIAN(earnest)I never treated this time with you like a game.
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY

LYDIA(dismissive, guarded)Stop joking. I know you played along for thrills, helping your brother… Sebastian takes her hand, placing it over his chest. SEBASTIAN(heartfelt)Lydia… I love you. I’ve always loved you. From the first time I saw you on the course at ten… my heart has belonged only to you. Lydia freezes. Sebastian reaches into his suit, removing a tie clip, and hands it to her.

SEBASTIAN (CONT'D)When you won your first championship, I was just a fan shaking your hand… and you dropped this hairpin. I picked it up… and I’ve never let it go. Lydia’s eyes widen with realization. LYDIA(soft, astonished)It was you… You liked me all along? I always thought you hated me… Sebastian steps closer, his expression tender and unwavering. SEBASTIANI’ve always liked you. When I learned my brother was going to marry you, it hurt me… I tried to let go, but I couldn’t. I thought hope was gone… then your… “memory loss” gave me a chance. Lydia’s eyes glisten, emotions breaking through. SEBASTIAN (CONT'D)I know you’ve been hurt… it’s hard to trust love again. But I’ll show you with my actions… please, give me a chance. Let me prove my love. Lydia looks down at the hairpin, a small smile touching her lips. She clenches it gently in her hand, then lifts her gaze to him. LYDIAI thought I’d never believe in love again… but you’ve made my heart beat anew. I'll give it another shot, with you... Sebastian’s tense expression melts into pure joy. He pulls Lydia into a tight embrace. SEBASTIAN(grateful, relieved)Thank you, Lydia. I promise… I won't let you down. I will make you the happiest woman in this world. Lydia hugs him back, smiling, content. The camera pulls back, capturing the couple in a perfect, tender frame of reunited love.

Drive!

Drive!

Over a hundred bugs and sixty hidden cameras - just in the living room.

My wife! From now on, call me

Hello?

text: Get back quick, something’s wrong!

text: Ah! It’s urgent, I’ll explain face- to-face!
speaker: ARTHUR (V.O.)
