4-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM — DAY
Katherine enters her apartment and walks into the dining room, where Arthur is bustling about.
The husband I married sure is pleasing to the eyes. Arthur places dishes on the table, then turns happily to see Katherine.
You’re back! Come, have a seat.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine approaches; Arthur pulls out a chair for her. She sits.
I thought something huge happened, but you just wanted me to eat.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur continues bringing out the rest of the dishes.
Eating is the most important thing!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: He sets a bowl of blood-red soup in front of her.
Try some.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine takes a spoonful and sips.
Good?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine nods.
Delicious.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: From now on, no more dinning out. It’s not safe.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine looks uneasy.
You don’t have to do this. I didn’t marry you to have you cook for me.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: What? You think I’m your pampered little husband?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine hesitates.
If you’re overwhelmed, just tell me.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She pulls out her phone, ready to transfer money.
And if you’re short on money, I’ll send you more.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur presses down gently on her hand, holding it warmly, looking at her seriously.
Seems like you really like sending me money. Katherine’s heart races, her face flushes. She regains composure.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Because other than money, I have nothing.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Funny—I’ve got everything except money.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine freezes, their eyes lock, an odd feeling rising. She pulls back her hand.
Let’s eat!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur watches contentedly as she eats heartily.
CUT TO:
Katherine puts down her knife and fork.
I’m done. Heading back to the office.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She stands and heads for the door; Arthur follows.
Remember! Don’t eat random food outside.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine looks puzzled, glancing back.
Huh?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur pushes her gently toward the door.
Just remember it! Aren’t you running late? Leave!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: 4-3 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, ENTRANCE — DAY

Arthur pushes Katherine’s shoulder; suddenly, he kisses her forehead. Then he closes the door behind her. Katherine’s heart races again, her cheeks flush. Her palm glows faintly, the stirrings of her inner wolf.
So... awakening the inner wolf needs intimate contact?!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She looks back at the door with a sly smile, determined.
That’s easy! I’ll find time to sleep with you!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 5-1 INT. KATHERINE’S OFFICE — DAY
Emily walks into the office.
Ma’am, someone’s here to see you.
speaker: EMILY

text: Katherine keeps her head down, working.
Tell them to wait.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: But it’s your husband.
speaker: EMILY

text: Katherine looks up.
Let him come in.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Emily nods and turns to welcome Arthur inside. Arthur walks in holding a takeout box. Katherine leans back in her chair.
What are you doing here?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur puts the takeout on the desk, glances around, then walks away. Katherine and Emily look at him confused. Arthur walks around the office and quickly finds a bunch of bugs and pinhole cameras hidden. He breathes a sigh of relief. Katherine frowns.
Didn’t we already check? How did so many get missed…? My mistake...
speaker: EMILY

text: They’re in really sneaky spots. You can head out now.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Emily nods and leaves. Katherine looks at Arthur.
You…
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur smiles and opens the takeout box.
I brought you lunch!
speaker: MATHEW

text: For someone so skilled, he’s just here to bring me food?
speaker: KATHERINE (O.S.)

text: Arthur lays out the dishes in front of her one by one. Katherine glances at him, picks up the utensils, but notices a blood-red sauce.
What’s this?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Ketchup!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: You think I’m dumb? I’m a werewolf. That smell? Ketchup?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Alright! It’s blood fern! Katherine’s eyes widen in shock, and the fork drops from her hand.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: You… you treat rare herbs like food?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Every dish here has blood fern. It’s the antidote I prepared for you.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Why would I need an antidote?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Because there’s something wrong with you.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: There’s something wrong with you!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: I’m serious.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Arthur kneels beside her, takes her hand, and kisses the back of it. Katherine is curious and pleased, but suddenly feels a stabbing pain in her heart. Her legs gradually go numb and lose feeling.
What’s happening? I feel like I’m breaking apart...
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur looks at her gently.
Don’t worry, you’ll be fine in ten minutes. Now do you believe that there’s something wrong with you?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: What’s wrong?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Overwork.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine looks at his mischievous expression helplessly.
Just kidding! It’s Vermora. A soul-devouring poison.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: 6-1 INT. KATHERINE'S OFFICE – DAY
Vermora?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur stands and leans against the executive desk.
It's a highly corrosive virus, very hard to detect. It slowly devours your wolf soul. Within a few years, you'll completely lose your wolf power and become an ordinary human... Or even worse.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine lowers her head, distressed.
But you've eaten the food I made for you, drunk the soup and coffee I prepared. You'll recover soon.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine looks up at him, skeptical.
During this time, don't eat anything else. It may interfere with the cure.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: You're really not joking?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Of course not.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Understood.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur looks at her appreciatively.
You are such a great patient. I'm heading home to prepare dinner for you.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: He exits. Katherine watches his back thoughtfully.
How does a human know the werewolf world so well?
speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

text: She presses the intercom.
6-2 INT. KATHERINE'S OFFICE – DAY
Get in touch with the Luna of the MOONMARK family. I want to meet her.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Emily enters.
That discreet healer pack? I’ve heard their Luna has healing powers. Are you feeling unwell?
speaker: EMILY

text: Don’t let anyone know. Come with me.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Emily nods and exits.
Is it really Vermora?
speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

text: 6-3 EXT. MOONMARK FAMILY YARD – DAY
Katherine walks through the courtyard. An elegant Luna, MRS. MOONMARK, in a wheelchair rests in the shade. Katherine approaches.
Mrs. MOONMARK, I need your help. I think I— Mrs. Moonmark raises a hand to stop her.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Don’t move.
speaker: MOONMARK

text: She lifts her palm. A glowing energy flows from her hand and surrounds Katherine. Katherine wobbles and weakens. Emily catches her. Mrs. Moonmark withdraws her hand, her wheelchair turning slightly to face them.
It's Vermora. I sit in this chair because of it. It hides for years and then strikes. Once active, it cuts your link to your inner wolf and causes excruciating pain.
speaker: MRS. MOONMARK

text: Katherine looks horrified.
Even our healer bloodline couldn’t fully cure me. After surviving the soul-pain phase, I lost both my wolf soul and my legs.
speaker: MRS. MOONMARK

text: You mean... I have it too?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Yes. It’s rare but curable. The problem is the antidote’s catalyst is almost impossible to find.
speaker: MRS. MOONMARK

text: Our Heiress is still young. There's no way she’ll become paralyzed or lose her inner wolf!
speaker: EMILY

text: I’ll prescribe some medicine. It won’t cure you but can delay the poison.
speaker: MRS. MOONMARK

text: Katherine nods solemnly.
Thank you, Mrs. Moonmark.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Emily supports Katherine as they leave.
6-4 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, ENTRANCE – DAY
Katherine returns home with a heavy expression.
Even Mrs. Moonmark needed healing power to detect it, but Arthur just knew it with a glance. Who is he really? Inside, a voice calls out.
speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

text: Alpha!
speaker: FLASH (V.O.)

text: 7-1. INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - DAY
Katherine enters. Arthur notices her, quickly kicks Flash away. Flash jumps out the window. Katherine chases forward, panicked.
He jumped?! From the 33rd floor?! Arthur steps in front of her.
Babe! Why are you back? I was about to bring you dinner.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine shoots him a glare and walks toward the bedroom.
We need to talk.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 7-2. INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, BEDROOM - DAY
Arthur follows, confused.
You didn’t test my blood. You don’t have wolf powers. How did you know I was poisoned?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: I... I could tell at a glance! Your skin tone is different from a healthy person’s.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Skin tone?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Yes.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Then can you tell how long I’ve been poisoned?
Well... I need to examine you carefully. It requires... full body contact.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine throws down her bag and, without a word, begins stripping.
So... ruthless?
speaker: ARTHUR (V.O.)

text: Katherine discards her clothes, steps toward Arthur, kicks off her heels, removes her underwear.
Done.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur averts her eyes, paralyzed.
Didn’t you want to examine me? Get started.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: You sure?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: He hesitates. Katherine removes her hair tie and blindfolds him.
Now you can begin.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur stumbles forward in the dark, trips on a heel, and lands on his knees before her, face near her pelvis. Katherine looks down at him.
I haven’t inherited the alpha title yet. No need to kneel.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur springs up.
Do it.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur touches her hair, traces her face, lingers at her lips. Suddenly, he cups the back of her head and kisses her. Katherine pushes him away, startled, touches her lips.
You examine with your mouth?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: No, hands work fine.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Then why— Arthur silences her with a finger.
Shh. The examination begins.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: His hands move from her neck to her shoulders, down to her waist. He crouches, touches her thighs, gives a slight squeeze. Katherine moans involuntarily. Arthur smiles, rises, whispers in her ear.
Don’t hold back. Your husband's here.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine defiantly removes his blindfold. Their eyes lock. She smirks, pushes him down. She straddles him, tosses back her hair, runs her hands over his chest, peels open his shirt. She grips his hand, pins him to the bed, fingers interlocked. Katherine leans down and kisses him.
8-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, BEDROOM - DAY
Katherine kisses Arthur, intensely teasing him— —but Arthur flips her over and pins her to the bed. Katherine leans into his ear.
If it feels good, don’t hold back.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She leans in for another kiss, but Arthur pulls away. Their noses brush.
Once your body’s fully recovered, I’ll make it all up to you.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: He gets up and starts putting on his clothes. Katherine lowers her eyes.
How long have I been poisoned?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Eleven years. Since you were a child.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine is stunned. She sits on the couch, hugging her knees.
You said there’s a cure. How long will it take?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur picks up clothes from the floor.
Hard to say. Well… massage can speed up recovery. But you’d have to be completely unclothed. Interested?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: KATHERINE nods firmly.
Sure.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur drapes a coat over her shoulders.
Then, for treatment convenience, you’ll move in here, starting tomorrow night.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine dresses.
I just remembered—I was kidnapped as a child. I don't know if that has anything to do with it.?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Could be. After all, it's easiest to do it while you're in the middle of a mess.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine brushes back her hair.
I bet it was Joanna. She saw me as a threat since childhood.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Need me to look into it?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: No. I’ll take care of this myself.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She exits decisively. Arthur watches her go, a subtle smirk on his face.
Such a fierce woman—it’s hard not to fall for her.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: 8-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
Katherine is busy at the computer. Arthur brews coffee, pours a cup, and brings it to her.
Here. Try this.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine peers inside, puzzled.
What is this? Tastes strange.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 9-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
Moon Root. It’s good for your body.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: That’s a rare herb.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She takes another careful sip, looking at him.
You said you’re broke. How’d you get it? Even healer families can’t find Moon Root.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Well... My family used to be in the Moon Root business. We don’t have much left, but enough.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Really? I feel like you’re hiding something.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Just drink it. A cup a day to detox.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine nods, drinks more.
Well, thanks anyway.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur takes her hand gently.
No thanks needed between married couples.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine exits. Arthur watches her leave, clutching his chest. Flash jumps in through the window and rushes to him.
Alpha! Are you hurt?
speaker: FLASH

text: I’m fine.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Flash notices the coffee on the table.
You used your own blood and Moon Root to brew this?
speaker: FLASH

text: Go back to Shadow Pack. Bring the rest of the Moon Root. She needs it.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Alpha, if you don’t care about your own health, fine! But there's only one Moon Tree in the world, and its roots can only be harvested once a century. People would only chew a piece when clinging to life, yet you're giving it to her like instant coffee?!
speaker: FLASH

text: She’s my wife. I don’t care.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Then... can I eat the leftover roots?
speaker: FLASH

text: Disgusting. Get out!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: 9-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING AREA - MORNING
Katherine walks out in pajamas, stretching. Arthur places breakfast on the table.
Just in time. Try this oatmeal.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: She takes a bite.
Mmm... delicious! What’s the secret?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Herbal infusion. Very special ingredients.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Another one of those century-old herbs?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: He hesitates. She gently stirs the bowl.
I’m a light sleeper. I overheard you two last night.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She looks at him, serious.
I’ll drink all the Moon Root coffee from now on.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: He exhales quietly, smiling awkwardly. She finishes the oatmeal, clearly enjoying it. He watches her, eyes full of affection.
9-3 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, BEDROOM - NIGHT
Arthur exits the shower, drying his hair, towel around waist.
Babe...
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine stands, slipping off her robe.
Come.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur watches her in awe.
You want to...?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine nods.
For the massage. He’s momentarily disappointed.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Oh... massage.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine smirks. Arthur ties a hairband as a blindfold.
Let’s begin.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Arthur turns after covering his eyes. She rips off the blindfold while Arthur still has his eyes closed.
No blindfold tonight.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 10-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - NIGHT
Arthur pulls Katherine closer, gritting his teeth, his breathing deep.
Babe, I'm a man. If you expect me to massage you while looking at your naked body, I...
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine is caught in his arms, looking up at him. She laughs unconsciously.

Then what do you want? Arthur unwraps his towel and wraps it around Katherine. He picks her up and places her gently on the bed. He opens his eyes. His hand slides under the towel, gently pressing her stomach. He looks at Katherine.
Does it hurt here? Katherine, slightly nervous and blushing, shakes her head.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: No.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur moves his hand upward. Katherine's heartbeat quickens. She inhales deeply. Arthur pauses above her stomach, pressing lightly.
Here?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine shakes her head again
Looks like it’s better now. I need to move higher. Are you ready?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine nods.

Arthur slowly moves his hand. The towel shows the subtle shift of his touch as he moves upward toward her chest. Katherine grows more nervous. Her breathing deepens. She closes her eyes. Arthur lingers around her chest. Katherine lets out a soft moan, her body trembling slightly. Arthur takes a deep breath, then lifts her up to sit on his lap. Katherine’s towel slips. She gasps, her eyes opening to find herself inches from Arthur. Arthur leans in to kiss her. Katherine pushes lightly.
Didn’t you say we’d wait until I recover? Arthur’s eyes are glazed with desire.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: I’m the doctor. I make the call.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: He kisses her fervently. Katherine responds passionately, pushing Arthur down beneath her. They tangle intensely.
CUT TO:

After their lovemaking, the bedroom is a mess—pillows ripped, feathers floating, the bed frame nearly collapsed. Arthur sits up, a feather falling onto his head. He looks around, slightly embarrassed.
Babe...
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine rises slowly, looking at her hands, blood flowing with energy.
I feel the energy coursing through me.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur looks at her with concern.
You don’t have to push yourself so hard. You could rely on me.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine’s gaze sharpens.
No. I’ll earn what’s mine with my own hands.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur looks at her, torn between concern and admiration.
The look when you pursue your goal... I love it. He places a robe over her shoulders. Kathrine grabs his hand and looks up at him.
Arthur, will you ever betray me?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 11-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - DAY
Arthur kneels on one knee, his gaze intense but voice tender.
Babe, if I ever betray you... you have my permission to take my life.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: What?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: I'm not joking.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine processes this, then stands.
I’m going to meet with the Council. You're coming with me. Bring the wheelchair.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Wheelchair? My antidote should've fixed your legs.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: But the poisoner doesn't know yet. Joanna's my prime suspect, but I need proof. They'll slip up when they see me paralyzed.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur nods in sudden understanding. Katherine smirks and exits. Arthur watches her go, grinning as he throws up a thumbs-up.
That's my damn queen!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine flashes a blissful smile over her shoulder.
11-2 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM - DAY
Chaos erupts among the gathered Lexon elders. The doors swing open. Joanna enters in opulent attire, radiating smugness. Cole rises to greet her.
Joanna. You're glowing today. All eyes turn to her.
speaker: COLE

text: We all know Joanna has sacrificed years for this family. She's the true heir to the Lexon legacy!
speaker: COLE

text: Yay, Yay! Joanna's lips curl, basking in the attention.
speaker: ELDERS

text: This council meeting was called for you alone. Joanna's smile turns predatory.
speaker: COLE

text: Enough. Sit.
speaker: JOANNA

text: The elders comply. Joanna scans the room.
Where's Katherine? Uncomfortable silence. Averted gazes. JOANNA(CONT’D) Someone drag her down here! A true Alpha wouldn’t keeps her pack waiting? Nervous whispers. Cole clears his throat.
speaker: JOANNA

text: She's... not at the estate.
speaker: COLE

text: What? This is how she respects the council? She's unfit to lead!
speaker: JOANNA

text: True! Quite right!
speaker: ELDERS

text: Katherine rolls in on her wheelchair.
Then which alpha will rise to rule?
12-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
Katherine enters in her wheelchair, pushed by Arthur. All eyes lock onto them.
So that’s why you’re late... Did your legs forget how to work?
speaker: JOANNA

text: Cole and Joanna’s loyalists barely contain their smirks.
The Lexon heir in a wheelchair? Now that’s a headline.
How’d you know it was paralysis?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Could’ve been any injury. Who’s your source?
I overestimated her. Couldn’t even wait to expose herself.
speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

text: An Alpha who can’t protect her pack is no Alpha at all!
Seriously? She can’t even awaken her inner wolf, and now she’s paralyzed? There’s no way she’s fit to be Alpha!
speaker: ELDERS

text: At least my legs are the only thing not working - can't say the same for someone’ brain.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Her gaze flicks to Joanna, who slams the table.
This is the Council, not a playground for your games. You failed to marry by the deadline. That 10% territory? It goes to a vote—today.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Sign the transfer. Or we’ll enforce the rule.
speaker: COLE

text: Cole tosses a contract and pen onto Katherine’s lap.
As your father… I insist.
speaker: COLE

text: Cole grabs Katherine’s wrist to force the signature—
This is for the pack. —Arthur intercepts, crushing Cole’s hand in his grip. Bones creak. COLE(CONT’D) Ah—!
speaker: COLE

text: 13-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
Try it. See what happens.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Joanna glares, her composure cracking.
Katherine! Who let this outsider in here? Call off your dog—
speaker: JOANNA

text: Katherine flicks a glance at Arthur. He releases Cole with a shove. Cole stumbles back, face purple with rage—
You little brat- —Arthur casually claps his hands together, releasing a cloud of white powder.
speaker: COLE

text: Ugh. Filthy.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Cole wheezes, coughing violently.
What the hell?!
speaker: COLE

text: He’s your father, Katherine! By refusing to sign, are you daring to challenge the Pack's sacred laws?!
speaker: JOANNA

text: I wasn’t done speaking. Allow me to introduce—
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She pauses, savoring the moment.
—my husband. Arthur Lexon. Owner of the 10% territory. Arthur’s eyes widen. The word "husband" hits him like a physical blow—pride and warmth flooding his chest.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: The council erupt in shocked murmurs. Katherine tosses a contract onto the table.
Transfer’s signed. Any objections?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Joanna shoves Cole, who’s still red-faced from coughing.
You—cough—can’t just marry anyone!
speaker: COLE

text: The Alpha bloodline—
Oh? So now the council need to approve who I fuck? Dead silence. The council shift uncomfortably.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: I know Lexon’s old-fashioned, but policing the Alpha’s bedroom? Even for you, Joanna… that’s desperate. JOANNA’s nails dig into her palms, trembling with fury.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Wow. She went there.
speaker: ARTHUR (V.O.)

text: No challenges? Good. Then we address the wolf who dares bare fangs at her own Alpha — Joanna!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 14-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
Katherine’s gaze sharpens like a blade, locking onto Joanna.
A home wrecker who stole 30% of Lexon territory - that old debt is finally coming due.
Stolen?! Your father gifted it to me! For over a decade I've held 30% these lands - second only to the Alpha himself. How dare you...
speaker: JOANNA

text: Right. Now My husband and I hold the most lands now. And as Lexon’s new leader… …you’re shrieking at your Alpha. Joanna’s composure snaps.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: A crippled Alpha? The face of our clan? Wait till the press sees you wheeling onto that stage!
She’s right! And you—cough—can’t awaken your inner wolf! A human consort? You’re weak!
speaker: COLE

text: Step down. Now. The Lexon won’t bow to a crippled Alhpa.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Cole lurches up, finger jabbing—
You’ll cough—you’ll surrender— —Suddenly, foam bubbles from his lips. He collapses, convulsing.
speaker: COLE

text: Katherine side-eyes Arthur, who innocently wipes white powder off his hands. Chaos erupts. Elders back away, murmuring in terror.
Is Katherine truly the Moon-Chosen Alpha of the Lexon?
speaker: ELDER 1

text: Her own father dared to defy her- and now the Moon's justice is served!
Joanna may rule well, but she’s no Lexon... The room sways. Then—
We stand with Katherine Lexon!
speaker: ELDERS

text: You'd truly bow to a crippled Alpha? While rival houses sharpen their fangs, what can this broken thing do? Choose wisely!
speaker: JOANNA

text: "Cripple"? Oh Joanna… Who’s your informant?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She whips the blanket off her legs—and crosses them with a queen’s grace. Joanna stands up in shock.
15-1 LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
Joanna’s face twists with rage, her perfect facade shattered.
You bitch! You played me!
speaker: JOANNA

text: And you fell for it.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Joanna lunges, hand raised to strike—
I’ll end you—! —Katherine catches her wrist mid-air then slaps her hard across the face.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Strike your Alpha? Brave.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Joanna stumbles back, clutching her cheek, eyes wild.
You dare?! You ungrateful little—
speaker: JOANNA

text: She leaps again—only for Arthur to intercept, lifting her off her feet like a rag doll.
Your knuckles are too pretty for trash. Let me handle the dirty work.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine gives his hand a cold glance, unmoved. Lucas freezes awkwardly, looks at Cole. Cole chuckles nervously and gestures to the seats.
Well. Shall we sit?
speaker: COLE

text: Lucas returns to his seat, crossing his legs. Katherine places her bag down, subtly adjusting its position, then sits.
Mr. Reid? So you currently hold 5% of the LEXON lands?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: That’s right!
speaker: LUCAS

text: With 5%, Mr. Reid, you'd qualify to be a council member. May I ask... how you acquired such substantial holdings?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Lucas shifts uncomfortably, lowers his leg.
That’s... a bit nosy, don’t you think? If you’re not buying, someone else will!
speaker: LUCAS

text: He rises, pretending to storm off. Cole quickly pulls him back down.
Let’s eat first, Mr. Reid. We can talk later.
speaker: COLE

text: He gestures to the wineglass in front of Katherine.
Katherine, Mr. Reid brought some fine wine. Give it a try. KAtherine eyes the strong drink.
speaker: COLE

text: Heard our new Alpha is bold and sharp. As the saying goes- a deal is a deal. We can still be friends.
speaker: LUCAS

text: He raises his glass, toasts her, and downs it.
Since Mr. Reid’s so sincere, I’d be rude not to drink.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She smiles faintly, lifts her glass, and drinks. Lucas claps joyfully.
Brilliant! The Alpha doesn’t disappoint!
speaker: LUCAS

text: Katherine dabs her mouth with the napkin and sets it down.
So, how much are you asking for your 5% territory?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Lucas smirks, silent. Suddenly, Katherine’s vision spins. Her eyes blur. She shuts them, pinches her thigh hard.
That territory... Depends if you live long enough to claim it.
speaker: LUCAS

text: 42-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, DINING ROOM – DAY
Katherine is barely holding herself up.
You poisoned me?!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Cole rises.
Katherine, don’t blame me. You’ve never listened.
speaker: COLE

text: Katherine clutches her head, shaking it, trying to stay conscious.
My old man spoiled you, made you the Alpha.
speaker: COLE

text: Her face goes pale.
I’m his son—your father! I should’ve been Alpha!
speaker: COLE

text: She stumbles up, turns to flee—but collapses.
42-2 INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – DAY
Katherine lies unconscious, face pale. JOANNA stands nearby, arms crossed, sneering.
If I'd known Vermora could tame you this easy, I wouldn't have wasted all the efforts!
speaker: JOANNA

text: She laughs scornfully.
Who’d think the mighty Alpha still craved... fatherly love? JOANNA(CONT’D) I’ve won, Katherine. Lexon is mine!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Cole enters, nervous, eyes darting to Katherine.
Joanna—you promised me. She’s just paralyzed, not dead, right?
speaker: COLE

text: Does it matter anymore?
speaker: JOANNA

text: She’s still my blood, the only legitimate Lexon heir!
speaker: COLE

text: Joanna pokes his chest.
Spare me the “fatherly concern”! You were first to agree to drug her.
speaker: JOANNA

text: I only wanted to secure our control—not kill her!
speaker: COLE

text: Not my problem. You lured her here. You’re the last person she saw.
speaker: JOANNA

text: What?
speaker: COLE

text: Lexon isn’t ours, darling. It’s mine. You don’t even own a square foot.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Cole stumbles back in disbelief.
Joanna, you—
speaker: COLE

text: Joanna bursts out laughing and storms off.
43-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, HALLWAY – DAY
Joanna struts confidently, on the phone.
Publicly announce that Katherine's health has failed. Out of respect, I'll shoulder her burdens and take control of all Lexon family affairs.
speaker: JOANNA

text: 43-2 INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – NIGHT
The room is dark. Katherine stirs awake, groaning in pain. Suddenly, she notices a man beside her. She grabs a pillow and hurls it at him.
Who are you?! What are you doing in my bed?!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur bolts up, catches the pillow, gently covers her mouth.
Babe. It’s me. Shh... There are guards outside.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine recognizes him.
Arthur?! Scare me like that again and you're banned from the bedroom!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur kneels, dramatically bowing on the bed.
My Queen! You’ve been unconscious for three days! I thought I lost you!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Three days?!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 43-2A INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – NIGHT
Didn’t I spit most of it out? Just that tiny bit left in my mouth was enough to knock me out for three days?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur rolls a table over with food.

That little bit was enough to activate all the remaining toxins in your system. I’ve been here every day since, watching over you, giving you the antidote. And now... Good news: Vermora is completely purged!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Really? A blessing in disguise!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: He holds her hand.
Your inner wolf is fully awaken now. No one will ever dare use that against you again.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: She touches his face.
Wolf or not—I have you. That’s what matters.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur gazes at her.
I’ll make you a true wolf. A perfect and powerful Alpha Queen.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: How does one become a true wolf… with a human?
speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

text: She smiles, picks up her fork.
What’s the matter outside?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 43-3 INT. LEXON MANSION, DINING ROOM – DAY
Katherine discreetly spits the liquor into her napkin, feigning a casual wipe.
44-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
The room is packed. Joanna enters with proud.
Esteemed guests, reporters, members of Lexon — thank you for coming. Please, be seated. Reporters click away. Joanna basks in attention.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Twenty years... I’ve rightfully claimed this seat!
speaker: JOANNA (V.O.)

text: Joanna, are your previous involvement in money laundering and the kidnapping of Alpha connected to your alleged attempt to seize power through malicious means?? JOANNA lifts her chin, arms crossed, a look of disdain on her face.
speaker: REPORTER A

text: Of course not. Katherine fabricated those accusations. If I was guilty, then why would the Bureau have cleared me of all charges so quickly?
speaker: JOANNA

text: Was Katherine’s illness your doing?
speaker: REPORTER B

text: Joanna sighs, feigning sorrow.
Katherine has been ill since eleven years ago. She’s been actively seeking treatment recently, and here is her medical report. She distributes papers. Whispers ripple through the crowd.
Paralyzed... It’s true. She’s been sick for a while...
speaker: CROWD A

text: As the largest landholder, are you now Lexon’s new Alpha?
speaker: REPORTER C

text: Yes. I brought you all here today to reassure you.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Katherine is fighting for her life. As her family, I grieve.
From this moment on, I, Joanna Lexon, assume full authority as the Lexon Alpha! Mixed reactions—some applaud, others reluctantly follow.
speaker: JOANNA

text: 45-1 INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – NIGHT
Frost hands Katherine a coffee. She sips it lazily.
Ma’am, as you instructed, we’ve created the illusion. Everyone thinks your days are numbered.
speaker: FROST

text: Katherine runs her fingers along the rim of the cup, deep in thought.
Good. Now Joanna thinks she’s won. Whoever’s behind her should act soon.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: You think she’ll reach out to them?
speaker: FROST

text: Katherine nods.
Time to bait the serpent. Frost, watch her. Every call, every move.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Understood.
speaker: FROST

text: Frost bolts for the window.
Wait—that’s a window—
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Katherine is stunned. She lets out a sigh and leans back against the headboard.
These people… Who are they?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 45-2 EXT. REID HOUSE – DAY
Joanna clutches a file, scans her surroundings, hurries inside. Frost watches from above.
Lady Alpha, she’s inside. I’m sending the address.
speaker: FROST

text: 45-3 INT. REID HOUSE – DAY
Lucas sits at the head, one eye bandaged. Two masked guards stand behind him. Joanna kneels, offering the folder.
Mr. Reid... here it is. The Lexon family... is mine now.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Lucas lifts his chin slightly. The bodyguard behind him immediately steps forward and hands him the file. Joanna trembles uncontrollably, nervous and afraid. Lucas flips through the file, then calmly closes it and looks coldly at Joanna.
Is Katherine... dead?
speaker: LUCAS

text: 46-1 INT. REID HOUSE – DAY
Joanna cautiously approaches Lucas.
Almost there! She’s in a deep coma now. I’ve got my people watching over her.
speaker: JOANNA

text: You sure she won’t wake up?
speaker: LUCAS

text: I’m sure! Mr. Reid, I’ve done everything. Can I have the antidote now?
speaker: JOANNA

text: You will have it when the Lexon family is completely destroyed.
speaker: LUCAS

text: Joanna exhales and nods. Lucas pulls out a small pill.
This pill will keep your Vermora from flaring up for a whole year.
speaker: LUCAS

text: Joanna nods eagerly. Lucas disdainfully tosses the pill on the ground. Joanna crawls forward quickly, picking it up with both hands.
Thank you, Mr. Reid! Thank you!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Who are you? This is Reid territory! No entry!
speaker: MASKED BODYGUARD (O.S.)

text: Get lost.
speaker: KATHERINE (O.S.)

text: Lucas hears noises outside. His expression freezes. Joanna turns pale, looking back— Katherine enters, dressed all in black, radiating power. Several SHADOW GUARDS follow her. Joanna collapses to the floor, eyes wide with disbelief.
Katherine?! That can’t be!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Katherine raises an eyebrow and smiles lightly.
Ms. Hardy, what a coincidence.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 47-1 INT. REID MANSION – DAY
Joanna looks back at Lucas, terrified; her voice trembling and hoarse.
Mr. Reid, this can’t be. I’ve poisoned her! You saw her drink the wine and fall unconscious!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Lucas slowly stands and approaches JOANNA. He slaps her hard. Katherine looks at Lucas, fearless and determined.
It’s you?! We meet again. This time, you’re nothing like before.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Katherine walks in and sees Lucas dressed like a businessman.
Lucas sizes her up, then coldly approaches.
You weren’t dead nor poisoned. You kept up that whole act just to meet me here
speaker: LUCAS

text: Joanna’s just a pawn. Of course I want to meet the player?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Lucas smirks coldly, ominous.
You are a Reid. Lexon and Reid have no feud. What are you after?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Lucas laughs loudly.
So merciless, and so precise. Quite unlike your mother, I must say.
speaker: LUCAS

text: Katherine is shocked.
You know my mother?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: You’ll find out soon enough. We’ll meet again.
speaker: LUCAS

text: Lucas smirks, then gestures. Masked Bodyguards swarm forward. Shadow Guards defend Katherine. A fierce fight breaks out. Joanna screams hysterically.
Mr. Reid! Mr. Reid! You have to believe me— Among the crowd, Katherine looks up to Lucas standing above.
speaker: JOANNA

text: Lucas overlooks the battlefield. Katherine tries to pursue but is blocked. Frost blocks a punch from a Masked Bodyguard and pushes him away. Katherine looks up again. Lucas smirks mockingly and walks away.
48-1 INT. REID MANSION - DAY
The battle dies down quickly. Lucas’s bodyguards and Joanna lie defeated on the ground.
Ma'am, My fault. They got away through the underground tunnel.
speaker: FROST

text: Katherine stares at the place where Lucas vanished.
It’s not your fault. They were prepared. This was just a temporary base for them.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Yes, ma’am. what about...her?
speaker: FROST

text: Frost points at Joanna. She’s collapsed on the floor, dazed and disoriented.
It’s over... It’s all over...
speaker: JOANNA

text: Looks like they’ve abandoned you.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Joanna lifts her head and glares at Katherine, trembling as she gets to her feet.
Even if I'm abandoned, you'll never lay hands on me! You've got no proof!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Of course I do.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Katherine takes a pinhole camera out of her bag.
I’ve had this camera on me since I entered the mansion. Everything you and Cole did to me. It’s all recorded. Joanna, this time, you’re not getting away.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Joanna stumbles backward in shock.
You... You were planning this since the moment I answered your call?!
speaker: JOANNA

text: That’s right. I respected your ambition, but in the end, you’re just someone’s lapdog.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: You think I wanted this? It was
speaker: JOANNA

text: Lucas Reid!
I was just an orphan—until Lucas took me in. He used Vermora to turn me into his puppet!
speaker: JOANNA

text: So all these years...
speaker: KATHERINE

text: It was Lucas’s plan? Even marrying my father?
Why else? You think I’d stoop for your pathetic father? Lucas’s real plan was always to wipe out the entire Lexon bloodline! Hahahahahahaha!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Katherine grabs Joanna by the throat, trembling in disbelief.
So it was you who killed my mother?! Why? Why would you do that?!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Joanna clutches her throat, gasping for air, her face turning red.
Your mother was killed… by Cole Lexon!
speaker: JOANNA

text: 49-1 INT. REID MANSION – DAY
Katherine is in complete shock. Her grip loosens. Joanna catches her breath and continues.
He forced your mother to sign divorce papers while she was giving birth.
She died on the delivery table, furious and heartbroken! Katherine reels from the revelation. Joanna seizes the moment and breaks free, collapsing on the ground with a mocking laugh.
You thought Cole was just some weak fool, but he’s too stupid to be harmless!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Katherine turns away, overcome with grief.
Lock her up.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Frost and the shadow guards seize Joanna. As they drag her away, she screams after Katherine, her voice shrill and taunting.
Katherine! Your mother wasn’t a Hedrin. She was a Reid! A REID!
speaker: JOANNA

text: Katherine closes her eyes. A single tear escapes. She keeps walking forward, resolute.
49-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT – NIGHT
Katherine stares blankly out the window. Arthur walks over and wraps his arms around her.
Frost said you met someone from the Reid family? Katherine nods slowly, curling up in his embrace. Arthur pulls out a small bugging device from his coat pocket.
We found this bug in your office. It's from the Reid family—a bloodline of poisoners. Once feared, now fading with the modern world’s rejection of toxins.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: The one behind Joanna... is Lucas Reid. Alpha of the Reid family.

Here’s something else I uncovered: Lucas’s beloved daughter, Leah Reid, has always been indifferent to the family’s dirty business. She chose to escape to the countryside to teach children, and eventually broke away from the family for the sake of a man.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: She was my mother. She changed her name to Leah Hedrin. Lucas Reid... is my grandfather. Arthur exhales, holding Katherine tighter, sympathy on his face.

Lucas Reid... Call him ruthless, yet he dotes on his daughter like she’s his whole world. Call him loving, yet he doesn’t even spare his own granddaughter. What a stubborn, twisted old man! Katherine chuckles through her pain, then looks him in the eyes.
Grandpa used to say I’m bold and ruthless when I need to be—a born Alpha. That’s something the Lexons don’t have. No clue who I inherited it from, until I met Lucas.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: You’re nothing like him. This is his fault, not you.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine smiles faintly but her eyes well with tears.
I just feel sorry for my mother.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: She was under Lucas’s control in her youth and died heartbroken because of a scumbag. Yet, as her own daughter, I never really knew who she was. Arthur gently takes her hand.
I'm sure she was truly happy when she chose your father; unfortunately, she made the wrong choice.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine studies his face carefully.
Then what about me? Did I make a right choice?
50-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT LIVING ROOM – NIGHT
Arthur immediately raises his hand, swearing.
Babe! I swear to you! Going back three generations in my family, there’s absolutely no history of scumbags!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine is surprised, watching as ARTHUR counts on his fingers.
My dad, my grandpa, my great- grandpa... all loyal and loving! We’ve got good genes!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: You’re pledging loyalty now? That’s kinda suspicious.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Honestly, I’m... I’m just worried you’re mad at your jerk dad and taking it out on me.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine can’t help but smile, watching Arthur pound his chest confidently.
I’m legit!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: So far, so good.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: I’ll show with every action that your taste in men is just as spot- on as your business sense.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine is touched. Arthur glances sideways, then leans in close to Katherine, getting all sweet.
But... on a serious note, babe, when are we gonna make up for our honeymoon?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Hmm... maybe you find a place?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur grabs Katherine’s hand excitedly.
Let’s go skiing!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Skiing?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur looks up, starts imagining, moving his hands like drawing.
There’s this hotel up in the mountains. Panoramic window for us to... Katherine’s expression suddenly changes. She quickly raises her hand to stop him.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Thank you, but no thanks.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur straightens up.
What I’m talking about the view!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: You go ski then! I’m gonna take a shower.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur suddenly stands up and blocks her way.
Then we shower together!
Maybe a little massage too. Arthur scoops Katherine up in a princess carry. Katherine wraps her arms around his neck, surprised.
Vermora’s gone! No more massages needed!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Perfect, then let’s make this a relaxation massage.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: 51-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM – DAY

Morning light fills the room. Katherine and Arthur sit around the table in their pajamas. Arthur feeds Katherine a piece of dragon fruit. She eats it, and their eyes meet with warmth. Suddenly, Katherine clutches her chest in pain, groaning. Her eyes flash red.
Babe!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: I feel... this energy rising inside me. It’s getting stronger.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Babe, that’s your inner wolf growing. You need to learn to control it.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Inner wolf? Wait, are you trying to say I cheated? I didn’t!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: No... Babe, you’ve got it all wrong!
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine moves away, glaring fiercely.
What? A mere human could never awaken such a powerful inner wolf for me! Spit it out. What’s your real purpose? You sly bastard slithered your way into my trust... for what?!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: I swear, babe, I’m not human — I’m...
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Suddenly, Katherine’s phone rings. The screen shows “EMILY.” She quickly answers.
Ma’am, something big just happened!
speaker: EMILY (V.O.)

text: 51-1A INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM – DAY
location: A INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM

text: It’s Joanna. She transferred all her shares. We got played.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur frowns.
51-1B INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM – DAY
location: B INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM

text: Where’s the press conference?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 51-1C INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM – DAY
location: C INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM

text: Got it. Get ready. I’m heading there now.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Katherine hangs up. Arthur looks tense.
Lucas showed up? Katherine nods, worried.
He swept up every external territory overnight. With the 30% Joanna transferred to him, he now controls about 45%—more than I do.
He’s closing in.
Don’t worry. I’ll go with you, and you’ll finally see how strong your inner wolf truly is.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Katherine looks up sharply, touched, and nods.
51-2 INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
Crowds surge inside the mansion. Emily squeezes into a corner, urgently reporting.
Lucas Reid just publicly declared he holds the largest share of LEXON territory, and that he’s assuming leadership of the family!
How in Moon’s name did he get that much lands?!
51-2A INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
What do we do now? The other families are flooding in, the council has been summoned, and
speaker: EMILY

text: Lucas even brought reporters. The press conference is about to begin!
51-2B INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
At the Lexon mansion.
speaker: EMILY

text: 52-1 INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
Masked bodyguards under Lucas's command hold the Lexon council hostage. Lucas paces coldly in front of them.
Well? Have you made up your minds? Which one of you is willing to spare me 3% of your land. voluntarily, of course.
speaker: LUCAS

text: The Council members tremble, silent and terrified. Lucas toys with a small pill in his hand.
So be it. Is territory truly worth dying for?
speaker: LUCAS

text: Mr. Reid, is poisoning the only way you know how to negotiate?
speaker: KATHERINE (O.S.)

text: The crowd parts. Katherine strides forward with commanding presence, Arthur following behind. Lucas eyes her with amusement.
What did I say? We’d be seeing each other again, "Alpha." Oh, but not for much longer.
speaker: LUCAS

text: So what should I call you now? Mr. Reid or... Grandpa?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: The crowd gasps in shock. Lucas’s expression freezes. He scoffs coldly.
No! I had no such rebellious daughter — and certainly no patricidal granddaughter like you!
speaker: LUCAS

text: Don’t you see? You were one of the people who killed my mother. If you hadn’t forced her to inherit the family, she would never have ended up in that village, never met my scumbag father, and never cut ties with you - only to die at his hands!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Lucas reels from the accusation, visibly shaken.
You’re lying!She was my daughter — I raised her like a precious jewel. I would never have hurt her! From the crowd, Cole slowly steps forward, shaken and confused.
speaker: LUCAS

text: What... what are you talking about? Your mother, Leah Hedrin... wasn’t she just some peasant woman?
speaker: COLE

text: Cole lifts his trembling finger toward Lucas, turning to Katherine in disbelief.
Katherine, did you just say... he’s...
speaker: COLE

text: He’s Leah’s father. Alpha of the Reid family. Am I wrong, Grandpa?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: 53-1 INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
Lucas is fully ignited.
Everyone of the LEXON family deserves to die!
You're really Leah’s father? Leah’s a Reid? That can’t be true...
speaker: COLE

text: Katherine sighs softly.
You... you came to avenge Leah?!
speaker: COLE

text: Congratulations. You’ve finally figured it out. Cole's legs begin to tremble in fear.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: So you're Leah’s father... Then I guess that makes you my father-in- law.. Leah... She die during labor. We didn’t mean for it to happen! Lucas's face darkens, eyes blazing.
speaker: COLE

text: You can’t blame the entire Lexon family for that!
speaker: COLE

text: Lucas completely loses it — he flips a table and storms forward, viciously kicking Cole in the chest. Cole crashes to the ground from the brutal impact.
Screw that! I’m nobody’s father-in- law!
speaker: LUCAS

text: Cole struggles to get up, but the masked bodyguards restrain him, forcing him to his knees.
You loved your daughter so much... Why did you let her end up in some remote village?
speaker: COLE

text: I didn’t want that either! Leah ran off in the night to chase her dream of becoming a teacher. I thought, once she’d suffered enough out there, she’d come back on her own.
speaker: LUCAS

text: What I never expected was that, within just a few months, she’d meet you! Leah never once argued with me in her entire life—except twice, and both times were because of you! She even cut ties with me just to marry you!
speaker: LUCAS

text: That... that was her own choice! Lucas, enraged again, drives another vicious kick into Cole’s chest.
speaker: COLE

text: Cole collapses to the floor, coughing up blood, unable to rise. Katherine watches coldly. Arthur protectively steps in front of her. The masked bodyguards lift Cole up again, forcing him to kneel.
Who do you think you are? I sent
speaker: LUCAS

text: Joanna to seduce you, to show Leah what a filthy soul you really have! And yet... Leah remains stubbornly blind.
You wanted her to come back obediently, but you killed her instead. Why not go after the real culprit? Why lie in wait for years, plotting against the Lexon family?
speaker: KATHERINE

text: SCENE 54-1 INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
Lucas furiously points at Katherine.
You’re the one who killed my daughter!
speaker: LUCAS

text: Katherine freezes in shock.
If it weren’t for giving birth to you, a bastard, my daughter wouldn’t have died.
speaker: LUCAS

text: Looks like Joanna didn’t tell you everything.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: What do you mean?
speaker: LUCAS

text: My mother didn’t die giving birth to me. She died in the delivery room because of Cole.
speaker: KATHERINE

text: What?!
speaker: LUCAS

text: Cole panics and shakes his head in denial. Katherine turns to Lucas, eyes sharp.

Joanna was just a tool, a weapon. She only took the side to push Cole to divorce my mother. But it was Cole who turned murderous. You, however, are the merciless mastermind! Lucas, in disbelief, points at Cole, spiraling into rage.
Lies! You killed my daughter! If it weren’t for you, I’d never have done what I did!
speaker: LUCAS

text: Lucas signals to the masked guards, yelling with madness.
Beat him to death!
speaker: LUCAS

text: The bodyguards pounce. Cole screams in agony. Blood splatters. The crowd recoils in horror.
Enough!
speaker: KATHERINE

text: Arthur notices Katherine’s pain. He gently steps forward.
Get him out of here. He’s disgusting.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: The bodyguards drag the nearly unconscious Cole away.
Mr. Reid, you didn’t come all this way just to throw punches, did you?
speaker: ARTHUR

text: And who the hell are you? You think you have the right to speak here?
speaker: LUCAS

text: 55-1 INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
Arthur straightens his back with a calm pride.
Well, my birth name was Arthur Frostnight. Now, it's Arthur Lexon. Laughter ripples through the crowd.
speaker: ARTHUR

text: Frostnight? Don’t make me laugh. Since when does a live-in son-in- law belong to the ancient and mighty Frostnight clan?
speaker: LUCAS

text: Katherine glances over thoughtfully.

Wedding day. It’s a beautifully decorated, fancy affair. Grandma, Butler, Vincent all present amongst other guests. Casey and Nicholas face each other and deliver their vows. NICHOLAS(serious, with warmth)I, Nicholas Johnson, take you, Casey Cooper, to be my lawfully *wedded wife. I vow to love, honor, and cherish you for the rest of my life. Casey smiles, her eyes sparkling. CASEY(playful, yet heartfelt)And I, Casey Cooper, take you, *Nicholas Johnson, to be my lawfully *wedded husband. I promise to support you, to stand by your side through everything. NICHOLASI vow to never hide anything from you ever again. CASEYAnd I vow to always let you finish your sentences, regardless of interruptions.

NICHOLASI promise to tell you if anything I buy for you is ever a knockoff. * Grandma gives a warm smile. As long as you don’t ditch me to change. Vincent laughs heartily at their banter. * CASEY(CONT’D)For what it’s worth, I can’t *believe I found you, Nicholas Johnson. NICHOLASI fell right into your lap. It wasn’t that hard. Nicholas gazes into Casey’s eyes. She stares back, lovingly. *Guests toss flower petals at them. Nicholas and Casey share a *romantic kiss. *
