INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY1 1

Arabella walks into the hall in a beautiful dress. Many guests there. Everyone smiles and salutes Arabella. GUESTSHappy birthday, my Luna! Arabella salutes them back. She walks to the stage in the hall - the stage curtain is behind her. Everyone is watching her. ARABELLAThank you all for coming to my birthday party... JESSICAAh, yes! Yes, baby! There is a sound of a woman MOANING interrupting Arabella's words. The guests falls silent and look at each other in shock, whispering. Arabella looks confused. She listens carefully and determines the sound is coming from behind the curtain. Arabella pulls the curtain open. JESSICA and DEREK, back naked, are having sex on a table - Jessica on top - under several tablecloths. When the curtain opens, they turn the heads in shock and immediately stop moving. The guests look at Arabella sympathetically. Arabella’s face shows the emotions of anger, shock, and humiliation. ARABELLAWhat the hell, Derek? How could you betray me? Even here, on my birthday, in front of everyone! Jessica gets off the table and walks to Arabella - a tablecloth is wrapped around her. JESSICAHappy birthday! Like this gift? By the way, you are not Luna anymore. Only I’m worthy of being Luna! Arabella looks at her in disbelief... then notices the necklace around Jessica’s neck.

ARABELLAThat's my necklace! Give it back! Arabella tries to take the necklace. But Derek - his waist wrapped in a tablecloth - grabs her hand stopping her, and looks at her coldly. DEREKStay away from her, Arabella. It’s your honor that Jessica wants your necklace. Show her some respect! She’s going to be your new Luna! ARABELLAHer? What about me? I should be your Luna. We’re mates chosen by the moon goddess. Derek releases Arabella's hand, pushes her away. DEREKStop talking about the moon goddess! She shouldn’t have chosen you, a weak wolfless rouge, as my mate. Jessica is a powerful gamma. You’ll never be better than her. Arabella tries to hold Derek’s hand. ARABELLABut we've been married for 3 years. DEREKIf you could shut up like a doll, maybe I would’ve considered letting you stay with me... as my slave. Now get out! Arabella cries as she runs through the crowd and out the door. Derek addresses the guests. DEREK(cont'd)It's okay, go on and enjoy the party, everyone.
EXT. FOREST - DAY2 2
Arabella runs in the forest, tears streaming down her face. ARABELLAThis is my birthday! How could they do this to me?

Suddenly a ROGUE WOLF appears and stops her. She is frightened and SCREAMS. ROGUE WOLFWhere are you going, beauty? Why don’t you go out with me? Arabella starts walking backward in fear. ARABELLAStay away from me! Rogue Wolf walks toward her, getting closer with each step. His expression becoming more and more evil. ROGUE WOLFYou have nowhere to hide. ARABELLAHelp! Suddenly there is a wolf runs towards the Rogue Wolf when the Rogue Wolf stretches out his hand to Arabella. A young and handsome guy appears and catches the rogue's hand and he knocks the Rogue Wolf down with a few punches. It’s EDWIN. Arabella looks at Edwin's handsome figure. The warm light shining from his side makes him look like a god descending from heaven. Edwin walks to Arabella and takes Arabella in his arms. He shows Arabella his charming smile - her face is radiating like the sun. EDWINYou OK?
EXT. FOREST - DAY3 3

Edwin is stilling holding Arabella. Arabella stares at his face then suddenly comes to her senses. ARABELLAI'm fine. Thank you, sir. Can you let me go now? Edwin gently puts her down on a big rock(or a park bench). EDWINNo offense, my apologies. Arabella, right? Happy birthday!

ARABELLADo you know me? Edwin shows her an emblem on his suit. EDWINI am Alpha Edwin, your father, Alpha Jackson's, adopted son. I am currently managing the Silver Moon pack on behalf of him. Arabella is surprised when she sees the emblem. ARABELLAI remember you now! So you are my brother? EDWINTechnically, yes. And I came here to take you home. Father finally agreed to let you go home to inherit Silver Moon pack. You won’t have to hide your identity anymore. Edwin notices that Arabella’s shoe fell off in the attack. ARABELLAI’ve been away for three years. That’s long enough. Edwin takes the shoes and gets down on one knee and puts it on her gently. EDWINYes, you have noble Alpha blood after all. Only you can lead a pack as powerful as the Silver Moon pack. Arabella can’t help looking at Edwin. Their eyes meet and then Arabella comes back to her senses. ARABELLATell my father I will be back. But first I need to go back to the Red Howl pack. EDWINUnderstood. Arabella stands and arranges her clothes.

ARABELLAThere's one last thing I need to finish, and that is to end it with Derek once and for all. As Arabella departs, Edwin's cell phone RINGS. He answers the call seriously. EDWINMax. Tell them I can't return yet to take over the Alpha King position. You must conceal my identity as the Alpha King successor.
INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY4 4

As soon as Arabella walks in, The guests' sympathetic eyes are focusing on her. Derek is now dressed and comes over, throwing a file at her. DEREKSign it! Arabella picks up the document which says Divorce Agreement.
INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY5 5

Arabella is holding the divorce agreement, then tosses it aside. ARABELLAFine! But we were married for three years. You at least own me an explanation... in front of everyone. Derek stares at Arabella with a cold expression. DEREKI told you. You don’t deserve to be in my pack, let alone be my mate or my Luna! At this time, a passage opens up in the crowd. Derek's mother LAURA and a dressed Jessica walk out. Laura looks at Arabella with disdain. LAURAThat's right. You have lowly blood, have no family and are very weak!

You are not worthy of being the Luna of the Red Howl pack. You should know your place! Upset, Arabella's voice trembles when she speaks. ARABELLAMom? You're on their side? That means you condone his cheating... Derek lets out a mocking LAUGH. He pulls Jessica into his arms. DEREKStop blaming everyone else. All of this is happening because of you. If you were half as interesting as Jessica is, I wouldn’t have strayed. Arabella looks at Derek and Jessica, almost burning with anger. Jessica walks over and whispers in Arabella's ear. JESSICAHow’s that feel, huh? Catching your husband cheating with a pregnant woman in front of everyone — pretty wild, right? ARABELLAWhat?! You're pregnant! Arabella looks Jessica’s belly in shock. Jessica pretends to fall and pulls Arabella down with her. There is a cry of fright from the crowd. Arabella hits the ground hard. Derek hurries to help Jessica up. JESSICAOw! She hurt me! DEREKAre you insane, Arabella? How could you do this to Jessica, especially when she's pregnant!? Arabella stands up, her face is pale. ARABELLADerek, I was so wrong about you. LAURAShut up and sign the divorce agreement right now! Otherwise I’ll make you suffer even more.

Arabella picks up the divorce papers and sneers. ARABELLAVery well, I've had enough of this! Arabella signs her name elegantly and throws it back to Derek. Arabella's pupils flash with silver light, and a shining werewolf family emblem appears in them. ARABELLA(cont'd)But remember this, Derek. I, Arabella Wellington, reject you, Derek Evans, as my mate. DEREKHow dare you do this to your Alpha? ARABELLAYou are not my Alpha, not anymore. Arabella turns to leave when Derek suddenly stops her. DEREKYou can't leave yet. Arabella turns and looks at Derek in anger. ARABELLAWhat else do you want from me? Derek looks at Arabella from head to toe and points at her. DEREKYou can't leave until you give back what's mine.
INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY6 6

Arabella looks at them very angrily. Arabella takes off her earrings and necklace, and throws them on the ground. ARABELLAThis is your wedding present for me. Arabella takes off the bracelet and throws it to Derek. ARABELLA(cont'd)And the birthday present. DEREKGo on!

Arabella, visibly furious, pulls off her dress and kicks off her shoes. Some guests quickly avert their eyes in shock, while others continue to stare, wide-eyed and captivated by the scene. ARABELLAYou bought these for me, too. I’m not your wife from now on! Jessica sees the wedding ring on Arabella's hand and she points at Arabella's hand. JESSICAAnd that ring! Arabella is now in her underwear. She turns back to Derek with a blank expression, a single tear escaping down her cheek. Glancing at her hand, she grips the ring tightly before yanking it off and hurling it at him. The ring bounces off Derek and clatters to the floor. ARABELLASatisfied? DEREKYou can leave. ARABELLAMarrying you is my biggest regret!(turns to Jessica)And you, Jessica, you must really like picking up my trash. But whatever suits you. The onlookers make way for Arabella as she walks through the crowd and steps out of the Red Howl pack.
EXT. STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK - DAY7 7
location: EXT STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK

text: As Arabella walks down the street, 3 luxury cars stop in front of her. Edwin gets out of one car and walks over to Arabella. EDWINWhat happened? Edwin takes off his coat and puts it around Arabella, and holds her. ARABELLAPlease take me Home.
Suddenly, a magical light emits from their bodies while hugging. Edwin and Arabella are both shocked. EDWINYou are my mate?
EXT. STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK - DAY8 8
location: EXT STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK

text: Arabella carefully touches Edwin’s chest. The two of them emit a magical light. EDWINYou and I are destined to be together, Arabella. We’re fated mates. ARABELLAThis is insane! You’re my stepbrother - it can’t be. We must keep this hidden. Edwin looks at her deeply. EDWINI’ll keep it quiet. But Arabella, the universe has a plan.
INT. SILVER MOON PACK - LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY9 9
location: INT SILVER MOON PACK - LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM

text: JACKSON (Arabella's dad) sits at the table, surrounded by 2 SERVANTS. 4 BODYGUARDS appear and Jackson looks at them expectantly. The Bodyguard steps aside as Edwin and Arabella come out. Arabella walks in front. Although she is only wearing a slip and a coat, she appears confident. Jackson LAUGHS and stretches out his arms. JACKSONArabella, my dear! You are finally home! Happy birthday, my baby girl! Arabella immediately runs to Jackson and hugs him. ARABELLAOh, Dad! I missed you so much! Arabella LAUGHS happily but sheds tears at the same time.

ARABELLA(cont'd)I’m sorry, Dad! I should not have been away from my family. JACKSONCome on, kid, don’t be. You're all I care about. It’s good to see that you are safe. Jackson, Arabella, and Edwin all sit down. Jackson looks at Arabella's clothes. JACKSON(cont'd)Now tell me what happened? ARABELLADerek betrayed me. He had an affair in front of me, then he forced me to divorce him and kicked me out. Jackson becomes very angry and stands. JACKSONWhere is this scumbag? I’ll make him pay for this! Arabella stops Jackson and touches his arm. ARABELLADad, please. What’s done is done. Let it go. JACKSONHow dare he do this to my beloved daughter? His entire pack cannot even hold a candle to you. EDWINI’ll teach them a lesson. It’s a lucky thing that Arabella is no longer with the wrong person. Jackson smiles. He sits down and pats Arabella’s hand. JACKSONThat’s right! It’s good you divorced him. You’ll meet a handsome second mate. Edwin and Arabella glance at each other. Edwin interrupts Jackson immediately.

EDWINFather, let's talk about the gift we prepared for Arabella. JACKSONIndeed! Arabella, I’m going to hand the Silver Moon Pack over to you. Edwin takes out a black card and gives it to Arabella. EDWINThis is a top-tier black card — only four exist globally, and this one shows you're the boss in the Silver Moon Pack. Arabella takes the black card and she looks at it. ARABELLAYou’re spoiling me! Jackson CHUCKLES. He grabs a file on the desk and hands it to Arabella. She takes it and reads it with hesitation. JACKSONAnd this is a list of the strongest soldiers in our pack. They’ll support you when you feel ready to become the Alpha. Of course, they’re all good mate material. You can choose any of them. Jackson winks. Arabella realizes his meaning and quickly looks at Edwin, who seems tense.
INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM - DAY10 10
location: INT SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM

text: Arabella is sitting in the armchair, reading the file Jackson gave her. Edwin walks to her. EDWINSo, working through lunch now, huh? You’re really interested in those soldiers. Arabella keeps reading, without looking up. ARABELLAUh-huh, they’re not bad.

Edwin spins Arabella's chair so she faces him. He corners her and slams his hands on the armrests. EDWINIf you’re want to be married again, why not choose me? I’m much more handsome and powerful than those soldiers. And I’m your second mate, chosen by the moon goddess. ARABELLAThat all sounds good, but- Edwin gently brushes Arabella's hair away from her face and behind her ears. ARABELLA(cont'd)Maybe we should wait, until we’re both ready. EDWINI see. It's okay, don't pressure yourself. Edwin and Arabella look at each other, and the two of them move closer and closer. EDWIN(cont'd)But I want you to know that I do have feelings for you. I can't help feeling drawn to you... ARABELLAAnd I, you. They kiss passionately. Edwin holds Arabella's head with one hand and caresses her with the other hand. Arabella unbuttons his clothes. A sudden KNOCK at the door. They immediately stop what they're doing. ARABELLA(cont'd)Who's there? JACKSONIt's me, sweetheart. I'm coming in. Arabella and Edwin are very nervous. ARABELLA(whispering)We can't let Dad find out about our relationship. Hide! Hurry!

Arabella pulls Edwin into the cloakroom. At this time, the bedroom door also opens. INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA'S CLOAKROOM - DAY 10A 10A Arabella and Edwin hide in the cloakroom, watching Jackson through a gap in the door. Edwin accidentally KNOCKS OVER a clothes hanger. Arabella covers Edwin's mouth and places her index finger over it. Jackson walks toward the cloakroom. JACKSONYou there, Arabella?
INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM - DAY11 11
location: INT SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM

text: Arabella can see her father through a gap in the door. ARABELLA(pretend to be calm)Just changing my clothes. JACKSONIt's okay, I can wait. I just have something to tell you. Edwin leans against the wall, gazing at Arabella with affection. He gently removes her hand from his mouth and presses Arabella against the wall and kisses her neck. Arabella makes a gasping sound that she can't control. EDWIN(deliberately)Shh, you don’t want father to find out about us. Edwin immediately kisses her mouth heavily.
Outside the cloakroom, Jackson paces and checks his watch. JACKSONYou know what, I think I’m gonna go find Edwin.

Jackson takes out his cell phone and dials Edwin's number. INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM - DAY11B 11B At this moment, a cell phone RINGS from inside the cloakroom. Arabella and Edwin look at each other in terror. Arabella suddenly opens the cloakroom door and leans halfway out to say hello. ARABELLAThat's my phone! Just another moment. Edwin immediately hangs up the phone.

character: INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM11C 11C
text: Jackson puts down his phone and looks at her in confusion. JACKSONIsn’t that Edwin’s ringtone? Arabella smiles awkwardly and closes the door again. ARABELLAUm...maybe we happen to have the same ringtone. Yeah, that makes sense, right? Can you wait outside for me, Dad? I'll be right there! Jackson turns around and walks towards the door. JACKSONIt’s nothing important. I just want to remind you that I've prepared a party for you. It’s time to introduce you to all the packs. ARABELLAThanks, Dad! Love you! Jackson closes the door. Edwin finally comes out of the cloakroom. EDWINFather is really happy that you came back. Arabella walks into the cloakroom.
speaker: INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM11C 11C

text: INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM - DAY11D 11D ARABELLAIt seems he wants everyone to celebrate my return. Edwin looks back at Arabella and sees only the thrown clothes. The door of the cloakroom is half open, and Arabella's back is exposed while changing her clothes. Edwin immediately turns around.

character: INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM - DAY11E 11E
text: Arabella comes out dressed and rubs Edwin's back. ARABELLAHow do I look? Edwin looks at her with amazement. EDWINStunning. But why did you change into sportswear? Arabella takes out the black card and flips it between her fingers. ARABELLAIt's time to see what this baby can do.
speaker: INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM - DAY11E 11E

text: INT. THE SHOE STORE - DAY12 12

Arabella who wears simple casual wear, enters the store with Edwin. There are many exquisite SHOES displayed on the shelves. Arabella's eyes light up as she glances around, full of excitement. ARABELLAI’m so gonna max out this card. EDWINMax it out? You could buy the whole store and it wouldn’t even make a dent. Edwin smiles and goes to another section of the store. Arabella looks around and stops in front of the most beautiful pair of shoes.

ARABELLAThis pair is really awesome! Arabella touches the shoes, when a clerk comes over. CLERKIf you can’t buy it, you can't touch it. Arabella gets pissed and stands right in front of the shoes. ARABELLAExcuse me? That’s not how you treat a customer. And what makes you think I can’t afford them? CLERKThis pair of shoes is a limited edition worth $30,000. Someone like you? Please. You’d be lucky to afford a knockoff. Now, why don’t you go play dress-up somewhere else? Arabella’s face flushes with anger as the clerk tries to escort her out. Arabella stands her ground. ARABELLAI can’t believe this. You have no idea who I am! And you think you can just throw me out because of what I’m wearing? Snooty clerk rolls her eyes, about to respond when Edwin steps beside Arabella, placing a hand on her shoulder. Clerk's expression suddenly turns into horror. EDWINIs there a problem here? CLERKAlpha Edwin! I-I’m really sorry. I didn’t mean to offend you. Edwin throws a bank card to the clerk. EDWINWe’ll have it no matter how much it costs! Clerk immediately swipes his card and starts packing the shoes.

CLERKAlpha, buy anything you want. It’s an honor to serve you! EDWINGood! There’s something else I want you to do. Arabella and the clerk both look at him. EDWIN(cont'd)I want you to personally help the lady put on these shoes.
INT. THE SHOE STORE - DAY13 13

Clerk is embarrassed. CLERKThat’s not a part of my job. EDWINIt is now. Do as I say and help her put it on, or you'll lose more than just a sale. Clerk reluctantly takes a knee in front of Arabella and slips the shoes on her feet. CLERKYes, Alpha Edwin. Arabella looks at Edwin, who looks deep into her eyes. ARABELLAYou don't have to do this for me, Edwin. I can handle this myself. EDWINI want to protect you and won't allow anyone to bully. Plus, it’s the salesperson’s job to treat all customers with respect. Edwin’s phone suddenly RINGS and he stood up. EDWIN(cont'd)Our father again. I’ll pick you up later. Call me if you need anything.

Dewin leaves. Arabella gestures goodbye then admires the shoes on her feet. Jessica enters the store and immediately notices Arabella. JESSICAArabella? The ink hasn’t even dried on your divorce papers and you’re already rutting your way across town. Why are you here? Arabella's happy expression drops. ARABELLAAs you can see, I am buying what I need. JESSICAThe salesperson really shouldn’t let you in here, you tramp. I didn't think a country bumpkin like you is qualified to enter such a high-end store. ARABELLAA country bumpkin?! You know what, you’re the one who should leave. I could buy the whole store if I wanted to! JESSICAYou lowborn bitch! You have no right to enter high social circles. After all, you are just a weak Rogue Wolf without a pack. Arabella sneers disdainfully. ARABELLAWell, I'm going to the party at the Silver Moon Pack. I'm sure you know about it. JESSICADerek and I will also go to the party. And we'll stay at the most luxurious hotel - SPURIA Hotel, which only welcomes the highest elites. I'll be there to humiliate you. If you think you’re better than I, show me. ARABELLADeal! You're gonna regret this.
Jessica walks away. Arabella pulls out her phone. ARABELLA(cont'd)Hello, is this the SPURIA Hotel? I am the heiress of Silver Moon pack. I would like to book the presidential suite.
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - LOBBY - DAY14 14

In the hotel lobby, the hotel manager WILLIAM steps forward in front of 4 WAITERS. MANAGER WILLIAMEveryone, pay attention! The waiters gather together. MANAGER WILLIAM(cont'd)I just received a reservation. The heiress of the Silver Moon pack will stay in our hotel. She has booked the presidential suite. You must make sure she is taken care of and has a good time here! WAITERSYes, sir! MANAGER WILLIAMNow, get to work! William leaves, the waiters disperse and start doing their work. Waiter A and Waiter B stand at the hotel entrance. WAITER AThe Silver Moon pack is already the most powerful and richest pack. WAITER BThen this lady must be extraordinary. At this time Arabella walks into the hotel wearing simple casual wear. WAITER AThat’s obviously not her. Waiter A and Waiter B LAUGH. Arabella looks at them.

ARABELLAExcuse me? Are you guys judging me? WAITER AWhat if we are? WAITER BWe're expecting a very important guest soon. Go away! Arabella is angry and about to say something. At this time, Jessica, wearing gorgeous clothes, walks in. Waiter A and Waiter B become nervous. WAITER AThis lady must be the one! Waiter A and Waiter B bow toward Jessica. WAITER BGood afternoon, Miss! Arabella looks at them indignantly. ARABELLAWhat? Seriously?
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - LOBBY - DAY15 15

Arabella looks angrily at the two waiters. ARABELLAHow can you treat us differently like this? Jessica looks at Arabella proudly. JESSICAIsn't it obvious? Move over, Ms. Nobody. Waiter A walks to Jessica and bows again. WAITER AMiss, you are the one who booked the presidential suite, right? JESSICAThat's right, it's me!

ARABELLAWait, I booked it! Waiter B looks at her doubtfully, pushes her aside. WAITER BThat’s impossible. People like you can't afford even the cheapest room in the SPURIA hotel. ARABELLAYou ignorant snob! Jessica pretends to be impatient with these waiters. JESSICAThat's enough! Take me to the suite. Waiter A and Waiter B immediately lead the way. WAITER BThis way, please! Jessica walks by and looks at Arabella proudly. JESSICAI’ll make sure you lose, bitch! ARABELLAReally? We’ll see!
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY16 16
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: Waiters A and B walk Jessica to the door of the suite. WAITER AHere we are. JESSICAOkay, open the door. WAITER BMiss, only you can open it, with your VIP card. JESSICAWhat? Oh, of course. Jessica is very nervous and starts rummaging through her bag. WAITER AYou lost your VIP card, miss?
Arabella comes over and takes out her VIP card. ARABELLAYou mean this card?
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY17 17
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: Arabella walks to the door of the room holding the VIP card. ARABELLAOnly the VIP card can open the presidential suite, right? Waiter A and Waiter B are shocked. WAITER AThat's right. WAITER BBut how did you get the VIP card? Arabella swipes her card and the door to the room unlocks. ARABELLABecause I was the one who booked the presidential suite. Arabella turns the doorknob and is about to push the door open. ARABELLA(cont'd)Watch carefully! At this moment, Jessica suddenly grabs Arabella's hand and snatches the VIP card. JESSICAWait a minute! Arabella is surprised and the door fails to open. Jessica looks back at Waiter A and Waiter B. JESSICA(cont'd)This VIP card is mine! I lost it. She must have found it somewhere and just stole it! WAITER BThat's right, this VIP card is obviously not hers.

WAITER AWe believe you, Miss! Arabella looks at them very angrily. ARABELLAAre you two insane? She obviously just took the card from me! JESSICAKick this thief out, now! Waiter A and Waiter B immediately try to control Arabella. ARABELLALet me go! At this time, manager William appears. MANAGER WILLIAMStop!
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY18 18
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: Manager William walks towards the two waiters. MANAGER WILLIAMWhat are you doing? Waiter A and Waiter B are still holding Arabella tightly. WAITER AThis thief stole that lady’s VIP card. WAITER BWe are kicking her out. MANAGER WILLIAMWho told you to do this? Jessica walks up to the manager William. JESSICAI did. Do you have a problem? Manager William smiles and takes the VIP card from Jessica. He walks up to waiter A and waiter B and slaps them. MANAGER WILLIAMYou idiots!

Jessica, Waiter A and Waiter B are all very shocked. Manager William bows politely to Arabella and returns the VIP card to her with both hands. ARABELLAIt’s good that you recognize me, William. MANAGER WILLIAMI'm so sorry, miss. I'll fire them immediately! Manager William grabs the waiters’ collars and drags them away. Arabella takes the VIP and opens the door. ARABELLAYou lost this game. JESSICASo what? Arabella walks up to Jessica and looks at her intensely. ARABELLAI want you to admit your mistake and apologize to me in front of everyone!
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY19 19
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: JESSICAWhy should I do that?! ARABELLAYou cheated with my mate, took my Luna position, and now you accused me of stealing! JESSICAYou're such a baby! Nobody cares about the truth! There’s no way I’m gonna apologize to someone as lowborn as you! Arabella walks to Jessica directly, and Jessica stumbles backwards. ARABELLAHow can you be so shameless?

JESSICAFine. I’ll tell you the truth. I want to see you hurt. It is so much fun. Arabella raises her hand, intending to slap Jessica. Before she hits her, Jessica pretends to be hit and falls to the floor. Arabella looks at her hand in confusion. ARABELLAWhat are you doing? Then Derek rushes over. He pulls Arabella away and helps Jessica up. DEREKJessica, are you hurt? Jessica buries her head in Derek’s chest. JESSICAShe is trying to hurt me again! DEREK(angry)Arabella, how could you attack a pregnant woman? Why are you so vicious? ARABELLAWhat? I didn’t hit her! She fell on her own! DEREKShut up! I saw it! Are you saying she would risk her own child? Arabella is extremely angry. She sneers. ARABELLAShe's evil and you’re blind! You two clearly deserve each other! Arabella tries to leave but she is stopped by Derek. Jessica looks at Arabella with an evil smile. DEREKArabella, if you apologize now, I’ll forget this ever happened. Arabella breaks away from Derek's hand in disgust.

CHARLIEThis guy keeps playing games with me and putting me to sleep. Jade breaths a sigh of relief and smiles. She hugs Charlie, and looks at Samuel timidly. JADE Why are you doing this... location: INT AT THE DOOR OF THE HOSPITAL WARD

MIKE(cont'd)Later, Jade had to leave the hospital under the relentless coercion of that group of people. When she returned there, it was time to give birth. Jade and Mary sit in the hospital office as the doctor hands over the consent form for surgery. DOCTORMrs. Fisher, have you made up your mind? Jade looks at the consent form for surgery. MARYDoctor, is there really only a 10% chance... DOCTORYes, Mrs. Fisher, our hospital already has the most advanced equipment. There are no guarantees, but I believe that a gifted person like Samuel will be lucky. Jade's hands shake as Mary takes the consent form for the surgery. MARYJade, you have nothing to do with Samuel anymore, let me sign. JADEMom... 89
Mary takes the pen and writs her name. MARY (choking)Doctor, please...
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY97 97

The door of the operating room opens, and the haggard Jade and Mary stand up from the bench. DOCTORThe tumor was successfully removed and Samuel is temporarily out of danger! Jade and Mary cry with joy. DOCTOR(cont'd)It's just that the brain has been damaged to some extent, and it will take some time to recover from the sequelae of the surgery. Samuel probably won't remember anyone. MARYIt's good that he is alive. That's good enough…
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY98 98

Samuel sits on the bed with a bandage on his head. He looks out the window with empty eyes. Jade pushes the door open and walks in slowly. Samuel turns his head slowly. SAMUELHello, what can I do for you? JADE(laughing)Samuel, I'm your old friend, and I came to see you. SAMUELSorry, I... JADEI know, I just came by to say hi and then I'll leave. 90

SAMUELThank you. Could you stay a little longer? Jade smiles and shakes her head, looks at Samuel lingeringly for a few seconds, and turns around. JADE (OS)Samuel, our painful first half of life ends here. You are the new you, and I will be a new me... Jade walks out of the ward. Samuel watches the Jade's departing figure, his gaze lingering. A hint of complexity flashes in his eyes. SAMUEL(murmurs to himself)She’s probably more than just an old friend.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE BASEMENT - DAY99 99

The basement door opens. Mike blocks Samuel from walking in. SAMUELWhy you block me? I wanna take a look. MIKEHold on... MIKE (OS)(cont'd)Jade probably didn't leave anything behind... Mike breathes a sigh of relief when he sees that it is completely clean and there is no sign of habitation. SAMUEL Why are you so nervous? Mike avoids the question. Samuel shakes his head helplessly. He looks carefully at the bookshelf in the basement, picking up a photo of Jade and Charlie that has fallen from the corner of the shelf with his hand. 91

SAMUEL (OS)(cont'd)This is... the woman who came to visit me in the hospital that day... Why is her and her child's picture in my house? Do we know each other well? Samuel suddenly has a splitting headache. He screams in pain. Mike approaches. MIKEMr. Fisher! Are you OK? Mike sees Samuel holding a photo tightly in his hand. His face turns pale with fear. SAMUEL(growls)Who is she, what's her name! MIKESamuel...her...her name is Jade...I can't say anymore...
INT. CAREY'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY100 100

Jade sits on the sofa in the living room, and Summer and Kevin (early 30s), a stylish and handsome man, sit together on the opposite sofa. SUMMERJade, Kevin is the most famous fashion magazine editor. You majored in fashion design. You have also worked for a fashion magazine publishing company. You can go to work at Kevin's magazine and learn from him. JADEBut I haven't been involved in this industry for s many years… KEVIN So Jade, even if you got divorced, you shouldn't give up your life like this. JADEWait, I'm not giving up on my life, I want to learn. 92

Kevin turns and looks at Jade. KEVINPlease make a clothing sketch for me right now based on the latest fashion trends. JADEOkay. The SERVANT hands over paper and pen, and Jade begins to draw. As time passes, Jade hands in her sketch. Kevin's eyes is widen. KEVINThis...did you draw this? JADEYou've been sitting here the whole time... KEVIN Genius, you are a genius! Summer smiles. KEVIN(cont'd)(exclaiming)If you come directly to my magazine, I guarantee that in a year you will definitely be a top-notch fashion editor. JADEMay I ask which magazine your company is... KEVINELLE Magazine. Jade covers her mouth in surprise. JADEOK! I'll start tomorrow! Kevin smiles and looks at the sketch in his hand with appreciation.
INT. ELLE MAGAZINE OFFICE - DAY101 101

Jade is busy processing documents while Helen drinks coffee with a smile on her face. HELENJade, you have been working for a week. How is the work I assigned to you going? Jade raises her head. JADEMs. Helen, as my senior, I have some questions I would like to ask? HELENNo rush. Get me another cup of coffee first. Helen hands her empty cup to Jade. When she looks up, she sees James and Kevin coming and quickly tidies herself. HELEN(cont'd)(nervous laughter)James, long time no see.. JAMESJade! Jade's head snaps up, and is startled to see James. JADEJames... Jade stands up from her chair.James runs past Helen and hugs Jade with a smile. Helen's smile freezes on her face. James lets go of Jade and looks at her. JAMESJade, I heard about your story. How have you been recently? JADE(laughing)Very good. JAMESI didn't expect you to come to work at EllE! KEVINShe is my first ever personal disciple. 94

James smiles with relief. JAMESI'm glad that your life is finally back on track. Are you free for lunch today. JADESounds great. James and Kevin continue on into the Editor-in-Chief's office. Just as Jade is about to sit, Helen stops her. HELENJade, how come you have affairs with every man? Tell me, what tricks did you use to seduce the big lawyer like James? JADEWhat's wrong with you? People with a black heart see everything in dirty ways. Helen slaps Jade in the face. Jade pours coffee on her desk onto Helen. HELENYou bitch! How dare you splash me! JADEIt's on you. Jade turns and leaves, and Helen angrily throws the documents on the table to the ground.
INT. ELLE MAGAZINE OFFICE - DAY103 103

Helen wipes the coffee stains off her clothes and returns to her seat. She is so angry that she throws all of Jade's things into the trash can. KEVINHelen, pack your things and leave within an hour. HELEN Wha- what do you mean? 95

KEVIN(firmly)You're fired. HELENBoss! I am the most senior member here, how can I... KEVINHelen! If I don't fire you, do you want to wait for the Carey family to deal with you? Jade comes over and stands behind Kevin. HELENThe Carey family...(Looking at Jade)You are... You are... JADEYou got it right, I am the daughter of the Carey family. Satisfied? Helen slumps to the ground.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY104 104

Mary sits on the sofa, reading. Samuel comes over and puts the photo onto the table. SAMUELMom, tell me, who is the woman in this photo? Mary looks at the photo, then looks at Mike, then laughs dryly. MARYOh, Samuel, you may have forgotten. The woman in this picture is Jade, my goddaughter. That's why you feel familiar with her. But now she has changed her name and gone abroad. SAMUELIt can't be that simple or Mike wouldn't be hesitant. 96

MARYThat's because you and Jade used to have a good relationship, and he's worried that you'll be sad because she's gone abroad. Mary pulls Samuel to sit down with her and puts the photo away. MARY(cont'd)By the way, I'm gonna ask you to go to Miss Lily's family dinner with me. Samuel frowns.
INT. HOTEL DINNER ROOM - DAY105 105

LILY sits in the box with her parents (LILY'S MOM and LILY'S FATHER), looking very happy. LILYDad, Mom, do you think Samuel will really come? LILY'S FATHERYes I think so. LILY'S MOMLily, you must seize this great opportunity to get married to Mr. Fisher! The door opens and Lily's family stands up. Samuel and Mary walk in, Lily looks at Samuel with a smile, eyes shining. LILY'S DADMrs. Fisher, Samuel, it's an honor for our family that you are coming to dinner today. MARYThanks for having us. Young people should also come out and get to know each other. LILY'S MOMSamuel, this is my daughter, Lily, who is also a popular young actress in the film and television industry. 97

Samuel's eyes flick to Lily. LILYSamuel, you don't know me yet. I... SAMUELDo you have any skeletons in the closet? LILYHuh? Of course not. SAMUELWell, that's suitable for marriage. Let's just leave it at that. Lily's father and mother exchange looks of ecstasy. LILY'S DADSamuel, did you fall in love with our Lily at first sight? SAMUELThere is no need to be so reserved. Isn't this dinner meant to bring me and your daughter together? I just recovered from my illness and don't want to waste time on such trivial matters. MARYSamuel... you are too direct. SAMUELMom, there are still many things waiting for me to take care of in the company. I have to leave now. Samuel nods to the group and walks out. MARY(smiling)Lily, I'm sorry. Samuel has a straightforward manner. LILY It's okay, Auntie. I like men like this. Since Samuel said so, I am willing to marry him. Let's decide on the date! LILY (OS)(cont'd)Samuel, I like challenging men like you. 98
EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY106 106

Subtitles: "One year later" Samuel gets out of the luxury car with Lily holding his arm. The media flash their lights, and the FANS shout wildly. FANS Lily, Lily! I love you! Lily smiles, waves to everyone, and leans on Samuel's arm like a little bird. FAN AOh my god, Lily is beautiful and a popular movie star, and her fiancé is Samuel, the president of Fisher Group. Winner in life! FAN BSamuel is so handsome, the two of them are simply a perfect match! Lily chuckles and kisses Samuel on the cheek. The fans shout louder. Samuel frowns slightly and lowers his head to fix Lily's hair. FAN AIt's hard to imagine the kind of big shots who are able to attend this kind of top family banquet with them. FAN BI heard that one of the world's richest families - the Carey's - will e here! Samuel looks up. SAMUEL (OS) The Carey family... While Samuel is lost in thought, a luxury car stops at the hotel gate. Frank gets out first, opens the door, and Jade, wearing a dress and high heels, steps out of the car and takes her father's arm. Samuel's eyes widen instantly. 99
SAMUEL (OS)(cont'd)Aren't you Jade from the photo? How come you are the daughter of the Carey family?
EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY107 107

Jade stands by the car door and is showered with flashes of light. LILY(whispering)Oh, the rumored Carey daughter finally shows up. FAN AOh my god! Isn't this the famous fashion designer Jade? She is actually the daughter of the Carey family! FAN BAhhhhhh! This is a real socialite! Jade smiles and waves to everyone as fans cheer, while Lily stomps her feet in dissatisfaction. When Jade comes near Samuel, Samuel grabs her wrist. SAMUEL Wait! Jade raises an eyebrow. JADE Sir, what can I do for you? Samuel hold Jade's hand and his Adam's apple bobs.
FRANK (interrupting)Samuel, your fiancée is still beside you. It would not be a good look if you pull my daughter along like this. 100
speaker: SAMUEL...

text: Samuel's grip tightens and Jade looks around, noticing the fans whispering. JADESamuel, I don't want to make the gossip news. LILYSamuel! Samuel releases Jade's hand. SAMUEL Sorry, wrong person. Jade raises an eyebrow, turns around and walks into the hotel, while Frank whispers a warning to Samuel. FRANKHer life now has nothing to do with you. Don't bother her anymore. Frank follows Jade into the hotel. Lily stomps her feet unhappily when she sees Samuel looking lost.
INT. HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY108 108

Jade fixes her makeup in front of the mirror in the lounge with trembling hands. JADE (OS)Did Samuel just remember me? It's impossible. I took all the stuff about me and Charlie in the house, and Mike kept saying that Samuel didn't remember anything, and now he has a new fiancé... Jade closes her compact. JADE (OS)(cont'd)No matter what, Samuel has his new life now, and I have your own life too. I mustn't Look back. Jade packs up her things and turns to go out, but Samuel pushes the door open.
INT. HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY109 109

Jade closed her compact. JADE (OS)No matter what, Samuel has his new life now, and I have your own life too. I mustn't Look back. Jade packs up her things and turns to go out, but Samuel pushes the door open. JADE(cont'd)(calm)Sir, this is my lounge, you must have the wrong place. SAMUELNo, I've come to see you. JADEBut we don't know each other, sir. As Jade starts to walk out Samuel grabs her wrist. SAMUELI know it's you. When I was hospitalized a year ago, you came to see me in the ward. I know your face. Jade takes a deep breath and turns to look at Samuel. JADESamuel, there are so many people in this world who look alike. Must you question every one of them? Samuel tightens his grip.
James pushes open the door of the lounge, see Samuel, frowns, and pulls Jade over. JAMES Samuel, what are you doing? SAMUEL Who are you? Jade tugs on James' hand. 102
speaker: SAMUEL I...

text: JAMES I'm Jade's boyfriend, James.
INT. HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY110 110

James holds Jade's hand and looks at Samuel. JAMES I'm Jade's boyfriend, James. SAMUEL You... have a boyfriend? Samuel clutches his chest and Jade frowns. SAMUEL (OS)(cont'd)Why...why does that make you feel sad? James steps in front of Jade to block Samuel's view. JAMESMr. Fisher, you can not leave your fiancée to come and harass my girlfriend. If you don't leave, I will Call the police! Samuel SIGHS. SAMUELPlease accept my apologies. Samuel walks out, Jade sobs into her hands. JAMESJade, I'm sorry, I just took the liberty of saying I was your boyfriend. JADEIt's okay, I know you just wanted him to leave. JAMESYou know, we have been together for a year and I think you might reconsider our relationship. JADE (wiping tears)James, let's get married… 103

JAMESAre you serious? I've been waiting for this day for a long time! Jade looks at James and nods. JADEJames, I'm a little tired now. Please leave me for a while. James walks out slowly closes the door, almost all the way.

character: INT. AT THE DOOR OF HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY110A 110A
text: Through the crack of the door, James sees Jade kneeling on the ground, crying. JAMES (OS) Jade, do you really love me? James closes the door, looks at Samuel's back who stands with Lily not far away, and clenches his fists. JAMES (OS)(cont'd)Samuel, I won't let you take her away from me this time...
speaker: INT. AT THE DOOR OF HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY110A 110A

text: INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY111 111

The guests move around freely. Samuel's eyes occasionally glance at Jade, who toasts not far away. LILY(unhappy)Samuel, you are my fiancé, why are you always looking at other girls? Samuel comes back to his senses. SAMUELShe just looks familiar, don't think too much about it. KEVIN (V.O.)Hello, everybody! Everyone looks at Kevin who was stands on the stage, and REPORTERS swarm around. 104

KEVINI am very happy to attend this banquet of top families as an invited guest of the Carey family. As everyone knows, Jade, the daughter of the Carey family, is my only student. She has also become a top designer in the world fashion within a year. Her designs have won many awards. Jade holds her wine glass and looks at Kevin on the stage with a smile. KEVIN(cont'd) Jade, come up. Jade hands her glass to James and walks up to the stage slowly. KEVIN(cont'd)From today on, Jade will focus on building her own luxury brand: Jade. We welcome all of you to come to us to design custom apparel. The whole audience APPLAUDS and Lily stamps her feet unhappily. LILYWho is the star of today after all? She's really good at stealing the limelight! SAMUELDon't say such things that would lower your reputation. LILYSamuel! SAMUEL (OS)I really can't fall in love with such a vulgar woman. Samuel suddenly notices a woman holding a iron bar next to James. SAMUEL (OS)(cont'd)Who is she... Why have I never seen her before? Helen quickens her steps holding the iron bar, and Samuel looks at her direction - It is towards Jade. 105

SAMUEL(cont'd)Jade! Helen rushes straight towards Jade on the stage, and Kevin and Jade's eyes widened instantly. KEVINHelen! Helen raises the iron bar and swings it at Jade. Jade closes her eyes and only hears a dull sound. LILY (V.O.)Samuel! Jade's eyes snap open to see Samuel standing in front of her, blood pouring from his head. JADE Samuel! SAMUEL(weakly)Didn't I protect you like this before? Samuel collapses to the floor.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY112 112

Helen raises the pipe and swings it at Jade. Jade closes her eyes. Samuel steps in front of Jade and gets hit him hard with the stick. LILY (O.S.)Samuel! Jade's eyes snap open to see Samuel standing in front of her, blood pouring from his head. JADE Samuel! SAMUEL (weakly)Didn't I protect you like this before? Samuel faints on the ground and Jade quickly hugs him. Helen realizes something is wrong and tries to run away, but is stops by James. She turns around and sees Kevin again. 106
KEVINHelen, why did you do that? You're going to prison! HELENIt's all her fault. She destroyed everything I've had for so many years! It's all her fault! Jade steps forward and slaps Helen hard.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY113 113

Jade steps forward and slaps Helen hard. JADE Helen, I'm warning you, if anything happens to Samuel, I'll make you beg for death in jail. HELEN (laughing)Kevin, James, you see, the woman you are protecting has another man in her heart. Such a love story, hahahaha! Helen is dragged away by the security guards. Jade clenches her fists and turns to looks at Samuel who is being carried on a stretcher. Just as she is about to follow him, James pulls her away. JAMESJade, if you follow him, you'll never be able to start over again... Jade pauses and Lily glares at her. LILYJade! I don't care what your relationship with Samuel is. We're getting married, stay away from him! After that, Lily runs after Samuel's stretcher. Jade's tears fall. James and Kevin reach out to comfort her. Jade waves her hand, steps off the stage and walks towards Frank. JADEDad, I want to go home. 107

FRANKJade, you really need some rest. JADEDad... why did Samuel stand in front of me? FRANKI don't know. Judging from what happened today, it seems that he did not remember who you were. JADELove never forgets... Frank looks at Jade. JADE(cont'd)Take me to the hospital.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY114 114

Samuel lies on the hospital bed with blood covering is head. His eyes are blurry, he clutches his head, groaning in pain. LILYSamuel, don't touch yourself, you're covered in blood! Samuel stares at the bright hospital ceiling, his expression dazed, and holds Lily's hand. Jade stands at the ward door and watches Samuel hold Lily's hand tightly. She stops in her tracks. JADE (OS)Jade, what are you doing... You are no longer the same person, and you shouldn't be the one staying with him now.... Jade turns back reluctantly. Samuel murmurs something, Lily leans in closer. To Jade, they seem so intimate. JADE (OS)(cont'd)Samuel, you and your future wife are in love... I feel relieved... Jade turns and leaves. LILY Samuel, I can't hear you. 108
SAMUEL Jade, I'm sorry… Samuel closes his eyes as he speaks. LILY(whispering) Whose name are you in? Jade? A fierce look flashes in Lily's eyes.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY115 115

Samuel lies on the hospital bed. He frowns as if he was dreaming and suddenly wakes up. SAMUELJade! Samuel sits up, panting, and Mary holds his hand. MARYSamuel, what's wrong? Are you having a nightmare? SAMUELMom, Jade is my ex-wife, right? Mary's hand stiffens. MARYSamuel... SAMUELMom, what is going on between Jade and me? Why are you hiding it from me? Mary sighs. MARYSamuel, do you really want to know, even if it hurts you... SAMUELI want to know. I clearly feel that I love her now, but I can't remember everything. This makes everything feel more painful. Mary purses her lips and looks up at Samuel. 109

MARYJade is your ex-wife. She was the adopted daughter of the Garrison family, and was actually the kidnapped lost daughter of the Carey family. SAMUELShe used to be my wife? So why is she pretending not to know me? Mary sighs and glances at Samuel. MARYSamuel, we Fishers owe her all these years... SAMUELWhat do you mean? MARY Jade hasn't had a good day since she married you. You and I both think she stole the Garrison family's biological daughter, Olivia's position...(chokes up)And humiliate her... SAMUELWhat... But I can clearly feel it. I love her very much. When I see her, I can't help wanting to get close to her... How could I hurt her like this? Samuel stares at Mary in panic, and Mary holds his hand. MARYBack then, Olivia fooled us all. She kept framing Jade, twisting everything against her. And yet, she had the audacity to pretend she saved your life—making us all believe her lies. SAMUELWho's the kid in that photo... MARYIt's your son.(sighs)Back then, Jade told me she was pregnant.
But I did not believe it was yours. And Jade left home in desperation, wandering for five years... Samuel's eyes widen and he grabs the quilt helplessly. SAMUELFive years?!
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY116 116

Samuel grabs the blanket like a child who has done something wrong. SAMUELFive years?! MARYFive years later, she came back with a child. You think the child was born of her and another man. To punish Jade, you made her a maid and nanny during the day and a prostitute in your nightclub at night. Samuel's eyes widen and covers his head in pain. Mary hugs him in panic. SAMUELHow could I do that to her! MARYActually, you and Jade have always loved each other, but you have been torturing each other for too long. SAMUELI tortured her, and she has been suffering all this time... MARYSamuel, are you still going to go find her? SAMUEL(shaking his head)No, she already has a new identity and a new life.

Since she pretends not to know me, then she wants to deny our past. I won't bother her anymore. MARYBut... Samuel, this may not be... up to you... SAMUELWhat do you mean? MARYOur company's new fashion project partner invited Jade to design the formal attire... Jade will tailor clothes for you in a couple of days. The light shines in Samuel's eyes. SAMUEL (OS) I can still see her...
INT. FISHER'S OFFICE - DAY117 117

SAMUELYou're here. JADESamuel, take off your coat. I'll measure for your clothes and leave. Samuel says nothing, but takes off his coat. Jade sets out her tool box, takes out a measuring tape, and measures Samuel. When Jade puts her arm around Samuel's waist to measure it, Samuel can't help but hug her. SAMUELJade... JADEI am no longer the Jade I used to be! SAMUELOkay. I remember all about our past now. You can also feel that I love you. Love does not disappear even if I lose my memory...

JADEPlease don't dwell on the past. Samuel, we'll only hurt each other if we're together. What's more, I already have someone I want to entrust the rest of my life too. Samuel's eyes turn red, and he puts his hand on Jade's face and kisses her. Jade opens her eyes wide and pushes Samuel away. JADE(cont'd)Samuel! Are you crazy? SAMUEL (ROARING)Yes, I am crazy. I understand what you said, but I am unwilling to do it! I really love you, and I also wont forget you. I also told myself not to bother, but I can't do it...Jade, I beg you, if you are angry with me, you can punish me however you want, but please don't be with another. JADE (trembling)Samuel, you already have a new partner, and I have started a new life. Since you bullied me so horribly, there is no possibility of us being together again. Do you understand? Samuel slumps in his chair, holding his head. SAMUEL (crying)You're still blaming me... Jade puts away her measuring tape. JADEI have roughly measured the size, and I will ask someone to deliver your clothes on time. With that, Jade straightens her clothes, takes the box and leaves. Samuel shouts and sweeps the things off the table. 113
INT. LILY'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY118 118

Lily throws things in the living room, her hair is messy. Her ASSISTANT runs over and kneels in front of her. LILY You came at the right time. Tell me quickly, what evidence have you found against Jade? The subordinate hands Lily a USB drive. ASSISTANTMiss, you will know if you open it. When Jade was still Samuel's wife, Samuel asked her to work in his nightclub... LILY What?! Lily grabs the USB drive. LILY(cont'd)Jade, see you at your engagement party.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY119 119

Frank, Summer and James' parents stand on the stage, smiling at the guests. FRANKWelcome everyone to the engagement party of my daughter Jade and her fiancé James. Please give a round of applause to welcome them on stage! James walks onto the stage smiling, holding Jade's arm, while Jade holds the microphone. JADEJames and I have known each other for a few years, and he has taken care of me without asking for anything in return. He is the kindest and most sincere person in the world. I want to give the rest of my life to him. 114
LILY (V.O.) Are you worthy? Everyone looks towards the hotel entrance. Lily pushes the door open with a bunch of REPORTERS, looking at Jade with a sneer.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY120 120

Samuel works on some papers on the sofa when Mike rushes in. MIKESamuel, bad news! The nightclub's surveillance footage from a year ago was stolen! SAMUELHow could anyone pirate that? MIKEThe stolen footage was from when Jade used to work there, and the thief seems to be Miss Lily's assistant! SAMUELWhat! Oh no, Jade and James' engagement party is today. Let's go!
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY121 121

Lily sneers at the people present with a bunch of reporters, and Kevin stands up. KEVINMiss Lily, what do you mean barging in uninvited and bringing so many reporters here? LILYOh, Carey family's daughter's engagement is definitely worth celebrating by the whole town. KEVIN Would you be so kind? LILY (laughing)Not only am I kind, I also brought a gift for Jade. 115

Lily waves, and her Assistant runs backstage with the USB. LILY(cont'd)How can an engagement party be complete without the couple's personal profiles? The big screen on the stage suddenly starts playing a clip of Jade working in the nightclub. The reporters begin filming frantically. The microphone falls to the ground and make a buzzing sound. JAMES(shouting)Stop filming! Stop filming! Frank holds his heart and is supported by Summer. James protects Jade. Kevin rushes forward in front of the reporters' cameras. Jade's ears gradually lose the sound of the crowd. She stares at the screen, motionless, at her clothes being torn off by a man. The sight of money stuffed into the collar makes her laugh out loud.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY122 122

Jade LAUGHS SO HARD on the stage. Everyone looks at her and falls silent. At this moment, Samuel and Mike arrive. LILY Jade, how can you still laugh? Mike sees the scene on the big screen and wants to rush over but is stopped by Samuel. SAMUEL Trust her and listen to her. Jade bends down to pick up the microphone and looks at the reporter's cameras. JADEI'm sorry to spoil your fantasy. Yes, before I returned to my current identity, I was an adopted daughter and also the ex-wife of the president of Fisher's Group, Samuel. The guests looks at each other. 116

JADE(cont'd)Because I was an adopted daughter, I had to leave the house and suffer humiliation when the biological daughter came back. And I have to pay off the debt I owed to my ex-husband... SAMUEL (whispering)No, you don't owe me, you don't owe me... JADESo I went to work at his nightclub to earn money. There is an UPROAR at the scene. JADE(cont'd)But that was my job, I always followed my rules: selling the wines, not myself. I don't think it's anything to be ashamed of, even though I'm a different person now, I still want to be honest with the past. Jade's tears flow down, and Summer and James cry bitterly beside her.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY123 123

Jade looks into the camera with tears in her eyes. JADEEven though I am a different person now, I still want to say to my past self… Thank you for your hard work, Jade… The whole hall is silent. Kevin, Mike and others all have tears in their eyes. The Reporters put down their cameras and someone shouts something. GUEST Isn't that Samuel at the door? Everyone looks towards the door and Samuel, shaking all over, rushes in and grabbed Lily's arm. 117

SAMUELAre you satisfied? Have you had enough trouble? Stop embarrassing yourself here! Get out of here with all your people! The Reporters turn their cameras and take pictures of Samuel and Lily. LILYSamuel, I'm your fiancée, how dare you say such harsh words to me! SAMUELNot anymore. LILYSamuel, do you know what you are talking about? Samuel turns and looks at Jade. SAMUELI'm sorry for the pain I've caused you, Jade. I hope you and James have a happy marriage. (To the guest)I also want to make an announcement, from now on, Fisher and the Lily's engagement is cancelled! Samuel bows deeply to Jade and strides away, leaving Lily with tears in her eyes. LILY Stop filming! Get out of here! Lily runs out, followed by the Reporters. Jade slumps to the ground.
INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - DAY124 124
James paces through the hotel banquet hall, looking at his watch. JAMES (OS)It's been so long, why hasn't Jade arrived? 118
