Locke’s jaw tightens. Vivian presses harder — a thin line of blood trickles down Rose’s neck. LOCKE (ALARMED)Stop! What do you want? VIVIAN (SMIRKING)Let Edmund go. Tell your men to leave. Now. Rose shakes her head. Locke looks at her bleeding throat. He releases Edmund and gestures to his men. LOCKEOut. Eric leads the guards out. The doors close, leaving only the four of them. Edmund scrambles to Vivian’s side. LOCKE (CONT'D)Now let her go. VIVIAN (COLDLY)Did you really think I’d just forgive you? EDMUNDYeah, Vivian’s the heiress of Blackstone, and I’m her fiancé. After what you did to me, you think this ends so easily? LOCKEWhat do you want? VIVIANI want you to kneel. ROSE (HORRIFIED)No! Locke, don’t! Vivian jerks the glass tighter; Rose gasps in pain. LOCKERose! VIVIAN (SNAPPING)Shut up! (to Locke) You heard me. Get on your knees—or she bleed out before you can blink. Tears stream down Rose’s face as she shakes her head. ROSELocke, don’t! Don’t listen to them! Don’t kneel— Vivian sneers and drags the glass sharply across Rose’s neck. Blood spurts instantly. LOCKE (SHOUTING)Stop! I’ll do it!

He drops to one knee with a heavy thud, then the other. His body trembles, but his back remains straight. Vivian smiles and halts her hand. Rose breaks down, sobbing. ROSELocke! Locke’s eyes burn with rage as he stares up at Edmund. LOCKENow... let her go. ROSE (V.O., SOBBING)He... he knelt down for me...
12.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL - DAY41 41

LOCKENow... let her go. Edmund bursts into wild laughter and stomps on Locke’s knee. Locke groans in pain. EDMUNDLet her go? Not even close! He snatches the fallen candlestick from the floor and swings it down hard onto Locke’s head. Blood splatters. Locke staggers, blood dripping down his face. EDMUND (TAUNTING) (CONT'D)What happened to all that confidence? Didn’t you want to show me your strength? Where is it now, huh? ROSE (DESPERATE)Locke! Stop it! Please, stop! Vivian sneers and tightens her grip on Rose’s throat. VIVIANYou two—one pretending to be me, one pretending to be my uncle. Edmund, teach this fake a lesson he’ll never forget. EDMUNDGladly. I’ll make sure he remembers this forever. He slams the candlestick down again. It cracks against Locke’s skull — Locke collapses backward, blood spreading across his face, his expression in pain. ROSE (CRYING)Locke!

LOCKE (WEAKLY, SMILING)I’m fine… Rose breaks down, sobbing harder. ROSEStop it! He’s the real Locke! You’ll regret this! Edmund hesitates and glances at Vivian. EDMUNDVivian… VIVIANStill won’t admit it? Fine. I’ll make you confess. EDMUNDOh? You have proof? Vivian’s lips curl into a cold smile. VIVIANYou don’t know, do you? Locke’s just one of my bodyguards. VIVIAN (V.O.)Good thing Dad told me so many details about him... The crowd murmurs, shocked. VIVIANTwenty years ago, Locke took a knife for me — nearly lost his arm. The scar’s still there. Rose’s eyes fill with tears. She looks at Locke. He meets her gaze, and mouths the words: Don’t be afraid. VIVIAN (SMIRKING) (CONT'D)You claim to be Locke? Then prove it.Do you have that scar? EDMUNDYeah, if you’re so sure you’re Locke, show us your arm! ROSEIf he does… will you let him go? Will you stop? VIVIAN (SCOFFING)Of course. If he really has that scar, I’ll get on my knees and beg for forgiveness. EDMUND (LAUGHING)Yeah, if he’s got it, I’ll chop my own head off and hand it to him as a stool! Hahaha!

Locke pushes himself up from the ground, half-kneeling, one hand bracing his weight. He scans the room, nods. LOCKESince you all want to see... He starts to rise, but Edmund stomps his knee again. EDMUNDStay down! Take off your shirt! Locke glares up at him, his eyes sharp enough to cut. Edmund flinches, but forces a shaky sneer. EDMUND (CONT'D)What are you looking at? Locke rolls up his sleeve. The crowd leans in. Bit by bit, the fabric slides upward—until a deep, jagged scar is revealed across his arm. Everyone stares in shock. VIVIAN (V.O.)No... it can’t be… he really is Locke...
13.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - DAY42 42
Rose stares at the scar on Locke’s arm, eyes trembling.
13.2 EXT. WINSTON MANSION - GARDEN - DAY43 43

Little ROSE (7) chases butterflies through the garden. Suddenly, a gardener lunges toward her with a knife. Locke, without hesitation, throws himself between them, shielding Rose in his arms. The blade slashes deep across his arm — blood sprays across the flowers.
speaker: SUPER: FIFTEEN YEARS AGO

text: 13.3 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL - DAY44 44

Tears spill from Rose’s eyes. ROSE (V.O.)Locke has always protected me… and now… it’s my fault. If it weren’t for me, he wouldn’t have to suffer this humiliation… Locke’s expression remains cold, unreadable. He looks straight at Vivian.

LOCKENow… can you let Rose go? The crowd, stunned, begins to murmur. GUESTHe really has the scar... Edmund whirls toward Vivian, panic setting in. EDMUNDHe—he really has the scar. He’s the real Mr. Locke… then we— Vivian swallows hard, face paling. VIVIANNo! Impossible! You must’ve overheard something. You planned this, didn’t you? LOCKE (ICILY)Enough. You’ve crossed the line too many times.Let her go. Now! Edmund hesitates. Vivian shakes her head violently. VIVIAN (V.O.)No, it can’t be… Wait—Dad said Locke once took a bullet for the heiress. A gunshot wound, right in the chest. Only a handful of people know that… yes, that’s it! VIVIAN (LOUDLY)Impossible! Locke took a bullet for me five years ago — left a gunshot scar on his chest. There’s no way you’d know that! EDMUNDYeah! If you’ve got that scar too, then I’ll believe you! LOCKE (SMIRKING)Is that so? He gives a cold laugh, unbuttoning his suit jacket. LOCKE (CONT'D)Seems you know quite a lot about me. He starts undoing his shirt buttons. Vivian swallows nervously. Rose weeps silently, watching him.
13.4 EXT. CITY STREET - DAY45 45
Rose and Locke walk side by side when chaos erupts ahead. Locke instantly shields her. A bullet hits him square in the chest. He collapses in Rose’s arms.
13.5 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL - DAY46 46

ROSE (V.O.)That day… he nearly didn’t survive… Locke tosses his shirt aside. The camera pans from his abdomen up — his torso crisscrossed with old wounds — revealing the deep, circular gunshot scar at the center of his chest. He points to it, mocking. LOCKEGunshot wound. Edmund stumbles back, pale and trembling. EDMUNDYou… you really are Locke! Vivian’s face twists in terror. VIVIANNo… that’s impossible… you’re— you’re really Locke…
14.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL - DAY47 47

EDMUNDYou… you're really Locke! Vivian stares in horror as Locke slowly rises from the ground, step by step, like a predator closing in. LOCKENow it’s your turn to pay the price. Vivian trembles, her entire body shaking. LOCKE (CONT'D)Let Rose go. Vivian’s breathing quickens. She shakes her head, eyes wide with fear. VIVIAN (HYSTERICAL)No! You can’t be Locke! Locke’s in Deer Town! You’re not him!

LOCKE (COLD)Didn’t you already prove who I am? My patience is running out—don’t test me again. Vivian shakes her head. The shard in her hand presses harder against Rose’s neck, blood starting to drip. VIVIANStay back! Don’t come any closer! Tom’s coming. When he gets here, you're finished! LOCKE (SMIRKING)Tom? Then let him come. I’d love to see how I die. Terrified, Vivian dials furiously. VIVIAN (INTO PHONE)Tom! Where are you? This man pretending to be Locke is out of control! TOM (ON PHONE)Calm down. I’m already downstairs. Whoever’s impersonating Mr. Harris, he’s dead!
14.2 EXT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - FRONT DOOR - DAY48 48
A black car screeches to a stop. Tom storms out with several bodyguards. TOMSurround the building! Make sure he doesn’t leave alive! He leads his men toward the entrance.
14.3 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL - DAY49 49

Vivian hangs up, regaining a bit of her smugness. VIVIANAlmost had me fooled. You hear that? Locke’s chief aide, Tom, is on his way. Let’s see how long you can keep pretending. VIVIAN (CONT'D)Rose, tell your little actor to kneel and beg us for mercy. LOCKE (CALM)Sure. Let’s see who's gonna kneels — me, or Tom. The main doors swing open.

TOM (O.S.)Who’s got such a big mouth they expect me to kneel? Everyone turns. Tom enters with his bodyguards. Edmund immediately runs to him, sycophantic smile on his face. VIVIANTom! She points straight at Locke. (Staging note: Vivian holds Rose at knifepoint, facing the door. Locke stands between them and the entrance, shirtless, his back to the door.) VIVIAN (CONT'D)It’s him! He’s pretending to be Locke! He even said you’d have to kneel to him—and he hurt me! TOM (SNARLING)Insolent bastard! I’ll make sure he pays for this insult! EDMUND (EAGERLY)As Mr. Harris’s chief aide, Tom, you must teach this scum a lesson! Tom strides toward Locke, expression cold. Locke doesn’t move, his gaze dark and steady. TOMDon’t worry. He dared to impersonate Mr. Harris, he won’t live to regret it. He grabs Locke’s shoulder roughly. TOM (CONT'D)Let’s see which fool’s pretending to be— Tom stops mid-sentence as Locke turns his head. Tom freezes, face draining of color. His hand jerks back as he stumbles, collapsing to the floor. TOM (TERRIFIED) (CONT'D)M–Mr. Harris! The room falls dead silent. Everyone stares in shock.
15.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY50 50
TOM (PANICKED)M–Mr. Harris! Edmund blinks, stunned.

EDMUNDTom? This is the guy impersonating Mr. Harris! VIVIAN (FURIOUS)Yes—teach him a lesson! Rip him apart and toss him down the sewer! EDMUND (SMOKING WITH RAGE)No—killing him outright would be too easy. Make him suffer. Make his life a living hell! Locke rises slowly, stretching, eyes cold as he stares at Tom. Tom breaks out in a cold sweat—then, in a desperate panic, slaps Edmund across the face. TOM (SNAPPING)Shut your goddamn mouth! Edmund stands there, stunned, mouth hanging open. VIVIANTom—what are you— Tom smacks Vivian hard, too. TOM (HARD)You shut up, too! Vivian clutches her cheek, shocked and confused. Tom drops to his knees before Locke, pleading. TOM (BEGGING) (CONT'D)Mr. Harris, it was my fault. I was deceived—I thought someone was impersonating you! Edmund and Vivian stare, incredulous. EDMUNDWhat? He’s really Mr. Harris? Edmund’s face collapses. Vivian trembles, the shard of glass she’d held falling from her hand. VIVIAN (SHAKEN)No... that can’t be. It he's real—then... Rose was real too? Locke moves to Rose and helps her up, concerned. LOCKE (CALMLY)Are you okay? Rose nods weakly. Tom’s eyes never leave Locke. Terrified, he slaps his own face again and again. TOM (DESPERATE)Sir—please—punish me. Any punishment. Please!

Locke’s gaze finally lands on Tom. He snorts and kicks Tom’s knee hard. Tom collapses to the floor, kneeling. LOCKE (COLD)Don’t show your face at the company again. Tom panics, shaking his head violently. TOM (PLEADING)No—please, Mr. Harris! I’m begging you—don’t fire me! Locke flicks his fingers. Eric steps forward and drags Tom away by the arm. Edmund and Vivian watch, terrified. VIVIAN (V.O.)Dad! Edmund swallows hard, eyes darting to Vivian. EDMUND (PANICKED)Mr. Harris—this is all her! It’s her fault! That bitch set me up! It’s not my doing!
16.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY51 51

Locke turns to Edmund. LOCKE (COLDLY)You used your right hand, didn’t you? EDMUND (TERRIFIED)No—no, I didn’t! Mr. Harris, please, I swear I didn’t! Locke’s gaze shifts to Vivian. LOCKE (ICILY)And you. VIVIAN (SHAKING)I-I didn’t do anything... Eric enters, a gun in his hand. Locke smirks and extends his hand. Eric passes him the weapon. Locke raises the gun, then fires two shots. One hits Edmund’s right hand. The other slams into Vivian’s shoulder.

LOCKEClean them up. Eric steps forward and kicks Edmund hard in the chest, then plants his boot on Vivian and pulls out a knife. VIVIAN (PLEADING)Please... don’t...! Eric raises the blade and slashes downward.
Locke turns away, walking toward Rose. He bends and lifts her gently into his arms. Rose clings weakly to his neck, eyes dazed and frightened. LOCKE (SOFTLY)Let’s go. I’m taking you home.
speaker: VIVIAN

text: 16.2 INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY52 52
Rose lies unconscious in bed, her face pale, brow furrowed. She drifts in a restless dream.

16.3 INT. WINSTON MANOR – GRAND HALL – NIGHT (DREAM)53 53 Locke showers, his muscular back and old scars visible under the running water. Suddenly, the door bursts open — ROSE stumbles in, clearly drunk. Locke startles, grabbing a towel and wrapping it around his waist. LOCKERose? Rose throws her arms around his neck, eyes red. ROSELocke, I love you! LOCKE (SHOCKED)Do you understand what you’re saying? He tries to pry her hands off, but she clings to him. ROSEI’m not a kid anymore. I know what I feel! I love you, like a woman loves a man! LOCKE (UNSTEADY)I’m your uncle, Rose! Do you understand? There can’t be love between us! He forces her off him, putting space between them.
ROSEWhy not? We’re not blood-related! LOCKEYour grandfather entrusted you to me so I could protect you — not to have feelings for you! Rose stands frozen, her expression shattered.
16.4 INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY54 54

Rose jolts awake, gasping. Sweat beads on her forehead, tears glisten at the corners of her eyes. She looks around, disoriented, slowly remembering where she is. ROSE (V.O.)Why... why did I dream of that night three years ago again?
17.1 INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY55 55

Locke bends close, worry etched on his face. LOCKE (SOFT)Rose? You’re awake. How do you feel? Any pain anywhere? Rose blinks, focusing on Locke sitting beside her. ROSE (PANICKED)Mm... my baby—what about my baby? Is it... still with me? Locke falters, avoiding her gaze. LOCKE (ASHAMED)Sorry. I failed to keep you safe. Tears pour down Rose’s face. ROSE (BREAKING)You protected me so many times... That bastard Edmund... If I'd never met him... if I didn't... LOCKE (V.O., GUILTY)If I hadn’t hurt her like I did three years ago, she wouldn’t have run away. She wouldn’t have met him. None of this would have happened...
17.2 INT. EDMUND’S VILLA – DAY56 56
Edmund grabs Vivian by the hair and slaps her hard.

EDMUND (FURIOUS)It’s all your fault, you bitch! If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t have missed the real heiress! Vivian tumbles onto the couch but springs up and slaps him back. VIVIAN (SNAPPING)You’re such an idiot. You think you could land the Blackstone's heiress without me? They come to blows. EDMUND (ANGRY)She’s pregnant with my kid—this is all because of you,you slut! VIVIAN (COLD)Wake up. She doesn’t want you. She wants her uncle, Locke. You’re just a placeholder she used for fun. Edmund freezes. EDMUNDWhat did you say? VIVIAN (SCORNFUL)Three years ago Rose ran away because she confessed to Locke and he rejected her. She never had feelings for you. Edmund punches the wall in fury. EDMUND (SPITTING)Jesus! That filthy liar! Pretending to be pure while screwing her uncle! VIVIAN (SMIRKING)Now are you awake? Good. Listen. She got me into this situation. Of course I’m taking everything from her! At that moment, SARAH (Vivian’s mother) enters. Vivian takes Sarah’s hand and steers her forward. VIVIAN (PROUD) (CONT'D)This is my mother. My father was fired, she still works at Winston Manor. She’ll help us. Sarah nods quietly.
17.2 INT. WINSTON MANOR - LOCKE’S BEDROOM – DAY58 58

Rose quietly pushes open the door and tiptoes inside. She stands beside the bed, gazing down at the sleeping Locke. Unable to resist, she reaches out to touch him. Suddenly, Locke frowns and murmurs in his sleep. LOCKE (MURMURING)Rose... Rose’s hand stills. ROSE (V.O.)Locke... you dream about me? Does that mean you...? She starts to step away, but Locke’s hand catches hers. LOCKE (HALF ASLEEP)Don’t go... Rose... Rose turns back just as Locke opens his eyes. He looks at her—then at his hand holding hers, quickly lets go. LOCKE (FROWNING) (CONT'D)What are you doing here? Rose lowers her gaze.

ROSE (SOFTLY)If you could go back, would you still turn me away? Locke meets her eyes, his face hard. LOCKE (STEADY)Yes. But this time, I wouldn’t let you cross paths with Edmund. Rose lets out a faint, bitter laugh. ROSE (SADLY)I see... I guess it was just wishful thinking on my part. LOCKERose, I— ROSE (CUTTING HIM OFF)You don’t have to comfort me. She bows her head, wiping away a tear. ROSE (CALMLY) (CONT'D)It’s been a long time.I’m fine. I just came to tell you I’m moving to the West Hill villa. She turns and leaves. Locke watches her go. When the door closes, his hardened face softens into regret.

character: 18.1 INT. WINSTON MANOR – DINING ROOM – DUSK57 57
text: Rose sits at the table, having breakfast. A news report plays on the TV nearby. TV ANCHOR (V.O.)Once hailed as the God of Wall Street, Edmund Reed loses everything overnight. What kind of enemy could bring him down? ROSE (V.O.)Looks like Locke got revenge for me. ROSEWhere’s Locke? MAUREEN (CAUTIOUS)Mr. Harris only went to bed at three this morning, miss. He’s probably still asleep. ROSE (SURPRISED)Three? He used to sleep early. MAUREEN (LOW)Ever since you left three years ago, he’s had trouble sleeping. Rose freezes, the spoon pausing in her hand.
speaker: 18.1 INT. WINSTON MANOR – DINING ROOM – DUSK57 57

text: 18.3 EXT. WINSTON MANOR – GATE – DAY59 59
Rose stands by the gate, glancing back toward Locke’s window. Maureen loads her suitcase into the car. ROSE (V.O.)Goodbye, Locke. She gets into the car.
18.4 INT. LOCKE’S BEDROOM – DAY60 60
From behind the curtains, Locke watches the car pull away, emotions restrained. LOCKE (V.O.)I’m sorry, Rose... I can’t let myself love you.
18.5 EXT. WINSTON MANOR – GATE – DAY61 61
In the driver’s seat, Sarah adjusts her hat. She glances at Rose through the rearview mirror and sneers. ROSEDrive.
19.1 EXT. COUNTRYSIDE ROAD – DAY62 62

The car suddenly screeches to a halt and Rose lurches. ROSEWhat’s going on? Sarah suddenly turns around, holding a handkerchief tightly over Rose’s nose and mouth. Rose struggles, but she loses consciousness.
19.2 INT. UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL - ABANDONED WAREHOUSE – DAY63 63
location: INT UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL - ABANDONED WAREHOUSE

text: Rose lies on an operating table, the white light blinding her. She slowly wakes, squinting against the brightness. ROSE (V.O.)Where am I... my head... so dizzy... A conversation echoes in her ears. DOCTORMiss Vivian, are you sure you want to have your face changed to look like Rose's? You’ve seen the surgical risks disclosure, right? VIVIAN (IMPATIENTLY)Of course! Start the procedure! DOCTORThis is a liability waiver. You're solely responsible for any complications that may arise during the procedure, and the hospital bears no responsibility. VIVIAN (WITHOUT HESITATION)Give me the pen! Rose’s eyes snap open, her vision blurry, but she sees the glint of surgical instruments. Her body stiffens. ROSEI... I don’t consent! The doctor and Vivian turn toward her. ROSE (CONT'D)Doctor, I was kidnapped by her! The doctor frowns and steps toward Rose.

ROSE (CONT'D)Doctor, I don’t consent. The surgery can’t happen! The doctor scoffs, his expression hardening. DOCTORWoke up so soon? (He turns to the door) Jack, where’s the anesthetist? Get him in here! Rose’s pupils contract in fear. Her body goes cold. ROSEYou... you’re all in this together! Vivian smirks as she walks closer. VIVIAN (SNEERING)Of course. This place is for special clients. They only care about money, not people. Rose trembles, her wrists bound tightly by cold restraints, leaving deep red marks. Vivian leans down, her breath warm on Rose’s ear, her hair, scented with perfume, brushing against Rose’s cheek. Vivian’s fingers glide slowly, tracing Rose’s cheek, brow and nose... VIVIAN (WHISPERING, OBSESSIVE) (CONT'D)Stop struggling, sweetheart. Just give me your pretty face. Rose’s face turns deathly pale.
19.3 INT. WINSTON MANOR – LOCKE’S BEDROOM – DAY64 64

The butler rushes to knock on Locke’s bedroom door. THOMAS (ANXIOUSLY)Sir, something’s wrong! Locke, getting dressed, opens the door. LOCKE (CALMLY)What’s going on? THOMASThe West Hill villa called—Miss Rose hasn’t arrived! She left two hours ago, and normally, this drive takes only half an hour! Locke’s expression shifts to concern. LOCKEGather everyone immediately! We need to find Rose—Eric!
Eric, the bodyguard, enters promptly. ERICYes, sir!
20.1 INT. UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL – DAY65 65

Rose’s eyes track Vivian’s fingers; each touch sends a shudder through her. She swallows hard, terrified. ROSE (PLEADING)I’ll pay you—double, triple, ten times what she paid! Just let me go! Vivian’s face hardens. She straightens and slaps Rose across the face. VIVIAN (SNARLING)Don’t even think about it! She turns to the doctor, voice low and threatening. VIVIAN (TO DOCTOR) (CONT'D)They signed the contract and paid a deposit. Backing out now would ruin your business! DOCTOR (CLINICAL)Miss Vivian is our client. We honor our commitments. The anesthetist wheels in a cart and makes a noise as he sets it down. DOCTOR (CONT'D)Give her another dose—make sure she won’t move. The anesthetist nods. He snaps the neck off an ampoule and draws the liquid into a syringe. Rose’s fear spikes; she writhes on the table,straps cutting into her wrists. ROSE (TERROR)Vivian, stop! Aren't you afraid of Locke? He’ll come and find me! Vivian laughs, stepping in close. VIVIAN (TRIUMPHANT)Locke? By the time he gets here it’ll be too late. With your face, I’ll take your life—your rights, your status, your men. Edmund, Locke, they'll be mine! She leans so close their noses nearly touch.

VIVIAN (WHISPERING, OBSESSIVE) (CONT'D)And you? I’ll make you a filthy slut — so you know what it’s like to be fallen, Miss Winston. Rose’s jaw tightens. ROSE (DEFIANT)Even if you take my face, Locke will still know that's you. You can’t fool him. Vivian smirks, slapping Rose’s cheek lightly. VIVIAN (CRUEL)Don’t worry about that. (her fingernail drags across Rose’s tear duct) Don’t puff up your eyes—if you cry and ruin the operation, I’ll be angry. She steps back, pleased. VIVIAN (TO DOCTOR) (CONT'D)Proceed. The anesthetist rubs Rose’s arm with alcohol and plunges the needle in. ROSE (WEAK, SOBBING)No... please... don’t...
20.2 INT. WINSTON MANOR – STUDY – DAY66 66
Eric bursts into the study, out of breath. ERIC (URGENT)Sir—we found something! He thrusts a tablet at Locke. Locke watches the footage.
20.3 EXT. SUBURBAN ROAD - DAY67 67

A white car pulls off the road. A black car pulls up. Edmund and Vivian get out, force Rose into the black car. (Sarah not shown.) The clip ends with Vivian sneering. VIVIAN (ON FOOTAGE)Take her to the clinic! Go!
20.4 INT. WINSTON MANOR – STUDY – DAY68 68
Locke slams the tablet down in fury.
LOCKE (SNAPPING)Which hospital did they go to? ERIC (FAST)We traced them—an underground cosmetic clinic. LOCKE (COLD, COMMANDING)Surround that place. I want Rose back—alive and unharmed.
21.1 INT. UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL – DAY69 69

As the anesthesia enters her veins, Rose feels her eyelids grow heavy. Her body weakens. She bites her tongue hard—pain jolting her mind awake for just a moment. But her body won’t obey her anymore. ANESTHETIST (COLDLY)The drug’s fast-acting. She’ll be fully under in seconds. You can begin. VIVIAN (EXCITED, RUBBING HER HANDS)Doctor, make it perfect—no flaws! I want her face flawless! DOCTOR (PUTTING ON GLOVES)Relax. My work is exact. She’ll look identical when I’m done. He takes a thick marker and draws incision lines across Rose’s face. The chill of the ink prickles her skin; she clenches her teeth, eyelids twitching, fighting to stay awake. But her body refuses to move. ROSE (V.O.)No... I can’t fall asleep... they can’t take my face... Her fingers tremble, clutching the bedsheet weakly. The doctor steps back, satisfied. DOCTORAlright. We’ll start from the hairline—clean cut, full lift. ROSE (V.O.)Locke... can you find me? The doctor sets down the pen and picks up a scalpel. The cold metal touches her cheek, making her shiver. He steadies his wrist—then the blade pierces her skin.
21.2 INT. UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL - SURGERY ROOM HALLWAY – DAY70 70
location: INT UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL - SURGERY ROOM HALLWAY

text: Armed men flood the underground passage, surrounding the operating room. Locke stops before the door. LOCKE (COLDLY)Blow it open.
21.3 INT. UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL – DAY71 71

A thin red line runs down Rose’s right cheek. The doctor leans in, voice calm and clinical. DOCTORGood... hold that depth. We can peel cleanly from here. He lifts the scalpel again, adjusting his angle for the next incision—when suddenly—BOOM! The heavy steel door explodes inward, shards of metal and wood scattering across the room. The floor trembles. LOCKE (ROARING)Touch her—and you die! Everyone turns, terrified. Locke stands in the doorway, his coat whipping in the blast’s wind. Behind him, a wall of armed men storm in. The doctor’s scalpel clatters to the floor. Vivian’s face drains of color.
22.1 INT. UNDERGROUND COSMETIC SURGERY HOSPITAL – DAY72 72

Just as the scalpel is about to slice into Rose’s skin again—BANG! Everyone startles, spinning toward the door. It’s Edmund, bursting in and slamming the door open. VIVIAN (ANGRILY)What the hell are you doing? If you mess up the surgery, can you take responsibility? EDMUND (BREATHLESS)Locke’s found out we kidnapped Rose! You need to hurry! Vivian’s face drains of color. She nods quickly. VIVIAN (PANICKED)Got it. Keep watch at the door!
22.2 INT. SURGERY ROOM HALLWAY – DAY73 73
The operating room doors explode. Locke storms in.

LOCKE (YELLING)Rose! But the room is empty. LOCKE (FACE DARKENING) (CONT'D)Where is she?! ERIC (RUSHING IN)Sir, this isn’t the right hospital! Locke slams his foot into a surgical cart, sending it crashing across the floor. LOCKE (FURIOUS)Find them! If anything happens to Rose, I’ll hold you all responsible! ERIC (STEADY)Yes, sir!
22.3 EXT. CITY STREETS – DAY74 74
Eric and his men kick down door after door, clearing building after building—each one empty.
22.4 INT. POLICE STATION – DAY75 75

The guards exit the hospital. In a dark corner, Edmund watches them leave, eyes lighting up. He slips inside.
35.3 INT. WINSTON MANOR - ROSE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT116 116

Vivian (Rose's face) paces the room, agitated. The phone rings once — she answers immediately. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)How's it? EDMUND (ON PHONE)The bodyguards are gone! Vivian (Rose's face)’s lips curl into a cold smile. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)Got it. Keep an eye on her. I can’t leave now, but I’ll come in person tomorrow morning. I need to see her die!
35.4 INT. WINSTON MANOR HALL - DAY117 117

Servants bustle about, preparing for the memorial prayer. Vivian (Rose's face) rushes out of her room and hurries down the stairs. Maureen follows anxiously behind. MAUREENMiss, you shouldn’t go out today! VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)Stay out of my way! Vivian (Rose's face) reaches the hall, Thomas stops her. THOMASMiss, it’s not time yet. Please wait a little longer.

VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)I have plans with a friend. Tell Locke I’ll skip breakfast. Thomas looks stunned. THOMASMiss, you’re not cooking yourself today? VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)Cooking? Me? Do I look like someone who needs to cook myself? Thomas, you’re losing it, aren’t you? Thomas freezes. THOMASBut today is the late master’s— VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)Enough! Since when does a servant question their mistress? Who do you think you are? Maureen steps forward, panicked. MAUREENMiss, today isn’t like any other day— Vivian (Rose's face) slaps Maureen hard across the face. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)That’s enough! Maureen stares in shock, clutching her cheek. Thomas frowns deeply. The other servants stop what they’re doing, all turning to watch in disbelief. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE) (CONT'D)What’s wrong with you two today? Move! Vivian (Rose's face) pushes past them and storms out of the hall. Just then, Locke comes downstairs, neatly dressed. He looks at the frozen staff and walks over. LOCKEWhat happened? Everyone turns to him. Thomas steps forward, flustered. THOMASSir, Miss Winston just ran out. She said she’s not cooking today! LOCKE (SURPRISED)What?

MAUREENYes, sir. She said she had plans with a friend and told us not to stop her. But she’s never gone out on this day before. Do you think something’s wrong? Locke’s expression darkens. One servant whispers quietly. SERVANTShe didn’t look troubled... more like she forgot what day it was... Locke shoots the servant a sharp look. THOMAS (ANGRILY)Silence! Miss would never forget the old master’s memorial! Even if she forgot everything else, she’d never forget this day! LOCKE (V.O.)That’s right... Rose would never forget her grandfather’s memorial. Unless... she isn’t Rose. Locke freezes, realization dawning.
36.1 INT. WINSTON MANOR HALL - DAY118 118

LOCKE (V.O.)Rose would never forget her grandfather's memorial. Unless... she isn't Rose. Locke freezes, stunned. He looks to Thomas and Maureen. Both wear worried faces; Locke feels dizzy. Eric rushes in. ERICSir! Locke turns to him. ERIC (CONT'D)We found her. The one at the hospital—she's the real miss. LOCKEPrepare a car. Now. I'm going to Haven Hospital.
36.2 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY119 119
Rose stares out at a distant chapel, pen in hand, writing.

ROSE (V.O.)Grandpa, today is your memorial. Forgive me for not cooking your favorite pasta. I'm facing problems I don't know how to solve. How can I make Locke believe I'm Rose? What should I do... The door is kicked open. Rose startles and spins around. Vivian (Rose's face) and Edmund rush in; Vivian bears Rose's face. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)Rose, I finally found you! Rose scrambles to her feet, terrified. ROSE (V.O.)W-what are you doing? This is a hospital! VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)As long as you're alive, my claim as Blackstone Capital's heiress won't stand. Rose gulps and looks for a way out. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE) (CONT'D)So we're here- to kill you! ROSE (V.O., FRIGHTENED)Is anyone there? Help! Somebody— (Her voice cracks, breaking into hoarse, muffled sounds.) EDMUNDNo need to shout. No one will come today.
37.1 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY120 120

EDMUNDNo one will come today. Rose clenches her fists and bolts for the door. Edmund grabs her and kicks her leg, sending her crashing to the floor. Rose screams in pain. Edmund shuts the door. Vivian (Rose's face) chuckles coldly, walks to the window, and sits at the small table where Rose had been writing. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)You won't be going anywhere today. You have to die here. ROSE (V.O., GUESTURING)Aren't you afraid Locke will find out the truth?

VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE) (SMUG)Once you're dead, there'll only be one Rose left. Locke will never know. Rose glares at Edmund, fists trembling. ROSE (V.O., GUESTURING)You're helping her too? Edmund shrugs. EDMUNDWhat else am I supposed to do? If the real heiress doesn't want me, I'll pick someone who does. Rose's eyes fill with tears. ROSE (V.O., GUESTURING)You won't get away with this! Vivian (Rose's face) crosses her legs, taps the floor with her high heel. VIVIAN (ROSE'S FACE)Enough talk, Edmund. Get on with it. Make it quick and gentle — after all, she's your former flame. Edmund nods, scans the room, and grabs a towel from the bed. He approaches Rose. Rose scrambles to her feet and reaches for the door handle. Edmund lunges forward, shoves the towel over Rose's head, and clamps it down, strangling her. ROSEAh— Edmund tightens his grip. Rose claws and kicks, her face flushing as she struggles for air. ROSE (V.O., GUESTURING) (CONT'D)Help… somebody… Vivian (Rose's face) watches, laughing triumphantly. She leans back and accidentally knocks a sheet of paper and a pen to the floor. She picks up the paper, at first disdainful — then her eyes lock on the line: "Grandpa, today is your memorial." Vivian (Rose's face)'s face goes pale.
38.1 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY121 121
Vivian(Rose's face)’s eyes go wide. The letter slips from her hand.
VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (MURMURING)Grandpa’s memorial... today? FLASHBACK to SC 35.4
38.2 INT. WINSTON MANOR HALL - DAY122 122

THOMASMiss, you’re not cooking yourself today? VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Cooking? Me? Do I look like someone who needs to cook myself? Thomas, you’re losing it, aren’t you? Thomas freezes. THOMASBut today is the late master’s—

VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (WHISPERING)So today’s Grandpa’s memorial. I—I exposed myself. And Locke... he must know! Vivian(Rose's face) shoots up, panicked. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Edmund! Edmund releases Rose and turns toward her. EDMUNDWhat? VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (FRANTIC)I’m exposed! EDMUNDWhat?! VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Today’s her grandfather’s memorial. Every year, Rose cooks for him. This morning Thomas asked me about it— and I yelled at him! I forced my way out! Edmund’s face drains of color. EDMUNDThen they must know! Vivian(Rose's face) clutches his arm, trembling.
speaker: END FLASHBACK

text: VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)What do we do? Locke’s coming. He knows I’m not Rose— and he knows what we did to her! We’re dead, Edmund, we’re dead! Meanwhile, Rose, gasping for air, braces against the wall. She stumbles to the door, wrenches it open, and runs out.
38.3 INT. LOCKE'S CAR – DAY123 123
Locke sits in the back seat, face hard and grim. LOCKE (V.O.)Rose... wait for me.
38.4 EXT. STREET - DAY124 124
A convoy of cars speeds down the road toward the hospital.
39.1 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY125 125
Rose staggers out of the room and bolts toward the elevator at the end of the hall. Halfway there she collapses, panting, then pushes herself up, and keeps running.
39.2 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY126 126

Edmund leans against the wall, thinking. He lifts his head. EDMUNDIf it's come to this, finish it. If Rose dies, there'll be no proof left. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (EAGER)Right. Once she's dead, I'm the only Rose. And make sure it's unrecognizable—no one can identify her. They rush for the door.
39.3 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL HALLWAY - DAY127 127

They catch sight of Rose heading for the elevator. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)After her! Edmund and Vivian(Rose's face) sprint down the corridor. Rose weakly presses the elevator button, but the lift is stuck at the tenth floor and doesn't come. Footsteps thunder behind her.
She glances back — Vivian(Rose's face) and Edmund closing in. She scans her options and darts for the stairwell.
39.4 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL - STAIRWELL - DAY128 128
Rose rushes into the stairwell only to find the downward access blocked by a metal gate. She turns and runs upward. Edmund follows close behind.
39.5 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL HALLWAY (15TH FLOOR) - DAY129 129

The elevator finally arrives. A NURSE pushes a supply cart out. Vivian(Rose's face)'s eyes lock on a bottle of sulfuric acid sitting on the cart. She stops cold, grabs the bottle. NURSEHey— Vivian(Rose's face) pulls a wad of cash from her bag and presses it into the nurse's hand. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Will this ruin a face completely? No one would be able to recognize them? NURSE (TREMBLING)I-it will... it will. She watches Vivian(Rose's face) bolt toward the stairwell with the acid.
39.6 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL - STAIRWELL - DAY130 130
Rose runs up the stairs, exhausted. Edmund is one flight below, closing the gap. Vivian(Rose's face) bursts into the stairwell, the bottle clutched in her hand.
39.7 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY131 131
Locke hurries into the lobby, moving fast, eyes sharp.
40.1 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL STAIRWELL - DAY132 132

The stairwell lights flicker with each pounding step, making the place feel even scarier. Rose is gasping for breath but won't stop. Her eyes lock on the path ahead. ROSE (V.O.)If I can just get somewhere crowded... once there are people, they won't dare.

EDMUND (SHOUTING, O.S.)Stop! Rose glances back, terrified — Edmund is close. ROSE (V.O.)Faster, faster... VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (O.S.)Edmund! Grab her! I know a way to make sure no one can identify her after... Rose panics and pushes through a fire door, sprinting out.
40.2 EXT. ROOFTOP PLATFORM - DAY133 133

The door opens onto a rooftop platform. Rose swallows hard, trying to hide. Edmund bursts through the door, scans the empty space, and sneers. EDMUND (COLD)Run, then. Try running one more lap and see what happens. He lunges and yanks Rose by the hair. She fights back with everything she has. ROSE (V.O., PLEADING)Let go! Edmund slaps her hard. EDMUNDBehave yourself! Vivian(Rose's face) catches up, smirking. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Look at you — digging your own grave, Rose.
40.3 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY134 134
Locke throws the door open. LOCKERose! The room is empty and trashed, signs of a struggle everywhere. LOCKE (CONT'D)Damn. LOCKE (CONT'D)Pull the hospital footage now!
41.1 EXT. ROOFTOP PLATFORM - DAY135 135

Vivian(Rose's face) locks the metal gate behind her. She shakes the bottle of acid in her hand, stepping closer to Rose. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)You know what this is? Ninety-eight percent pure sulfuric acid. She twists the cap open, grabs Rose by the chin, and sneers down at her face. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (CONT'D)One little pour, and that pretty face of yours is gone forever. Even if your body ends up at Locke’s feet, he’ll never recognize you! She bursts into laughter. Rose’s eyes widen in terror. ROSE (V.O., FRANTIC GESTURES)You’re insane! VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Hold her still—let’s finish this. She nods to Edmund. He grabs Rose by the neck with one hand and forces her head steady with the other. Vivian(Rose's face) lifts the bottle above Rose’s face, slowly tilting it.
41.2 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY136 136

Locke stands at the desk, clutching Rose’s letter, guilt flooding his eyes. LOCKE (V.O.)It’s my fault. I should see it sooner… Eric rushes in, tablet in hand. ERICFound her! She’s on the rooftop! Vivian(Rose's face) and Edmund—they’re trying to kill her! Locke jolts, drops the letter, and bolts out of the room.
41.3 EXT. ROOFTOP PLATFORM - DAY137 137
Rose’s pupils contract in sheer panic. Suddenly, she kicks Vivian(Rose's face) hard in the stomach.

Vivian(Rose's face) stumbles back, the acid splashing onto her hand. EDMUNDVivian! Rose bites down on Edmund’s hand. He yells in pain and releases her. Rose breaks free and runs. Vivian(Rose's face) and Edmund exchange a quick look, then chase after her. EDMUND (CONT'D)Stop! Rose backs away and reaches the edge of the rooftop. ROSE (V.O., DESPERATE GESTURES)Don’t come any closer! Vivian(Rose's face) slows, smirking as she eyes the drop behind Rose. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Looks like you’ve already chosen how you're going to die.
42.1 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL - STAIRWELL - DAY138 138
Locke leads the charge up the stairs, Eric and several guards close behind.
42.2 EXT. ROOFTOP PLATFORM - DAY139 139

VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Looks like you’ve already chosen how you're going to die. Rose glances back — the edge of the roof is terrifyingly close. Vivian(Rose's face) advances, step by step, forcing Rose to retreat. Vivian(Rose's face) grabs Rose by the shoulder. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (CONT'D)All it takes is one little push, and you’re done. ROSE (V.O., FRANTIC GESTURES)There are people down there— witnesses! If you push me, you’ll go down too! Vivian(Rose's face) looks over the edge. Sure enough, a crowd has gathered below, watching. She smirks. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)You forget—you’re “mentally unstable.” You tried to jump. We just couldn’t save you in time.

EDMUNDYeah, we’re your dear friends. Couldn’t stop you—we’re heartbroken. ROSE (V.O., FURIOUS GESTURES)You can't do that! Vivian(Rose's face)’s hand slides from Rose’s shoulder up to her face. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (LAUGHING)The great Miss Winston—the heiress of Blackstone Capital. Always looking down on us. Never thought you’d end up here, did you? Suddenly, Locke bursts through the stairwell gate and freezes when he sees Rose at the edge. Without hesitation, he raises his gun and fires. Edmund drops, clutching his leg, blood gushing. Vivian(Rose's face) gasps and spins around—then freezes when she sees Locke. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)Locke... Locke ignores her, eyes fixed on Rose. LOCKERose! Don’t be afraid—I’m here! Rose breaks down in tears of relief. ROSE (V.O.)Locke! Vivian(Rose's face) swallows hard, trembling. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (WHISPERING)It’s over… he’s here… Locke aims again but hesitates—Vivian(Rose's face) keeps Rose too close. One wrong move, and he’ll hit her. He lowers the gun and kicks the metal gate open. LOCKEVivian, let her go! I’ll spare you if you do! Vivian(Rose's face) glares at Rose, jealousy twisting her face. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE)You think I’ll believe that? She looks straight at Rose. VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (CONT'D)If I can’t live, neither will you!

ROSE (V.O., HORRIFIED GESTURES)What are you doing? VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (SMIRKING)If I’m doomed anyway, I might as well take you down with me! Rose’s eyes widen in shock. ROSE (V.O.)You’re insane! VIVIAN(ROSE'S FACE) (SCREAMING)Yes, I am! Let’s die together! Eric slams through the gate behind Locke. Locke charges forward. Rose’s face lights up for an instant—then Vivian(Rose's face) lunges. Rose’s eyes go wide as she’s shoved backward off the roof. Locke dives forward, reaching for her—but she’s already falling.
43.1 INT. ER WAITING AREA - DAY140 140

Locke paces outside the operating room, desperate. LOCKERose... please be okay... Eric arrives, breathless. ERICSir — Vivian and Edmund are dead. Locke's jaw tightens, fury boils behind his eyes. LOCKEThey couldn't have done all this on their own. Find out who helped them, eliminate them all! ERICYes, sir.
43.2 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY141 141
Rose lies unconscious on the bed. DOCTORThe surgery went well. She’ll wake once the anesthesia wears off. Locke sits by her bedside, eyes full of worry.

LOCKEHer face and her voice… can they be healed? DOCTORYes, but it’ll take time — a long recovery. LOCKEWhatever it takes. Do it. DOCTORUnderstood. I’ll draft a treatment plan. The doctor exits. Eric closes the door and stands guard outside. Locke’s hand trembles as he gently touches Rose’s face, love flickering in his eyes. LOCKEWhy didn’t I recognize you sooner? He takes her hand, voice breaking. LOCKE (CONT'D)Rose... all these years, I've never dared to respond to your love. I'm sorry... FLASHBACK 1 to SC 2.2
43.3 INT. WINSTON MANOR - BATHROOM - NIGHT142 142

ROSELocke, I love you! LOCKE (SHOCKED)Do you understand what you’re saying? He tries to pry her hands off, but she clings to him. ROSEI’m not a kid anymore. I know what I feel! I love you, like a woman loves a man! LOCKE (UNSTEADY)I’m your uncle, Rose! Do you understand? There can’t be love between us! He forces her off him, putting space between them. ROSEWhy not? We’re not blood-related!
LOCKEYour grandfather entrusted you to me so I could protect you — not to have feelings for you!
A tear slips down his cheek, landing on her skin. LOCKE (SOFTLY) (CONT'D)How could I not fall for you… But you’re the girl I’ve raised, the one I swore to protect. FLASHBACK 2 to SC 7.5
43.4 INT. WINSTON MANOR HALL - NIGHT143 143
An elderly GRANDFATHER grips Locke’s hand tightly. GRANDFATHERLocke, you’re the one I trust most. I’m leaving Rose to you. Keep her safe.
43.4 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY144 144

LOCKEYour grandfather saved my life. Without him, I’d be nothing. How could I ever have improper thoughts about his granddaughter? He lowers his head, resting his forehead against her hand. LOCKE (WHISPERING) (CONT'D)I’m sorry… Rose’s eyelashes flutter — but Locke doesn’t notice.
44.1 INT. WINSTON MANOR - STUDY - NIGHT145 145

Thurgood sits across from Locke, holding a will in his hand. THURGOODMr. Harris, I hope you still remember Rose's grandfather's will. LOCKEOf course. I won’t be with her. In one month, Rose will turn twenty-five. I’ll tell her then — and find someone suitable for her to marry.
44.2 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY146 146

The doctor slowly unwraps the bandages from Rose’s face. With the final layer undone—CONFETTI bursts in the air. Applause fills the room. LOCKE (SMILING)Congratulations, Rose, you’ve been fully recovered. Rose hesitates, then picks up a mirror. Seeing her reflection, she exhales in relief. A knock sounds on the door. Attorney THURGOOD enters, holding a folder. ROSE (CURIOUS)Locke, who’s this? Locke’s smile fades. He takes a slow breath. LOCKEIt's Thurgood, the Winston family attorney. Before your grandfather passed, he left instructions for us to meet with you today. Thurgood steps forward, extending a polite hand. THURGOODMiss Rose, it’s an honor. ROSENice to meet you. Thurgood opens the folder, glancing at both of them. THURGOODI’m here on behalf of the late Mr. Alfred Winston to present the contents of his will. Rose looks uneasily at Locke. Locke gives her a nod. THURGOOD (CONT'D)According to Mr. Winston’s will, Mr. Harris has been serving as your temporary guardian and acting chairman of Blackstone Capital. Upon your twenty-fifth birthday — once you are married — full ownership of the company will transfer to you. ROSE (SHOCKED)Married? LOCKEYes. That was your grandfather’s final wish. Tomorrow is your birthday banquet.(MORE)

LOCKE (CONT'D)I’ve invited some of the most eligible young men from prominent families. You’ll have the chance to meet them… and see who you might like. Rose stares at him, disbelief and heartbreak in her eyes.
45.1 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY147 147

Thurgood closes the folder and hands it to Rose. THURGOODMiss Rose, I hope to hear good news from you soon. Take care. He turns and exits. Rose keeps her gaze fixed on Locke. ROSEAfter everything we’ve been through… I thought things between us would be different. Locke avoids her eyes. He turns and leaves. Rose watches his back disappear, her chest tightening. Tears stream down her face. Locke’s expression is resolute—but as he walks away, a single tear slips down his cheek.
45.2 INT. WINSTON MANOR - BALLROOM - DAY148 148

Rose descends the grand staircase, radiant in her gown but expressionless, Maureen supporting her arm. A group of young men hurry forward, eager and smiling. YOUNG MAN 1Miss Rose, you look absolutely stunning tonight! YOUNG MAN 2It’s been too long, Miss Rose! Rose’s eyes wander, searching through the crowd. Then—Locke appears. Her heart lifts, and she takes a step forward—then freezes. At Locke’s side stands a beautiful woman, her arm linked tightly through his. Locke walks toward Rose, composed and formal. ROSEWho is she? LOCKEThis is Lisa — my girlfriend. And soon, she’ll be your aunt. Lisa leans close against him and offers a small box.

LISAHi, Rose. It’s so nice to finally meet you. I brought you a gift. Rose doesn’t take it. She just looks at Locke. ROSEI don’t believe you. LOCKEWhy not? Once you’re married, Lisa and I will get married too. He turns, brushing a strand of hair from Lisa’s face. Rose’s eyes redden, shimmering.
46.1 INT. WINSTON MANOR - BALLROOM - DAY149 149

Lisa blushes. Locke turns back to Rose, forcing a smile. LOCKEThere are so many guests today. Anyone catch your eye? Rose takes a deep breath, then smiles. ROSEThanks to you, Mr. Harris, I’m quite pleased with your choices tonight. She looks around, then stops on a man about Locke’s age. ROSE (V.O.)Ethan Wright… Locke’s old rival. Rose strides toward him and loops her arm through his. ROSEI like him. Gasps ripple through the room. Ethan looks surprised. LOCKE (FROWNING)Rose! Marriage isn’t a game. Don’t be childish. ROSEI’m not joking! I really like him — love at first sight! LOCKE (TO ETHAN)She’s being impulsive. I’m sure you understand, Mr. Wright. Ethan smirks, clearly enjoying Locke’s irritation. He leans closer, speaking under his breath.

ETHAN (LOW, TAUNTING)A beautiful woman and the chance to see you lose your cool? You know me, Locke — I can’t resist. LOCKE (WARNING)Don’t push it, Ethan. Ethan lifts Rose’s hand and kisses it with grace. ETHANTruth is, I’ve admired Miss Rose for quite some time. If I could marry her, I’d be honored. ROSEThat’s perfect then, Mr. Wright. She rises on tiptoe and kisses his cheek. Ethan grins. Locke freezes in place, stunned. Rose interlocks her fingers with Ethan’s and turns back to Locke. ROSE (CONT'D)Mr. Harris, let’s set the wedding for one month from now. You’ll walk me down the aisle, won’t you? LOCKE (SNAPS)Rose! Rose glances at Ethan, her eyes soft and affectionate. ROSECome on, let’s go. I want some time alone — just the two of us. She tugs Ethan’s hand and rushes out. LOCKE (YELLING)Rose! But she doesn’t stop.
46.2 INT. WINSTON MANOR - STUDY - DAY150 150

Locke sits behind his desk, cigarette burning between his fingers, fury etched across his face. Lisa peeks in. LISAMr. Harris, this isn’t on me. So… about the payment? Locke opens a drawer, pulls out a wad of cash, and slams it on the desk. LOCKETake it. And get out. Lisa snatches the money eagerly, counting it.

LISAPerfect, perfect. I’m gone. She turns to leave, then hesitates, muttering just loud enough for him to hear. LISA (CONT'D)Guess even rich men like to torture themselves — pretending not to love the one they can’t stop thinking about. Locke’s expression flickers — her words hit a nerve.
48.1 INT. WINSTON MANOR - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT152 152

ROSEYou pushed me away, Locke. You’re a coward! LOCKEIt’s late. Go to bed. He turns and walks upstairs. Rose stares after him, eyes burning with frustration. ROSEI’m doing my wedding photos tomorrow—right here at home. Don’t forget to show up, Uncle, since you’re the elder. Locke pauses on the steps, then nods slightly. LOCKEAll right. He disappears around the corner. Rose’s eyes redden. She slumps onto the sofa, grabs Locke’s cigarette pack and lighter, and lights one. She coughs violently, tears spilling down her cheeks as the smoke drifts around her.
48.2 INT. WINSTON MANOR - STAIRCASE LANDING - NIGHT153 153

Locke stands at the corner, unable to take another step. He leans his head against the wall, listening to the sounds from below — Rose coughing, sniffling — his face tight with emotion. His eyes glisten.
48.3 INT. COMPANY OFFICE - DAY154 154

Locke steps into the office and sinks into his chair. Eric glances at him, hesitant. ERICSir, Miss Rose invited me to her wedding. Can I… go? Locke glances up, voice flat. LOCKEOf course. From now on, your only job is to protect Rose. You don’t need to follow me anymore. Eric freezes, eyes wide. ERICSir, I— LOCKEGo. Guard their happily ever after. He tosses the invitation at Eric. Eric catches it awkwardly, sighs, and turns for the door. ERIC (MUTTERING)Man, getting punished just because the boss is jealous… I’m just the bodyguard.
48.4 INT. HALLWAY OUTSIDE OFFICE - DAY155 155

Eric shuts the door behind him, checks that no one’s around, and immediately pulls out his phone. ERICMiss, it’s done — just like you said! ROSE (ON PHONE)And? How did he react? ERICMiss, I swear — he’s jealous. No doubt about it! Rose smiles confidently. ROSE (ON PHONE)Good.
48.5 INT. COMPANY OFFICE - DAY156 156
Locke stands by the window, expression distant. A knock breaks the silence. Thurgood enters, laptop in hand.

THURGOODMr. Harris. Locke doesn’t turn around. He gestures at the document on the desk. LOCKEI won’t attend the wedding. Please deliver this document to her afterward. Thurgood opens the folder, brows furrowing at the title — “Asset Transfer.” THURGOODWhere are you going, sir? LOCKELeaving. She’s grown up now… she doesn’t need me anymore.
49.1 INT. MANSION HALL – DAY157 157
Rose rushes to the Thomas, whispering anxiously. ROSEWhere’s Locke? THOMAS(FLUSTERED)He left, Miss. If he doesn’t come to stop the wedding… what do we do? ROSE (FIRM)He will. FLASHBACK to SC 43.2
49.2 INT. HAVEN HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY158 158
Locke takes her hand, voice breaking. LOCKERose… all these years, I've never dared to respond to your love. I'm sorry.(beat) How could I not feel something for you?
ROSE (DETERMINED)He’s not cold — just scared. Then I’ll push him past that fear.
speaker: END FLASHBACK

text: 49.3 INT. LOCKE'S CAR – DAY159 159

The car radio plays a live broadcast of Rose’s wedding. HOST (V.O.)Any wishes for the bride and groom? GUEST (V.O.)We wish Rose and Ethan a lifetime of happiness! Locke listens in silence. Eric sneaks a look at Locke, who’s staring out the window. ERICSir… are you really leaving before the ceremony’s over? Locke snaps out of his thoughts, his voice low and calm. LOCKETurn it off. Drive. Now!
